#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
export GOTOOLCHAIN=local
export CGO_ENABLED=0
required="go$(awk '$1 == "go" {print $2}' go.mod)"
if [ "$(go env GOVERSION)" != "$required" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "请使用go.mod锁定的工具链: $required" >&2
    exit 2
fi
revision=$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)
dirty=false
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then dirty=true; fi
mkdir -p bin
go mod verify
go build -mod=readonly -trimpath -buildvcs=false \
    -ldflags="-buildid= -X github.com/franz-9527/workers/chat/internal/bootstrap.sourceRevision=$revision -X github.com/franz-9527/workers/chat/internal/bootstrap.sourceDirty=$dirty" \
    -o bin/chatd ./cmd/chatd

package moderation

import "testing"

func TestDiversionRulesAndConstructionNegatives(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		text     string
		previous []string
		blocked  bool
	}{
		{"电话 １３８ ００１３ ８０００", nil, true},
		{"联系我 一三八 零零一三 八零零零", nil, true},
		{"电话 one three eight zero zero one three eight zero zero zero", nil, true},
		{"电话 yao san ba ling ling yi san ba ling ling ling", nil, true},
		{"加我 ＶＸ：abc_123456", nil, true},
		{"加微信a\u200bb\u200cc123456", nil, true},
		{"weixin://contacts/profile/fixture", nil, true},
		{"取消订单后私下做，省掉服务费", nil, true},
		{"不走平台，这单私下做", nil, true},
		{"13800138000", nil, false},
		{"工单号13800138000，墙长12.5米，面积25平方米，报价1380元", nil, false},
		{"施工20261022138001，预约10:30，五楼二单元三零一", nil, false},
		{"不要私下加微信", nil, false},
		{"禁止绕过平台交易", nil, false},
		{"请勿发送电话13800138000", nil, false},
		{"售后电话请在订单页面查看", nil, false},
		{"请使用订单的联系师傅入口，尾款在原入口确认", nil, false},
		{"加微信", nil, false},
		{"型号VXabc123456，按图施工", nil, false},
		{"材料说明 https://brand.example.test/spec/13800138000", nil, false},
		{"不要私下加微信abc123，但加微信xyz789", nil, true},
		{"38000", []string{"电话138001"}, true},
		{"def456", []string{"微信abc"}, true},
		{"ok", []string{"请勿私下加微信abc123"}, false},
		{"ok", []string{"微信abc123456"}, false},
		{"你好", []string{"电话13800138000"}, false},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		t.Run(c.text, func(t *testing.T) {
			code := analyze(c.text, c.previous)
			if (code != "") != c.blocked {
				t.Fatalf("decision %q expected blocked=%v", code, c.blocked)
			}
		})
	}
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# S09 acceptance only. No production database, no deployment, no schema
# writes outside explicitly isolated random test databases.
set -euo pipefail

fail() { printf 'CHAT_S09_VERIFY_BLOCKED: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$root"

[[ "${CHAT_AUTH_TEST_INTEGRATION:-}" == "1" ]] || fail "isolated integration switch must be exactly 1"
[[ "${CHAT_INTEGRATION_MYSQL_ADDR:-}" =~ ^127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "MySQL must be explicitly loopback only"
[[ "${CHAT_INTEGRATION_REDIS_ADDR:-}" =~ ^127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "Redis must be explicitly loopback only"
[[ "${CHAT_AUTH_TEST_REDIS_ADDRESS:-}" =~ ^127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "Redis identity integration address must be loopback only"
[[ -n "${CHAT_INTEGRATION_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]] || fail "explicit isolated MySQL fixture administrator credential missing"
[[ -n "${CHAT_AUTH_TEST_PHP:-}" && -x "${CHAT_AUTH_TEST_PHP:-/nonexistent}" ]] || fail "explicit PHP binary path required"
[[ "${CHAT_AUTH_TEST_MYSQL_USER_HOST:-}" == "127.0.0.1" || "${CHAT_AUTH_TEST_MYSQL_USER_HOST:-}" == "%" ]] || fail "isolated SQL fixture user host not allowed"

[[ "$(go version)" =~ ^go[[:space:]]version[[:space:]]go1\.27\.3[[:space:]] ]] || fail "requires exact Go 1.27.3"
[[ "$("$CHAT_AUTH_TEST_PHP" -r 'echo PHP_VERSION;')" == "8.3.36" ]] || fail "requires exact PHP 8.3.36"

# Root privileges are restricted to ephemeral, randomly named test databases.
# Never interpolate the database address into SQL; parse its numeric port.
mysql_port="${CHAT_INTEGRATION_MYSQL_ADDR##*:}"
CHAT_S09_FIXTURE_PORT="$mysql_port" "$CHAT_AUTH_TEST_PHP" -r '
  $port = (int) getenv("CHAT_S09_FIXTURE_PORT");
  $db = new PDO("mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=".$port.";charset=utf8mb4",
                "root", (string)getenv("CHAT_INTEGRATION_ADMIN_PASSWORD"),
                [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE=>PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]);
  $version = (string)$db->query("SELECT VERSION()")->fetchColumn();
  if (!preg_match("/^5\\.7\\.44(?:[-.].*)?$/D", $version)) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "CHAT_S09_VERIFY_BLOCKED: exact MySQL 5.7.44 required\n");
    exit(1);
  }
  echo "Isolated MySQL 5.7.44 verified\n";
'

echo 'S09: PHP contracts, upgrade checks and ephemeral MySQL fixtures'
"$CHAT_AUTH_TEST_PHP" server/tests/chat_schema_contract.php
"$CHAT_AUTH_TEST_PHP" server/tests/chat_identity_contract.php
"$CHAT_AUTH_TEST_PHP" server/tests/chat_policy_contract.php
"$CHAT_AUTH_TEST_PHP" server/tests/chat_text_security_contract.php

echo 'S09: Go module integrity, vet, compile and race-tested integration'
(
  cd chat
  export GOTOOLCHAIN=local
  go mod verify
  go vet ./...
  bash build.sh
  go test -race -count=1 ./...
)
echo 'CHAT_S09_ACCEPTANCE_PASSED (only for the exact checked-out revision)'

-- V2.7.0：从已发布2.6.0升级的聊天整包；S01～S09共用一个未发布版本。
-- 不开启功能、不回填订单、不发送通知；DDL失败保持维护态，不自动整段重跑。

-- CHAT_SECTION identity
SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_admin_sessions` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '聊天后台会话ID',
  `admin_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '原后台管理员ID',
  `session_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '环境绑定的PHP Session摘要',
  `session_version` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '随机会话撤销版本',
  `authority_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '角色密码及scope快照摘要',
  `scopes_json` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '限权scope JSON数组',
  `expires_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '最晚凭证到期时间UTC',
  `revoked_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原Session登出或撤销时间UTC',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '创建时间UTC',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_admin_session_hash` (`session_hash`),
  KEY `idx_chat_admin_actor_expiry` (`admin_id`,`expires_at`),
  KEY `idx_chat_admin_expiry` (`expires_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_chat_admin_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`admin_id`) REFERENCES `admin_users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='PHP后台聊天凭证会话，Go只读';

-- 同步撤销所有PHP账号写入口（含SQL维护）；不向Go授予后台密码表读取权限。
-- 单语句trigger，无DELIMITER/BEGIN语法；原账号修改与撤销属于同一MySQL事务。
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_admin_identity_revoke`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_admin_identity_revoke` AFTER UPDATE ON `admin_users`
FOR EACH ROW UPDATE `chat_admin_sessions`
SET `revoked_at`=COALESCE(`revoked_at`,UTC_TIMESTAMP())
WHERE `admin_id`=NEW.id AND `revoked_at` IS NULL
  AND (NOT (OLD.role <=> NEW.role) OR NOT (OLD.status <=> NEW.status)
       OR NOT (OLD.password_hash <=> NEW.password_hash)
       OR NOT (OLD.must_change_password <=> NEW.must_change_password));
-- CHAT_END identity

-- CHAT_SECTION policy
SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_policy_guards` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '栅栏ID',
  `scope_key` varchar(96) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '订单与不可变指派代次',
  `order_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '订单ID',
  `assignment_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '不可变指派ID',
  `policy_version` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '同scope单调权限版本',
  `state` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'open可发或readonly只读',
  `active_order_id` bigint(20) unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS (IF(`state`='open',`order_id`,NULL)) STORED COMMENT '同订单仅一个可发scope',
  `snapshot_json` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'PHP权威身份与授权区间快照',
  `snapshot_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '无版本快照指纹用于幂等',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '更新时间UTC',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_policy_scope` (`scope_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_policy_active_order` (`active_order_id`),
  KEY `idx_chat_policy_order` (`order_id`,`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='PHP单写订单聊天权限栅栏，Go只读和取共享锁';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_business_events` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '扫描定位ID，不等于已提交水位',
  `event_id` char(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '随机稳定业务事件ID',
  `aggregate_key` varchar(96) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '会话作用域',
  `aggregate_version` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '该scope权限版本',
  `schema_version` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '事件协议版本',
  `event_type` varchar(48) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '事件类型',
  `payload_json` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '版本化完整授权快照',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '提交时间UTC',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_business_event` (`event_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_business_scope_version` (`aggregate_key`,`aggregate_version`),
  KEY `idx_chat_business_created` (`created_at`,`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='PHP订单事务事件，Go不修改消费状态';
-- CHAT_END policy

-- CHAT_SECTION repair
SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_repair_episodes` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '不可变售后受理代次',
  `order_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '订单ID',
  `assignment_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '受理时不可变指派ID',
  `after_sale_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '售后申请ID',
  `worker_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '明确受理的师傅ID',
  `accepted_user_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '师傅对应真实小程序用户ID',
  `state` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'active或closed，closed不复活',
  `active_order_id` bigint(20) unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS (IF(`state`='active',`order_id`,NULL)) STORED COMMENT '同订单仅一个有效受理区间',
  `accepted_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '原受理事务内UTC时间',
  `closed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '结束UTC时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_repair_active_order` (`active_order_id`),
  KEY `idx_chat_repair_request` (`order_id`,`after_sale_id`,`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='PHP单写售后明确受理事实，不从processing或事件文字推断授权';
-- CHAT_END repair

-- CHAT_SECTION staff
SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 修复历史新装基线遗漏的平台专属表；已有升级库保持原表及资金数据。
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `order_platform_terms` (
  `order_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '订单ID',
  `customer_flow_mode` varchar(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'platform_managed' COMMENT '客户参与方式：platform_managed平台托管、miniapp_booking小程序预约',
  `customer_pricing_mode` varchar(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fixed_total' COMMENT '客户计价方式：fixed_total固定总价、itemized明细计价',
  `customer_contract_total_cents` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '客户当前最终成交金额（分）',
  `worker_settlement_mode` varchar(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'worker_collect' COMMENT '师傅工费结算：worker_collect师傅代收、platform_balance平台余额',
  `worker_labor_cents` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '当前最终师傅工费（分）',
  `extra_income_rate_bp_snapshot` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '2000' COMMENT '订单外加项平台收入比例快照（万分比）',
  `booking_paid_cents` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '最终结算时平台已收预约费快照（分）',
  `customer_tail_cents` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '客户现场剩余应付（分）',
  `platform_receivable_cents` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '平台收入款待收金额（分）',
  `worker_balance_credit_cents` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '应进入师傅余额金额（分）',
  `worker_balance_freeze_days_snapshot` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '师傅余额冻结天数快照',
  `settlement_status` varchar(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT '平台承接单结算状态',
  `settled_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '结算完成时间',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '更新时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`),
  KEY `idx_platform_terms_settlement` (`settlement_status`,`updated_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_platform_terms_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='V2.5.0 平台承接单专属计价与结算条件';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `order_pricing_items` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '自增ID',
  `order_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '订单ID',

  `status` varchar(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' COMMENT '状态',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '创建时间',

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

-- 单语句触发器，覆盖Web/小程序/CLI/SQL维护，且回滚与原身份写入一致。
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_staff_settings_insert`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_staff_settings_insert` AFTER INSERT ON `system_settings`
FOR EACH ROW UPDATE chat_staff_authority_versions SET authority_version=authority_version+1
WHERE user_id=0 AND NEW.setting_key IN ('wechat.admin_openids','wechat.miniapp_appid');
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_staff_settings_update`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_staff_settings_update` AFTER UPDATE ON `system_settings`
FOR EACH ROW UPDATE chat_staff_authority_versions SET authority_version=authority_version+1
WHERE user_id=0 AND (OLD.setting_key IN ('wechat.admin_openids','wechat.miniapp_appid') OR NEW.setting_key IN ('wechat.admin_openids','wechat.miniapp_appid'))
AND (NOT (BINARY OLD.setting_key <=> BINARY NEW.setting_key) OR NOT (BINARY OLD.setting_value <=> BINARY NEW.setting_value) OR NOT (BINARY OLD.value_type <=> BINARY NEW.value_type));
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_staff_settings_delete`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_staff_settings_delete` AFTER DELETE ON `system_settings`
FOR EACH ROW UPDATE chat_staff_authority_versions SET authority_version=authority_version+1
WHERE user_id=0 AND OLD.setting_key IN ('wechat.admin_openids','wechat.miniapp_appid');
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_staff_user_insert`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_staff_user_insert` AFTER INSERT ON `users`
FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO chat_staff_authority_versions(user_id,authority_version) VALUES(NEW.id,1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE authority_version=authority_version+1;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_staff_user_update`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_staff_user_update` AFTER UPDATE ON `users`
FOR EACH ROW UPDATE chat_staff_authority_versions SET authority_version=authority_version+1
WHERE user_id IN (OLD.id,NEW.id) AND (NOT (OLD.id <=> NEW.id) OR NOT (OLD.status <=> NEW.status));
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_staff_user_delete`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_staff_user_delete` AFTER DELETE ON `users`
FOR EACH ROW UPDATE chat_staff_authority_versions SET authority_version=authority_version+1 WHERE user_id=OLD.id;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_staff_wechat_insert`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_staff_wechat_insert` AFTER INSERT ON `wechat_identities`
FOR EACH ROW UPDATE chat_staff_authority_versions SET authority_version=authority_version+1 WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_staff_wechat_update`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_staff_wechat_update` AFTER UPDATE ON `wechat_identities`
FOR EACH ROW UPDATE chat_staff_authority_versions SET authority_version=authority_version+1
WHERE user_id IN (OLD.user_id,NEW.user_id)
AND (NOT (OLD.user_id <=> NEW.user_id) OR NOT (OLD.app_id <=> NEW.app_id) OR NOT (OLD.openid <=> NEW.openid) OR NOT (OLD.status <=> NEW.status));
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS `chat_staff_wechat_delete`;
CREATE TRIGGER `chat_staff_wechat_delete` AFTER DELETE ON `wechat_identities`
FOR EACH ROW UPDATE chat_staff_authority_versions SET authority_version=authority_version+1 WHERE user_id=OLD.user_id;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_conversations` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '独立会话ID，不等于订单ID',
  `conversation_type` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '当前仅order',
  `scope_key` varchar(96) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'PHP提供的不可变订单指派作用域',
  `order_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '可信订单绑定，不直接授予权限',
  `assignment_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '不可变指派绑定',
  `policy_version` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '已连续应用的PHP权限版本',
  `snapshot_hash` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '已应用快照指纹',
  `episode_key` varchar(96) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'PHP授权业务区间代次',
  `state` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'open或readonly；pending仅事务内',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '建立时间UTC',
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '投影更新时间UTC，不是消息活跃时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_conversation_scope` (`conversation_type`,`scope_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_conversation_binding` (`conversation_type`,`order_id`,`assignment_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Go单写独立会话与可信业务绑定';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_members` (
  `conversation_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '所属会话ID',
  `actor_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '真实用户ID，当前仅小程序身份',
  `actor_kind` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '当前仅mini，不接受后台审计成员',
  `role` varchar(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'customer/worker/platform_staff',
  `member_key` varchar(240) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '包含episode和工作人员配置/用户代次',
  `can_read` tinyint(1) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近应用快照的读取资格，仍需当前栅栏交集',
  `can_send` tinyint(1) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近应用快照的发送资格，仍需当前栅栏交集',
  PRIMARY KEY (`conversation_id`,`actor_id`),
  KEY `idx_chat_member_actor` (`actor_id`,`can_read`,`conversation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_chat_member_conversation` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `chat_conversations` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Go单写当前成员投影，不复制用户账号';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_member_intervals` (
  `conversation_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '所属会话ID',
  `actor_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '真实用户ID',
  `member_key` varchar(240) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '不可变授权身份代次',
  `start_version` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '可读消息权限版本下界，包含',
  `end_version` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '可读消息权限版本上界，不包含；空表示尚未闭合',
  `open_actor_id` bigint(20) unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS (IF(`end_version` IS NULL,`actor_id`,NULL)) STORED COMMENT '每会话每人最多一个未闭合区间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`conversation_id`,`actor_id`,`start_version`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_interval_open` (`conversation_id`,`open_actor_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_chat_interval_conversation` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `chat_conversations` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Go单写历史授权版本区间，禁止用处理时seq补权';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_event_receipts` (
  `event_id` char(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'PHP原始不可变事件ID',
  `aggregate_key` varchar(96) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '原始会话作用域',
  `aggregate_version` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '原始PHP权限版本',
  `payload_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '领取时原始事件指纹',
  `status` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'processing/retry/done/rejected',
  `attempts` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '领取次数，有界递增',
  `lease_owner` char(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '每次领取随机独立所有者',
  `lease_until` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '服务端租约截止UTC',
  `next_attempt_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '失败退避后可重试时间UTC',
  `error_code` varchar(48) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '稳定诊断码，不存正文或SQL',
  `completed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '与会话投影同事务完成UTC',
  PRIMARY KEY (`event_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chat_receipt_scope_version` (`aggregate_key`,`aggregate_version`),
  KEY `idx_chat_receipt_retry` (`status`,`next_attempt_at`),
  KEY `idx_chat_receipt_lease` (`status`,`lease_until`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Go单写消费回执/租约，PHP事件表只读';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_send_intents` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '服务端发送意图ID',
  `sender_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '真实mini发送者ID',
  `conversation_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '授权会话ID',
  `client_message_id` varchar(43) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '10位Unix秒点32位小写hex随机数，不随重试变化',
  `fingerprint` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '版本化完整正文结构SHA256，不存被拒绝正文',
  `state` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'checking/retryable/rejected/accepted',
  `error_code` varchar(48) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '安全稳定诊断码，无规则证据',
  `message_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '已提交正式消息ID，拒绝为空',
  `lease_owner` char(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当前检查随机所有者，旧所有者不能发布',
  `lease_until` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '10秒有界审核所有权截止UTC',
  `attempts` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '最多8次检查尝试，耗尽不自动换ID补发',
  `action_expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'ID创建秒加24小时，发布前再次校验',

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Go单写发送意图与最小幂等结果，审核中不占消息seq';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chat_messages` (

  `conversation_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '所属会话ID',

  `state_version` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '安全状态单调版本',
  `safety_rule_version` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '通过必需审核的版本',

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Chat\OrderConversationPolicy;

/** Called inside the owning order transaction; never opens an independent transaction. */
final class DatabaseOrderConversationBridge
{
    private Database $db;
    private OrderConversationPolicy $policy;
    private bool $enabled;
    public function __construct(Database $db, bool $enabled=false)
    { $this->db=$db;$this->enabled=$enabled;$this->policy=new OrderConversationPolicy(); }

    /** Coalesce every event for this order until the original transaction's final facts exist. */
    public function schedule(int $orderID): void
    {
        if (!$this->enabled) return;
        if ($orderID<1) throw new RuntimeException('聊天授权订单编号无效');
        $this->db->beforeCommit('chat-policy:'.$orderID,function()use($orderID):void{$this->synchronize($orderID);});
    }

    /** @return string[] changed scope keys; no messages/Go tables/notifications are written. */
    public function synchronize(int $orderID,bool $apply=true): array
    {
        if ($apply && !$this->enabled) return [];
        if ($orderID<1 || !$this->db->pdo()->inTransaction()) throw new RuntimeException('聊天授权必须加入原订单事务');
        // Lock order first, then current authority reads, then the guard. Plain
        // reads could reuse an earlier REPEATABLE READ snapshot and grant stale accounts.
        $order=$this->db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE',['id'=>$orderID]);
        if (!$order) throw new RuntimeException('聊天授权订单不存在');
        $assignment=$this->db->fetch(
            'SELECT a.*,CAST(w.user_id AS CHAR) worker_user_id,u.status worker_user_status
             FROM assignments a JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.id=a.worker_id
             JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id WHERE a.id=:id AND a.order_id=:order_id LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE',
            ['id'=>$order['current_assignment_id'] ?? 0,'order_id'=>$orderID]
        );
        $customer=$this->db->fetch('SELECT status FROM users WHERE id=:id LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE',['id'=>$order['user_id']]);
        $facts=[
            'order_id'=>(string)$orderID,'customer_id'=>(string)$order['user_id'],
            'customer_status'=>(string)($customer['status'] ?? ''),'is_demo'=>(int)$order['is_demo'],
            'workflow_profile'=>(string)$order['workflow_profile'],'order_source_type'=>(string)$order['order_source_type'],
            'lifecycle_status'=>(string)$order['lifecycle_status'],'payment_status'=>(string)$order['payment_status'],
            'assignment_status'=>(string)$order['assignment_status'],
            'current_assignment_id'=>(string)($order['current_assignment_id'] ?? ''),
            'assigned_worker_id'=>(string)($order['assigned_worker_id'] ?? ''),
            'assignment_id'=>(string)($assignment['id'] ?? ''),'assignment_order_id'=>(string)($assignment['order_id'] ?? ''),
            'worker_id'=>(string)($assignment['worker_id'] ?? ''),'worker_user_id'=>(string)($assignment['worker_user_id'] ?? ''),
            'worker_user_status'=>(string)($assignment['worker_user_status'] ?? ''),
            'assignment_record_status'=>(string)($assignment['status'] ?? ''),'assignment_accepted_at'=>$assignment['accepted_at'] ?? null,
        ];
        if ($facts['order_source_type']==='platform') {
            $terms=$this->db->fetch('SELECT customer_flow_mode FROM order_platform_terms WHERE order_id=:id LOCK IN SHARE MODE',['id'=>$orderID]);
            $facts['customer_flow_mode']=(string)($terms['customer_flow_mode']??'');
            $facts['booking_fee_cents']=(int)($order['booking_fee_cents']??-1);
            $facts=array_merge($facts,(new DatabaseChatPlatformStaff($this->db))->readAuthorityLocked());
        }
        if($facts['lifecycle_status']==='completed' && $facts['workflow_profile']==='construction'
            && in_array($facts['order_source_type'],['consumer','merchant','platform'],true)) {
            $episode=$this->db->fetch(
                'SELECT e.*,a.order_id repair_order_id,a.user_id repair_user_id,a.type repair_type,
                    a.status repair_status,a.closed_at repair_closed_at
                 FROM chat_repair_episodes e JOIN after_sales a ON a.id=e.after_sale_id
                 WHERE e.active_order_id=:id LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE',['id'=>$orderID]
            );
            if($episode)$facts['repair_episode']=$episode;
        }
        $snapshot=$this->policy->evaluate($facts);
        // Bounded display facts travel with the same immutable PHP authority hash.
        $context=['public_no'=>(string)$order['public_no'],
            'title'=>mb_substr((string)preg_replace('/[\\p{Cc}\\p{Cf}]+/u',' ',(string)($order['title']??'')),0,120,'UTF-8'),
            'workflow'=>(string)$order['workflow_profile']];
        $open=$this->db->fetch('SELECT * FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE active_order_id=:id FOR UPDATE',['id'=>$orderID]);
        $changed=[];
        if ($open && (!$snapshot || $open['scope_key'] !== $snapshot['scope_key'])) {
            $closed=json_decode((string)$open['snapshot_json'],true,32,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $closed['state']='readonly';
            $closed['order_context']=$context;
            foreach ($closed['members'] as &$member) $member['can_send']=false;
            unset($member);
            if ($this->persist($closed,$open,$apply)) $changed[]=$closed['scope_key'];
        }
        if ($snapshot) {
            $existing=$this->db->fetch('SELECT * FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE scope_key=:scope FOR UPDATE',['scope'=>$snapshot['scope_key']]);
            $previous=$existing?json_decode((string)$existing['snapshot_json'],true,32,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR):null;
            // Never manufacture historical membership during a backfill/late event.
            if (!$existing && $snapshot['state']==='readonly') return $changed;
            // Keep the closing repair identity, rather than silently replacing it
            // with the old service episode. S05 needs that precise boundary.
            if($previous && $snapshot['state']==='readonly') {
                $snapshot=$previous;$snapshot['state']='readonly';
                foreach($snapshot['members'] as &$member)$member['can_send']=false;unset($member);
            }
            // Only an explicit, different accepted repair generation can reopen.
            if ($existing && $existing['state']==='readonly' && $snapshot['state']==='open') {
                $newRepair=isset($facts['repair_episode']) && $snapshot['episode_key']!==$previous['episode_key'];
                if(!$newRepair){$snapshot=$previous;$snapshot['state']='readonly';foreach ($snapshot['members'] as &$member)$member['can_send']=false;unset($member);}
            }
            $snapshot['order_context']=$context;
            if ($this->persist($snapshot,$existing,$apply)) $changed[]=$snapshot['scope_key'];
        }
        if($apply && $facts['order_source_type']==='platform') {
            $this->db->execute("INSERT INTO chat_policy_refresh(order_id,checked_at,next_check_at,status)
                VALUES(:id,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 60 SECOND,'success')
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checked_at=VALUES(checked_at),next_check_at=VALUES(next_check_at),status='success'",['id'=>$orderID]);
        }
        return $changed;
    }

    private function persist(array $snapshot, ?array $existing,bool $apply): bool
    {
        $json=json_encode($snapshot,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if (strlen($json)>16384) throw new RuntimeException('聊天授权快照超过上限');
        $hash=hash('sha256',$json);
        if ($existing && hash_equals((string)$existing['snapshot_hash'],$hash)) return false;
        if (!$apply) return true;
        $params=['scope'=>$snapshot['scope_key'],'order_id'=>$snapshot['order_id'],'assignment_id'=>$snapshot['assignment_id'],
            'state'=>$snapshot['state'],'json'=>$json,'hash'=>$hash];
        if (!$existing) {
            $this->db->execute('INSERT INTO chat_policy_guards(scope_key,order_id,assignment_id,policy_version,state,snapshot_json,snapshot_hash,updated_at)
                VALUES(:scope,:order_id,:assignment_id,1,:state,:json,:hash,UTC_TIMESTAMP())',$params);
        } else {
            unset($params['order_id'],$params['assignment_id']);$params['expected']=(string)$existing['policy_version'];
            $count=$this->db->execute('UPDATE chat_policy_guards SET state=:state,snapshot_json=:json,snapshot_hash=:hash,policy_version=policy_version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                WHERE scope_key=:scope AND policy_version=:expected',$params);
            if ($count!==1) throw new RuntimeException('聊天授权版本已变化');
        }
        $version=(string)$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT CAST(policy_version AS CHAR) FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE scope_key=:scope',['scope'=>$snapshot['scope_key']]);
        $payload=json_encode(['schema_version'=>1,'policy_version'=>$version,'snapshot'=>$snapshot],JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        $this->db->execute("INSERT INTO chat_business_events(event_id,aggregate_key,aggregate_version,schema_version,event_type,payload_json,created_at)
            VALUES(:event_id,:scope,:version,1,'chat.policy.changed',:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            ['event_id'=>bin2hex(random_bytes(16)),'scope'=>$snapshot['scope_key'],'version'=>$version,'payload'=>$payload]);
        return true;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Application\Messaging;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\NotificationInboxRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\MessageOperationException;

final class NotificationInbox
{
    private NotificationInboxRepository $repository;
    public function __construct(NotificationInboxRepository $repository) { $this->repository = $repository; }
    public function summary(array $actor): array { return $this->repository->summary($actor); }
    public function list(array $actor, int $page): array { return $this->repository->list($actor, max(1, min(10000, $page))); }
    public function read(array $actor, string $id): void
    {
        $id = trim($id);
        if ($id === '') throw new MessageOperationException('请选择要查看的消息', 'NOTIFICATION_REQUIRED');
        $this->repository->read($actor, $id);
    }
    public function readBatch(array $actor, array $rawIds): array
    {
        if (count($rawIds) > 50) throw new MessageOperationException('单次最多标记 50 条消息', 'NOTIFICATION_BATCH_LIMIT');
        $ids = [];
        foreach ($rawIds as $value) {
            if (!is_scalar($value)) continue;
            $value = trim((string)$value);
            if ($value !== '' && !in_array($value, $ids, true)) $ids[] = $value;
        }
        if (!$ids) throw new MessageOperationException('请选择要查看的消息', 'NOTIFICATION_REQUIRED');
        return ['updated_count' => $this->repository->readBatch($actor, $ids)];
    }
    public function readAll(array $actor, string $throughId = ''): void
    {
        if (strlen($throughId)>80) throw new MessageOperationException('通知范围无效','NOTIFICATION_RANGE_INVALID');
        $this->repository->readAll($actor,trim($throughId));
    }
}

    {
        $workerId = !empty($actor['worker_id']) ? (int) $actor['worker_id'] : 0;
        // One bounded projection for the normal-notification conversation; never load bodies.
        $latest = $this->db->fetch("SELECT n.public_id,n.title,n.created_at FROM notifications n WHERE n.channel='in_app' AND ((n.recipient_type='user' AND n.recipient_id=:user_id) OR (n.recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND n.recipient_id=:worker_id)) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT 1", [
            'user_id' => (int) $actor['user_id'], 'worker_enabled' => $workerId, 'worker_id' => $workerId,
        ]);
        $unreadCount = (int) $this->db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n WHERE n.channel='in_app' AND n.read_at IS NULL AND ((n.recipient_type='user' AND n.recipient_id=:user_id) OR (n.recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND n.recipient_id=:worker_id))", [
            'user_id' => (int) $actor['user_id'], 'worker_enabled' => $workerId, 'worker_id' => $workerId,
        ]);

        $userWhere = "o.user_id=:user_id AND o.lifecycle_status='active' AND o.refund_status NOT IN ('pending_review','approved','processing','refunding') AND (o.audit_status='supplement_required' OR (o.audit_status='draft' AND o.payment_status='awaiting_payment') OR (o.fulfillment_status='submitted' AND o.dispute_status NOT IN ('open','processing')) OR (o.audit_status='approved' AND o.selected_quote_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quotes q WHERE q.order_id=o.id AND q.status='active')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM change_requests c WHERE c.order_id=o.id AND (c.status='pending' OR (c.status='accepted' AND c.payment_status='awaiting_payment'))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_empty_fee_claims rc WHERE rc.order_id=o.id AND rc.status IN ('pending_confirmation','awaiting_payment')))";
        $userParams = ['user_id' => (int) $actor['user_id']];
        $userTodoCount = (int) $this->db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE ' . $userWhere, $userParams);
        $userTop = $this->db->fetch("SELECT o.public_no,o.audit_status,o.payment_status,o.fulfillment_status,(SELECT c.public_id FROM change_requests c WHERE c.order_id=o.id AND (c.status='pending' OR (c.status='accepted' AND c.payment_status='awaiting_payment')) ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1) pending_change_id,(SELECT rc.status FROM run_empty_fee_claims rc WHERE rc.order_id=o.id AND rc.status IN ('pending_confirmation','awaiting_payment') ORDER BY rc.id DESC LIMIT 1) pending_run_empty_status,CASE WHEN o.audit_status='draft' AND o.payment_status='awaiting_payment' THEN 95 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_empty_fee_claims rp WHERE rp.order_id=o.id AND rp.status='awaiting_payment') THEN 95 WHEN o.audit_status='supplement_required' THEN 85 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM change_requests cp WHERE cp.order_id=o.id AND (cp.status='pending' OR (cp.status='accepted' AND cp.payment_status='awaiting_payment'))) THEN 80 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_empty_fee_claims rc2 WHERE rc2.order_id=o.id AND rc2.status='pending_confirmation') THEN 80 WHEN o.fulfillment_status='submitted' THEN 75 ELSE 70 END todo_priority FROM orders o WHERE " . $userWhere . " ORDER BY todo_priority DESC,o.updated_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT 1", $userParams);
        $userTodo = null;
        if ($userTop) {
            if ($userTop['audit_status'] === 'supplement_required') $action = '补充订单资料';
            elseif ($userTop['audit_status'] === 'draft' && $userTop['payment_status'] === 'awaiting_payment') $action = '支付预约费';
            elseif (!empty($userTop['pending_change_id'])) $action = '处理费用调整';
            elseif (($userTop['pending_run_empty_status'] ?? '') === 'pending_confirmation') $action = '确认跑空费';
            elseif (($userTop['pending_run_empty_status'] ?? '') === 'awaiting_payment') $action = '支付跑空费';
            elseif ($userTop['fulfillment_status'] === 'submitted') $action = '确认完工';
            else $action = '选择报价';
            $userTodo = ['order_id' => (string) $userTop['public_no'], 'action' => $action, 'role' => '我的下单', 'detail_page' => 'user', 'priority' => (int) $userTop['todo_priority']];
        }

        $workerTodoCount = 0;
        $workerTodo = null;
        if ($workerId > 0) {
            $workerWhere = "o.refund_status NOT IN ('pending_review','approved','processing','refunding') AND (((o.lifecycle_status='active') AND o.current_assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments atodo WHERE atodo.id=o.current_assignment_id AND atodo.worker_id=:todo_worker_id AND atodo.status='offered')) OR (o.assigned_worker_id=:todo_repair_worker_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM after_sales astodo WHERE astodo.order_id=o.id AND astodo.type='warranty_repair' AND (astodo.status='open' OR (astodo.status='processing' AND (astodo.resolution IS NULL OR (astodo.resolution NOT LIKE '师傅拒绝维修%' AND astodo.resolution NOT LIKE '用户申请平台介入%')))))))";
            $workerParams = ['todo_worker_id' => $workerId, 'todo_repair_worker_id' => $workerId];
            $workerTodoCount = (int) $this->db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE ' . $workerWhere, $workerParams);
            $workerTop = $this->db->fetch("SELECT o.public_no,o.assignment_status,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM after_sales ast WHERE ast.order_id=o.id AND ast.type='warranty_repair' AND (ast.status='open' OR (ast.status='processing' AND (ast.resolution IS NULL OR (ast.resolution NOT LIKE '师傅拒绝维修%' AND ast.resolution NOT LIKE '用户申请平台介入%'))))) pending_repair_count FROM orders o WHERE " . $workerWhere . " ORDER BY pending_repair_count DESC,o.updated_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT 1", $workerParams);
            if ($workerTop) {
                $repair = (int) ($workerTop['pending_repair_count'] ?? 0) > 0;
                $workerTodo = ['order_id' => (string) $workerTop['public_no'], 'action' => $repair ? '处理待维修' : '确认接单', 'role' => '我的接单', 'detail_page' => 'worker', 'priority' => $repair ? 100 : 90];
            }
        }

        $topTodo = $userTodo;
        if ($workerTodo && (!$topTodo || (int) $workerTodo['priority'] > (int) $topTodo['priority'])) $topTodo = $workerTodo;
        return [
            'unread_count' => $unreadCount,
            'todo_count' => $userTodoCount + $workerTodoCount,
            'user_todo_count' => $userTodoCount,
            'worker_todo_count' => $workerTodoCount,
            'top_todo' => $topTodo,
            'latest_notification' => $latest ? [
                'id' => (string) $latest['public_id'],
                'title' => (string) $latest['title'],
                'created_at' => (new DateTimeImmutable((string) $latest['created_at'], new DateTimeZone('UTC')))->format(DATE_ATOM),
            ] : null,
        ];

    }

    public function list(array $actor, int $page): array
    {
        $limit = 20;
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $limit;
        $workerId = !empty($actor['worker_id']) ? (int) $actor['worker_id'] : 0;
        $where = "n.channel='in_app' AND ( (n.recipient_type='user' AND n.recipient_id=:user_id) OR (n.recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND n.recipient_id=:worker_id) )";
        $params = ['user_id' => (int) $actor['user_id'], 'worker_enabled' => $workerId, 'worker_id' => $workerId];
        $unreadCount = (int) $this->db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n WHERE ' . $where . ' AND n.read_at IS NULL', $params);
        $rows = $this->db->fetchAll('SELECT n.public_id,n.recipient_type,n.template_key,n.title,n.content,n.data_json,n.read_at,n.created_at FROM notifications n WHERE ' . $where . ' ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT ' . ($limit + 1) . ' OFFSET ' . $offset, $params);
        $hasMore = count($rows) > $limit;
        $rows = array_slice($rows, 0, $limit);
        // V2.2.3：先解析本页关联订单，再一次性批量取订单号，避免每条通知额外执行一次 SQL。
        $preparedRows = []; $orderIds = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $data = (json_decode((string)($row['data_json'] ?? ''), true) ?: []);
            $orderId = is_array($data) ? (int) ($data['order_id'] ?? 0) : 0;
            if ($orderId > 0) $orderIds[$orderId] = true;
            $preparedRows[] = ['row' => $row, 'order_id' => $orderId];
        }
        $orderNoById = [];
        if ($orderIds) {
            $safeIds = array_map('intval', array_keys($orderIds));
            foreach ($this->db->fetchAll('SELECT id,public_no FROM orders WHERE id IN (' . implode(',', $safeIds) . ')') as $orderRow) {
                $orderNoById[(int) $orderRow['id']] = (string) $orderRow['public_no'];
            }
        }
        $items = [];
        foreach ($preparedRows as $prepared) {
            $row = $prepared['row']; $orderId = (int) $prepared['order_id'];
            $items[] = [
                'id' => (string) $row['public_id'], 'recipient_type' => (string) $row['recipient_type'],
                'template_key' => (string) $row['template_key'], 'title' => (string) $row['title'],
                'content' => (string) $row['content'], 'read' => !empty($row['read_at']),
                'created_at' => $this->localTime($row['created_at']), 'order_id' => $orderId,
                'order_no' => $orderNoById[$orderId] ?? '', 'detail_page' => $row['recipient_type'] === 'worker' ? 'worker' : 'user',
            ];
        }
        $throughId=(string)($this->db->fetchValue('SELECT n.public_id FROM notifications n WHERE '.$where.' ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1',$params)?:'');
        return ['items' => $items, 'page' => $page, 'has_more' => $hasMore, 'unread_count' => $unreadCount, 'read_through_id'=>$throughId];

    }

    public function read(array $actor, string $publicId): void
    {
        $workerId = !empty($actor['worker_id']) ? (int) $actor['worker_id'] : 0;
        $params = ['public_id' => $publicId, 'user_id' => (int) $actor['user_id'], 'worker_enabled' => $workerId, 'worker_id' => $workerId];
        $owned = $this->db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE public_id=:public_id AND channel='in_app' AND ((recipient_type='user' AND recipient_id=:user_id) OR (recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND recipient_id=:worker_id)) LIMIT 1", $params);
        if (!$owned) throw new MessageOperationException('消息不存在或不属于当前账号', 'NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND', 404);
        $this->db->execute("UPDATE notifications SET read_at=COALESCE(read_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()) WHERE id=:id", ['id' => (int) $owned]);

    }

    public function readBatch(array $actor, array $ids): int
    {
        $workerId = !empty($actor['worker_id']) ? (int) $actor['worker_id'] : 0;
        $marks = [];
        $params = ['user_id' => (int) $actor['user_id'], 'worker_enabled' => $workerId, 'worker_id' => $workerId];
        foreach ($ids as $index => $publicId) {
            $key = 'notification_' . $index;
            $marks[] = ':' . $key;
            $params[$key] = $publicId;
        }
        $changed = $this->db->execute("UPDATE notifications SET read_at=COALESCE(read_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()) WHERE public_id IN (" . implode(',', $marks) . ") AND channel='in_app' AND ((recipient_type='user' AND recipient_id=:user_id) OR (recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND recipient_id=:worker_id))", $params);
        return $changed;

    }

    public function readAll(array $actor, string $throughId = ''): void
    {
        $workerId=!empty($actor['worker_id'])?(int)$actor['worker_id']:0;
        $params=['user_id'=>(int)$actor['user_id'],'worker_enabled'=>$workerId,'worker_id'=>$workerId];
        $where="channel='in_app' AND ((recipient_type='user' AND recipient_id=:user_id) OR (recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND recipient_id=:worker_id))";
        if($throughId!==''){
            $cutoff=$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE '.$where.' AND public_id=:through_id LIMIT 1',$params+['through_id'=>$throughId]);
            if(!$cutoff)throw new MessageOperationException('通知范围已失效，请刷新后重试','NOTIFICATION_RANGE_INVALID',404);
        }else{
            // Old clients also receive a server-side cutoff before the UPDATE.
            $cutoff=$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM notifications WHERE '.$where,$params);
        }
        $this->db->execute('UPDATE notifications SET read_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE '.$where.' AND read_at IS NULL AND id<=:cutoff',$params+['cutoff'=>(int)$cutoff]);
    }

    private function localTime($value): ?string
    {
        if (!$value) return null;
        try {
            return (new DateTimeImmutable((string) $value, new DateTimeZone('UTC')))->setTimezone(new DateTimeZone((string) \app_config('app.timezone', 'Asia/Shanghai')))->format('Y-m-d H:i');
        } catch (Throwable $exception) { return (string) $value; }
    }

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace WorkerAdmin\Http\Api\Modules;
use RuntimeException;

use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
/** Subscription settings and the signed-in actor's notification inbox. */
final class MessagingApiModule implements ApiModule
{
    private const ROUTES = [
        'announcement.current'=>'GET',
        'subscriptions.status'=>'GET', 'subscriptions.diagnose'=>'GET', 'subscriptions.preference'=>'POST',
        'notifications.summary'=>'GET', 'notifications.list'=>'GET', 'notifications.read'=>'POST',
        'notifications.read_batch'=>'POST', 'notifications.read_all'=>'POST',
    ];
    private \WorkerAdmin\Application\Messaging\AnnouncementQuery $announcement;
    private ApiActorResolver $actors;
    private NotificationInbox $inbox;
    private SubscriptionPreferences $subscriptions;
    public function __construct(Database $db, ?ApiActorResolver $actors=null, ?NotificationInbox $inbox=null, ?SubscriptionPreferences $subscriptions=null)
    {
        $container = new MessagingApplicationContainer($db);
        $this->announcement=new \WorkerAdmin\Application\Messaging\AnnouncementQuery((new ApplicationContainer($db))->settings());
        $this->actors = $actors ?: (new ApplicationContainer($db))->apiActorResolver();
        $this->inbox = $inbox ?: $container->inbox();
        $this->subscriptions = $subscriptions ?: $container->subscriptions();
    }
    public function supports(string $route): bool { return isset(self::ROUTES[$route]); }
    public function requiresContentSecurity(string $route): bool { return false; }
    public function dispatch(string $route): void
    {
        if (!$this->supports($route)) { $this->fail('接口不存在', 'NOT_FOUND', 404); return; }
        $header = trim((string)($_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? ''));
        if ($header === '' && function_exists('getallheaders')) {
            $headers = getallheaders();
            $header = trim((string)($headers['Authorization'] ?? $headers['authorization'] ?? ''));
        }
        if (preg_match('/^Bearer\s+([A-Fa-f0-9]{64})$/', $header, $matches) !== 1) { $this->fail('请重新登录','UNAUTHORIZED',401); return; }
        try { $actor = $this->actors->resolve($matches[1]); }
        catch (RuntimeException $exception) {
            $status = in_array($exception->getCode(), [401,403,503], true) ? (int)$exception->getCode() : 401;
            $this->fail($exception->getMessage(), $status === 503 ? 'MINIAPP_APPID_MISSING' : 'UNAUTHORIZED', $status);
            return;
        }
        try {
            // The demo boundary precedes method/body validation, as in the old dispatch.
            if ($route === 'subscriptions.preference' && !empty($actor['is_demo_actor'])) {
                $this->subscriptions->save($actor, []);
            }
            if (strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET')) !== self::ROUTES[$route]) {
                $this->fail('请求方式不正确','METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',405); return;
            }
            $raw = self::ROUTES[$route] === 'POST' ? file_get_contents('php://input') : '';
            // Retain the legacy empty/malformed-body fallback for these existing endpoints.
            $body = json_decode(is_string($raw) ? $raw : '', true);
            $body = is_array($body) ? $body : [];
            if ($route === 'subscriptions.preference') { \json_response(['ok'=>true] + $this->subscriptions->save($actor, $body)); return; }
            if ($route === 'announcement.current') $data=$this->announcement->current((string)($_GET['scene']??''));
            elseif ($route === 'subscriptions.status') $data = $this->subscriptions->status($actor, (string)($_GET['include_application'] ?? '') === '1');
            elseif ($route === 'subscriptions.diagnose') $data = $this->subscriptions->diagnose($actor);
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.summary') $data = $this->inbox->summary($actor);
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.list') $data = $this->inbox->list($actor, (int)($_GET['page'] ?? 1));
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.read_batch') $data = $this->inbox->readBatch($actor, is_array($body['ids'] ?? null) ? $body['ids'] : []);
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.read') {
                $this->inbox->read($actor, (string)($body['id'] ?? ''));
                \json_response(['ok'=>true,'message'=>'已标记为已读']); return;
            } else {
                $this->inbox->readAll($actor, (string)($body['through_id'] ?? ''));
                \json_response(['ok'=>true,'message'=>'未读消息已清除']); return;
            }
            $result = ['ok'=>true,'data'=>$data];
            if ($route === 'notifications.read_batch') $result['message'] = '消息已标记为已读';
            \json_response($result);
        } catch (MessageOperationException $exception) {
            $this->fail($exception->getMessage(), $exception->apiCode(), (int)$exception->getCode());
        } catch (OrderOperationException $exception) {
            $this->fail($exception->getMessage(), $exception->apiCode(), (int)$exception->getCode());
        }
    }
    private function fail(string $message, string $code, int $status): void
    { \json_response(['ok'=>false,'code'=>$code,'message'=>$message,'request_id'=>\request_id()], $status); }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// Minimal policy/identity fixtures use named sections of the actual release
// package. The full 2.6.0 -> 2.7.0 path is separately tested against real schema.
function chatFixtureMigration(PDO $pdo, string $section): void
{
    if (getenv('CHAT_AUTH_TEST_INTEGRATION') !== '1'
        || !in_array($section,['identity','policy','repair','staff'],true)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Explicit isolated chat fixture required');
    }
    $sql=(string)file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__).'/database/upgrades/2.7.0.sql');
    $start='-- CHAT_SECTION '.$section."\n";$end='-- CHAT_END '.$section;
    $parts=explode($start,$sql);
    if(count($parts)!==2 || count(explode($end,$parts[1]))!==2)throw new RuntimeException('Chat migration section missing');
    (new \WorkerAdmin\Support\SqlScriptRunner())->run($pdo,explode($end,$parts[1])[0],'2.7.0.sql:'.$section);
}

<?php

namespace WorkerAdmin\Core;

use PDO;
use PDOException;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

class Database
{
    private $config;
    private $pdo;
    private $transactionDepth = 0;
    private $transactionRollbackOnly = false;
    private array $beforeCommitCallbacks = [];
    private bool $runningBeforeCommit = false;

    // 2026-08-14：统一 PDO 连接并强制真实预处理，兼容 MySQL 5.7.44。
    public function __construct(array $config)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
    }

    public function pdo()
    {
        if ($this->pdo instanceof PDO) {
            return $this->pdo;
        }
        if (!extension_loaded('pdo_mysql')) {
            throw new RuntimeException('服务器未安装 pdo_mysql 扩展。');
        }

        $host = isset($this->config['host']) ? $this->config['host'] : '127.0.0.1';
        $port = isset($this->config['port']) ? (int) $this->config['port'] : 3306;
        $database = isset($this->config['database']) ? $this->config['database'] : '';
        $charset = isset($this->config['charset']) ? $this->config['charset'] : 'utf8mb4';
        if ($database === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('数据库名称尚未配置。');
        }

        $dsn = sprintf('mysql:host=%s;port=%d;dbname=%s;charset=%s', $host, $port, $database, $charset);
        try {
            $this->pdo = new PDO($dsn, (string) $this->config['username'], (string) $this->config['password'], [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
                PDO::ATTR_STRINGIFY_FETCHES => false,
                PDO::ATTR_TIMEOUT => 5,
            ]);
            $this->pdo->exec("SET SESSION sql_mode='STRICT_TRANS_TABLES,ERROR_FOR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION'");
            $this->pdo->exec("SET time_zone='+00:00'");
        } catch (PDOException $exception) {
            throw new RuntimeException('数据库连接失败，请检查安装配置。', 0, $exception);
        }

        return $this->pdo;
    }

    /**
     * MySQL 原生预处理不允许在同一条 SQL 中重复使用同名占位符。
     * 这里仅展开重复命名参数，继续保持 ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES=false，避免各业务控制器重复踩坑。
     */
    private function prepareAndExecute($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        list($sql, $params) = $this->expandDuplicateNamedParameters((string) $sql, $params);
        $statement = $this->pdo()->prepare($sql);
        $statement->execute($params);
        return $statement;
    }

    private function expandDuplicateNamedParameters($sql, array $params)
    {
        if (!$params || strpos($sql, ':') === false) {
            return [$sql, $params];
        }

        $normalized = [];
        foreach ($params as $key => $value) {
            $normalized[ltrim((string) $key, ':')] = $value;
        }
        $seen = [];
        $expanded = [];
        $rewritten = preg_replace_callback('/(?<!:):([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\b/', function ($match) use (&$seen, &$expanded, $normalized) {
            $name = $match[1];
            if (!array_key_exists($name, $normalized)) {
                return $match[0];
            }
            $index = isset($seen[$name]) ? ++$seen[$name] : ($seen[$name] = 1);
            $target = $index === 1 ? $name : $name . '__dup' . $index;
            $expanded[$target] = $normalized[$name];
            return ':' . $target;
        }, $sql);

        // 保留未出现在 SQL 中的参数会触发 HY093；因此只传递实际匹配到的命名参数。
        // 本项目数据库层统一使用命名参数，若 SQL 没有匹配到占位符则沿用原参数以便显式暴露调用错误。
        return [$rewritten, $expanded ?: $params];
    }

    public function fetch($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        $statement = $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params);
        $row = $statement->fetch();
        return $row === false ? null : $row;
    }

    public function fetchAll($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        return $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params)->fetchAll();
    }

    public function fetchValue($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        return $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params)->fetchColumn();
    }

    public function execute($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        return $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params)->rowCount();
    }

    public function insert($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        $this->execute($sql, $params);
        return (int) $this->pdo()->lastInsertId();
    }

    /**
     * 共享连接的事务加入语义：只有最外层真正 begin/commit；内层 transaction 加入当前事务。
     * 任一内层回调抛错都会把整笔用例标记 rollback-only，即使上层业务误捕获异常，也禁止提交部分结果。
     */
    public function transaction(callable $callback)
    {
        $pdo = $this->pdo();
        $outermost = $this->transactionDepth === 0;

        if ($outermost) {
            $pdo->beginTransaction();
            $this->transactionRollbackOnly = false;
            $this->beforeCommitCallbacks = [];
        }
        $this->transactionDepth++;

        try {
            $result = $callback($this);

            if (!$outermost) {
                $this->transactionDepth--;
                return $result;
            }

            if ($this->transactionRollbackOnly) {
                throw new RuntimeException('事务已因内部失败标记为回滚，禁止提交部分业务结果。');
            }

            $this->runningBeforeCommit = true;
            ksort($this->beforeCommitCallbacks,SORT_STRING);
            foreach ($this->beforeCommitCallbacks as $beforeCommit) $beforeCommit($this);
            $this->runningBeforeCommit = false;
            if ($this->transactionRollbackOnly) throw new RuntimeException('事务已因内部失败标记为回滚，禁止提交部分业务结果。');
            $this->transactionDepth--;
            $pdo->commit();
            $this->resetTransactionState();
            return $result;
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            if ($this->transactionDepth > 0) {
                $this->transactionDepth--;
            }
            $this->transactionRollbackOnly = true;

            if ($outermost) {
                if ($pdo->inTransaction()) {
                    $pdo->rollBack();
                }
                $this->resetTransactionState();
            }
            throw $exception;
        }
    }

    /** Register bounded DML work after all outer/nested writes, before the same commit. */
    public function beforeCommit(string $key, callable $callback): void
    {
        if ($this->transactionDepth<1 || !$this->pdo()->inTransaction() || $this->runningBeforeCommit
            || $key==='' || strlen($key)>96 || (!isset($this->beforeCommitCallbacks[$key]) && count($this->beforeCommitCallbacks)>=128)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('预提交动作必须在原事务内登记且不得递归或超过上限');
        }
        $this->beforeCommitCallbacks[$key]=$callback;
    }

    private function resetTransactionState()
    {
        $this->transactionDepth = 0;
        $this->transactionRollbackOnly = false;
        $this->beforeCommitCallbacks = [];
        $this->runningBeforeCommit = false;
    }

    public function tableExists($table)
    {
        $count = $this->fetchValue(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = :table',
            ['table' => $table]
        );
        return (int) $count > 0;
    }

    public function columnExists($table, $column)
    {
        $count = $this->fetchValue(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = :table AND column_name = :column',
            ['table' => $table, 'column' => $column]
        );
        return (int) $count > 0;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Support;

use PDO;
use PDOStatement;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * 2026-08-14：无 Composer 环境下的 MySQL 脚本解析与执行器。
 */
final class SqlScriptRunner
{
    /**
     * 2026-08-14：读取并执行 SQL 文件，返回可记录到升级历史中的统计数据。
     *
     * @return array{file:string,checksum:string,statements:int,execution_ms:int}
     */
    public function runFile(PDO $pdo, string $file): array
    {
        $realFile = realpath($file);
        if ($realFile === false || !is_file($realFile) || !is_readable($realFile)) {
            throw new SqlScriptException('SQL 文件不存在或不可读。');
        }

        $sql = file_get_contents($realFile);
        if ($sql === false) {
            throw new SqlScriptException('SQL 文件读取失败。');
        }

        $rawChecksum = hash('sha256', $sql);
        $result = $this->run($pdo, $sql, $realFile);
        $result['checksum'] = $rawChecksum;
        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * 2026-08-14：执行 SQL 文本；单条失败时给出序号和安全摘要，避免泄露连接信息。
     *
     * @return array{file:string,checksum:string,statements:int,execution_ms:int}
     */
    public function run(PDO $pdo, string $sql, string $sourceName = 'inline.sql'): array
    {
        $sql = $this->removeUtf8Bom($sql);
        if (trim($sql) === '') {
            throw new SqlScriptException('SQL 脚本内容为空。');
        }

        $startedAt = microtime(true);
        $statements = $this->splitStatements($sql);
        $executed = 0;

        foreach ($statements as $index => $statement) {
            if (trim($statement) === '' || !$this->hasExecutableSql($statement)) {
                continue;
            }

            try {
                $this->executeStatement($pdo, $statement);
                ++$executed;
            } catch (Throwable $exception) {
                $number = $index + 1;
                $summary = $this->statementSummary($statement);
                throw new SqlScriptException(
                    sprintf('SQL 第 %d 条执行失败（%s）：%s', $number, $summary, $exception->getMessage()),
                    0,
                    $exception
                );
            }
        }

        return [
            'file' => $sourceName,
            'checksum' => hash('sha256', $sql),
            'statements' => $executed,
            'execution_ms' => (int) round((microtime(true) - $startedAt) * 1000),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * 2026-08-14：按 MySQL 语法状态拆分语句，兼容字符串、注释及 DELIMITER 指令。
     *
     * @return string[]
     */
    public function splitStatements(string $sql): array
    {
        $length = strlen($sql);
        $delimiter = ';';
        $buffer = '';
        $statements = [];
        $quote = null;
        $lineComment = false;
        $blockComment = false;
        $lineStart = true;

        for ($position = 0; $position < $length; ++$position) {
            $character = $sql[$position];
            $next = $position + 1 < $length ? $sql[$position + 1] : '';

            if ($lineComment) {
                $buffer .= $character;
                if ($character === "\n") {
                    $lineComment = false;
                    $lineStart = true;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if ($blockComment) {
                $buffer .= $character;
                if ($character === '*' && $next === '/') {
                    $buffer .= '/';
                    ++$position;
                    $blockComment = false;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if ($quote !== null) {
                $buffer .= $character;
                if ($character === '\\' && $quote !== '`' && $next !== '') {
                    $buffer .= $next;
                    ++$position;
                    continue;
                }
                if ($character === $quote) {
                    if ($next === $quote) {
                        $buffer .= $next;
                        ++$position;
                    } else {
                        $quote = null;
                    }
                }
                $lineStart = $character === "\n";
                continue;
            }

            if ($lineStart) {
                $remaining = substr($sql, $position);
                if (preg_match('/^[ \t]*DELIMITER[ \t]+([^\r\n]+)[\r\n]*/i', $remaining, $match) === 1) {
                    $newDelimiter = trim($match[1]);
                    if ($newDelimiter === '') {
                        throw new SqlScriptException('DELIMITER 指令缺少分隔符。');
                    }
                    $delimiter = $newDelimiter;
                    $position += strlen($match[0]) - 1;
                    $lineStart = true;
                    continue;
                }
            }

            if ($character === '-' && $next === '-' && $this->isDashComment($sql, $position)) {
                $buffer .= '--';
                ++$position;
                $lineComment = true;
                $lineStart = false;
                continue;
            }

            if ($character === '#') {
                $buffer .= $character;
                $lineComment = true;
                $lineStart = false;
                continue;
            }

            if ($character === '/' && $next === '*') {
                $buffer .= '/*';
                ++$position;
                $blockComment = true;
                $lineStart = false;
                continue;
            }

            if ($character === "'" || $character === '"' || $character === '`') {
                $quote = $character;
                $buffer .= $character;
                $lineStart = false;
                continue;
            }

            if ($delimiter !== '' && substr($sql, $position, strlen($delimiter)) === $delimiter) {
                if (trim($buffer) !== '') {
                    $statements[] = trim($buffer);
                }
                $buffer = '';
                $position += strlen($delimiter) - 1;
                $lineStart = false;
                continue;
            }

            $buffer .= $character;
            if ($character === "\n" || $character === "\r") {
                $lineStart = true;
            } elseif ($character !== ' ' && $character !== "\t") {
                $lineStart = false;
            }
        }

        if ($quote !== null) {
            throw new SqlScriptException('SQL 脚本包含未闭合的字符串或标识符。');
        }
        if ($blockComment) {
            throw new SqlScriptException('SQL 脚本包含未闭合的块注释。');
        }
        if (trim($buffer) !== '') {
            $statements[] = trim($buffer);
        }

        return $statements;
    }

    /**
     * 2026-08-14：MySQL 的双横线注释要求其后为空白或文件结束。
     */
    private function isDashComment(string $sql, int $position): bool
    {
        $after = $position + 2;
        return !isset($sql[$after]) || ctype_space($sql[$after]);
    }

    /**
     * 2026-09-24：可能返回结果集的语句统一使用 query，并完整消费全部 rowset。
     *
     * MySQL PREPARE/EXECUTE 的 EXECUTE 可能动态执行 SELECT；若错误地交给 PDO::exec()，
     * mysqlnd 会保留未消费结果，下一条语句即触发 SQLSTATE HY000/2014。
     */
    private function executeStatement(PDO $pdo, string $statement): void
    {
        $command = preg_replace('/\A(?:\s+|--[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|\z)|#[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|\z)|\/\*(?!\!)[\s\S]*?\*\/)*\s*/', '', $statement);
        $command = is_string($command) ? $command : $statement;
        if (preg_match('/^(SELECT|SHOW|DESCRIBE|DESC|EXPLAIN|CALL|EXECUTE)\b/i', $command) === 1) {
            $result = $pdo->query($statement);
            if ($result === false) {
                throw new SqlScriptException('SQL 查询执行失败且未返回 PDOStatement。');
            }
            $this->drainResultSets($result);
            return;
        }
        $pdo->exec($statement);
    }

    /**
     * 2026-09-24：消费当前结果集及后续全部 rowset，确保连接可安全执行下一条 SQL。
     */
    private function drainResultSets(PDOStatement $statement): void
    {
        try {
            do {
                if ($statement->columnCount() > 0) {
                    while ($statement->fetch(PDO::FETCH_NUM) !== false) {
                        // 升级脚本只关心执行成功与否；结果内容无需保留。
                    }
                }
            } while ($statement->nextRowset());
        } finally {
            $statement->closeCursor();
        }
    }

    /**
     * 2026-08-14：跳过文件末尾的纯说明注释，同时保留 MySQL 可执行版本注释。
     */
    private function hasExecutableSql(string $statement): bool
    {
        $withoutComments = preg_replace(
            '/--[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|\z)|#[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|\z)|\/\*(?!\!)[\s\S]*?\*\//',
            '',
            $statement
        );
        return is_string($withoutComments) && trim($withoutComments) !== '';
    }

    /**
     * 2026-08-14：去除 UTF-8 BOM，避免第一条语句无法识别。
     */
    private function removeUtf8Bom(string $sql): string
    {
        return substr($sql, 0, 3) === "\xEF\xBB\xBF" ? substr($sql, 3) : $sql;
    }

    /**
     * 2026-08-14：错误页面只显示一行有限长度摘要。
     */
    private function statementSummary(string $statement): string
    {
        $redacted = preg_replace('/\'(?:\\\\.|\'\'|[^\'])*\'/s', "'…'", $statement);
        $redacted = is_string($redacted) ? preg_replace('/"(?:\\\\.|""|[^"])*"/s', '"…"', $redacted) : $statement;
        $summary = preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', trim(is_string($redacted) ? $redacted : $statement));
        if (!is_string($summary)) {
            return '无法生成摘要';
        }
        if (function_exists('mb_substr')) {
            return mb_substr($summary, 0, 120, 'UTF-8');
        }
        return substr($summary, 0, 120);
    }
}

/**
 * 2026-08-14：为安装器和升级页提供可区分的脚本异常类型。
 */
final class SqlScriptException extends RuntimeException
{
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;

/** Called only after the owning PHP repair command has authorized its actor. */
final class DatabaseChatRepairEpisodes
{
    private Database $db;
    private bool $enabled;
    public function __construct(Database $db,bool $enabled=false){$this->db=$db;$this->enabled=$enabled;}

    /** Record the worker's explicit acceptance, never infer it from processing. */
    public function acceptWorker(int $orderId,int $afterSaleId,int $workerId): ?string
    {
        if(!$this->enabled)return null;
        $order=$this->lockOrder($orderId);
        // Unsupported order profiles retain their existing repair workflow.
        // They never gain a chat episode until their own S04 policy is defined.
        if((int)$order['is_demo']!==0 || (string)$order['workflow_profile']!=='construction'
            || !in_array((string)$order['order_source_type'],['consumer','merchant','platform'],true))return null;
        $assignment=$this->db->fetch(
            'SELECT a.*,w.user_id worker_user_id,u.status worker_user_status FROM assignments a
             JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.id=a.worker_id JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id
             WHERE a.id=:id AND a.order_id=:order_id FOR UPDATE',
            ['id'=>$order['current_assignment_id']??0,'order_id'=>$orderId]
        );
        $repair=$this->db->fetch('SELECT * FROM after_sales WHERE id=:id AND order_id=:order_id FOR UPDATE',['id'=>$afterSaleId,'order_id'=>$orderId]);
        $customer=$this->db->fetch('SELECT status FROM users WHERE id=:id LOCK IN SHARE MODE',['id'=>$order['user_id']]);
        $platform=(string)$order['order_source_type']==='platform';
        $terms=$platform?$this->db->fetch('SELECT customer_flow_mode FROM order_platform_terms WHERE order_id=:id LOCK IN SHARE MODE',['id'=>$orderId]):null;
        if((int)$order['is_demo']!==0 || (string)$order['lifecycle_status']!=='completed'
            || (string)$order['payment_status']!==($platform?'not_required':'paid') || (string)$order['workflow_profile']!=='construction'
            || ($platform && (($terms['customer_flow_mode']??'')!=='platform_managed' || (int)$order['booking_fee_cents']!==0))
            || !$assignment || (int)$assignment['worker_id']!==$workerId || (int)($order['assigned_worker_id']??0)!==$workerId
            || !in_array((string)$assignment['status'],['accepted','completed'],true) || empty($assignment['accepted_at'])
            || (string)$assignment['worker_user_status']!=='active'
            || !in_array($customer['status']??'', $platform?['active','platform_unbound']:['active'],true)
            || (string)$assignment['worker_user_id']===(string)$order['user_id']
            || !$repair || (string)$repair['type']!=='warranty_repair' || (string)$repair['status']!=='processing'
            || !empty($repair['closed_at']) || (string)$repair['user_id']!==(string)$order['user_id']) {
            throw new RuntimeException('售后聊天受理事实不满足真实订单与指派边界');
        }
        $current=$this->db->fetch('SELECT * FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE active_order_id=:id FOR UPDATE',['id'=>$orderId]);
        if($current){
            if((string)$current['assignment_id']!==(string)$assignment['id'] || (int)$current['after_sale_id']!==$afterSaleId
                || (int)$current['worker_id']!==$workerId || (string)$current['accepted_user_id']!==(string)$assignment['worker_user_id']) {
                throw new RuntimeException('订单已有其他有效售后受理区间');
            }
            (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($this->db,true))->schedule($orderId);
            return (string)$current['id'];
        }
        $id=$this->db->insert("INSERT INTO chat_repair_episodes(order_id,assignment_id,after_sale_id,worker_id,accepted_user_id,state,accepted_at)
            VALUES(:order_id,:assignment_id,:after_sale_id,:worker_id,:user_id,'active',UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            ['order_id'=>$orderId,'assignment_id'=>$assignment['id'],'after_sale_id'=>$afterSaleId,'worker_id'=>$workerId,'user_id'=>$assignment['worker_user_id']]);
        (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($this->db,true))->schedule($orderId);
        return (string)$id;
    }

    /** A future acceptance must INSERT a new immutable episode, never reopen this row. */
    public function close(int $orderId,int $afterSaleId): void
    {
        if(!$this->enabled)return;

        $this->db->execute("UPDATE chat_repair_episodes SET state='closed',closed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
            WHERE order_id=:order_id AND after_sale_id=:after_sale_id AND state='active'",['order_id'=>$orderId,'after_sale_id'=>$afterSaleId]);
        (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($this->db,true))->schedule($orderId);
    }

    private function lockOrder(int $id): array
    {
        if($id<1 || !$this->db->pdo()->inTransaction())throw new RuntimeException('售后聊天事实必须加入原订单事务');
        $order=$this->db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE',['id'=>$id]);
        if(!$order)throw new RuntimeException('售后订单不存在');
        return $order;
    }
