namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;

/** Bounded, resumable PHP projection only; never creates a Go message or interval. */
final class DatabaseChatPolicyMaintenance
{
    private Database $db;
    public function __construct(Database $db) { $this->db=$db; }

    /** Read-only enablement gate; it neither toggles features nor changes epochs. */
    public function preflight(): array
    {
        $expected=['chat_staff_settings_insert'=>'system_settings','chat_staff_settings_update'=>'system_settings','chat_staff_settings_delete'=>'system_settings',
            'chat_staff_user_insert'=>'users','chat_staff_user_update'=>'users','chat_staff_user_delete'=>'users',
            'chat_staff_wechat_insert'=>'wechat_identities','chat_staff_wechat_update'=>'wechat_identities','chat_staff_wechat_delete'=>'wechat_identities'];
        $rows=$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT TRIGGER_NAME,EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE,ACTION_TIMING,EVENT_MANIPULATION
            FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TRIGGER_NAME LIKE 'chat_staff_%'");
        $actual=[];
        foreach($rows as $row){
            $name=(string)$row['TRIGGER_NAME'];
            if(!isset($expected[$name]))continue;
            if($row['ACTION_TIMING']!=='AFTER' || strtolower((string)$row['EVENT_MANIPULATION'])!==substr($name,strrpos($name,'_')+1)
                || $row['EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE']!==$expected[$name])throw new RuntimeException('工作人员撤权触发器定义不匹配');
            $actual[$name]=true;
        }
        if(count($actual)!==count($expected))throw new RuntimeException('工作人员撤权触发器缺失或不可核验');
        $tables=['chat_policy_guards','chat_business_events','chat_repair_episodes','chat_staff_authority_versions','chat_policy_refresh',
            'order_platform_terms','order_pricing_items','platform_order_refund_reviews','platform_order_manual_receipts'];
        foreach($tables as $table)if(!$this->db->tableExists($table))throw new RuntimeException('聊天授权依赖表缺失');
        $config=$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT CAST(authority_version AS CHAR) FROM chat_staff_authority_versions WHERE user_id=0');
        $missing=(int)$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u LEFT JOIN chat_staff_authority_versions a ON a.user_id=u.id WHERE a.user_id IS NULL OR a.authority_version=0');
        if(!$config || $config==='0' || $missing>0)throw new RuntimeException('聊天权限代次种子缺失');
        return ['ready'=>true,'schema_target'=>'2.7.0','revocation_triggers'=>count($actual),'policy_enabled'=>$this->enabled()];
    }

    public function backfill(int $after,int $limit=100,bool $apply=false): array
    {
        if($after<0 || $limit<1 || $limit>100) throw new InvalidArgumentException('回填游标无效或每批超过100笔');
        if($apply && !$this->enabled()) throw new RuntimeException('订单聊天授权开关未启用，不能执行回填');
        $this->preflight();
        $rows=$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.id>:after AND o.is_demo=0
            AND ((o.lifecycle_status='active' AND o.current_assignment_id IS NOT NULL)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_policy_guards g WHERE g.order_id=o.id)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_repair_episodes e WHERE e.active_order_id=o.id))
            ORDER BY o.id LIMIT ".($limit+1),['after'=>$after]);
        $more=count($rows)>$limit;$rows=array_slice($rows,0,$limit);
        $result=['mode'=>$apply?'apply':'dry_run','scanned'=>0,'changed'=>0,'next_after'=>$after,'has_more'=>$more];
        foreach($rows as $row){
            $id=(int)$row['id'];
            $scopes=$this->db->transaction(function()use($id,$apply):array{
                return (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($this->db,$apply))->synchronize($id,$apply);
            });
            $result['scanned']++;$result['changed']+=count($scopes);$result['next_after']=$id;
        }
        return $result;
    }

    /** Existing all scheduler calls once; LIMIT is a hard per-run budget. */
    public function refresh(int $limit=100): array
    {
        $limit=max(1,min(100,$limit));
        $result=['task'=>'chat_policy_refresh','status'=>'success','scanned'=>0,'success'=>0,'failure'=>0];
        if(!$this->enabled())return $result;
        if((int)$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT GET_LOCK(CONCAT('chat-policy:',SHA1(DATABASE())),0)")!==1){$result['status']='skipped';return $result;}
        try{
            $rows=$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT g.order_id FROM chat_policy_guards g
                JOIN orders o ON o.id=g.order_id AND o.order_source_type='platform' AND o.is_demo=0
                LEFT JOIN chat_policy_refresh r ON r.order_id=g.order_id
                WHERE g.state='open' AND (r.order_id IS NULL OR r.next_check_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP())
                ORDER BY COALESCE(r.next_check_at,'1970-01-01'),g.order_id LIMIT {$limit}");
            foreach($rows as $row){
                $id=(int)$row['order_id'];$result['scanned']++;
                try{
                    $this->db->transaction(function()use($id):void{(new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($this->db,true))->synchronize($id);});
                    $result['success']++;
                    $this->db->execute("UPDATE scheduled_job_failures SET resolved_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                        WHERE job_name='chat_policy_refresh' AND business_key=:key AND resolved_at IS NULL",['key'=>'order:'.$id]);
                }catch(Throwable $error){
                    $result['failure']++;$result['status']='failed';
                    // A broken first row cannot starve later work. No SQL, token,
                    // identity list or message content is copied to diagnostics.
                    $this->db->execute("INSERT INTO chat_policy_refresh(order_id,checked_at,next_check_at,status)
                        VALUES(:id,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 5 MINUTE,'failed')
                        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checked_at=VALUES(checked_at),next_check_at=VALUES(next_check_at),status='failed'",['id'=>$id]);
                    $this->db->execute("INSERT INTO scheduled_job_failures(job_name,business_key,business_version,error_class,error_message,next_retry_at,created_at)
                        VALUES('chat_policy_refresh',:key,1,'CHAT_POLICY_REFRESH_FAILED','聊天授权投影恢复失败，请检查事务与升级状态',UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 5 MINUTE,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['key'=>'order:'.$id]);
                }
            }
        }finally{$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(CONCAT('chat-policy:',SHA1(DATABASE())))");}
        return $result;
    }

    private function enabled(): bool
    {return function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true;}
}

<?php

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

final class DatabasePlatformOrderAdminRepository implements PlatformOrderAdminRepository
{
    private const UNBOUND_CLOUD_USER_ID = 'platform-order-unbound-v250';

    private Database $db;
    private PrivateValueCipher $cipher;
    private PlatformOrderBookingPaymentVerifier $prepaymentVerifier;

    public function __construct(Database $db, PrivateValueCipher $cipher)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->cipher = $cipher;
        $this->prepaymentVerifier = new PlatformOrderBookingPaymentVerifier();
    }

    public function dashboard(): array
    {
        $rows = $this->db->fetchAll(
            "SELECT o.id,o.public_no,o.title,o.category_name_snapshot,o.city,o.district,o.address_summary,o.lat,o.lng,
                    o.payment_status,o.audit_status,o.publish_status,o.quote_status,o.assignment_status,o.fulfillment_status,o.lifecycle_status,
                    o.workflow_profile,o.dispatch_mode,o.booking_fee_cents,o.expected_fee_type,o.expected_fee_cents,o.final_amount_cents,o.selected_quote_id,
                    o.assigned_worker_id,o.current_assignment_id,o.quote_deadline_at,o.created_at,o.updated_at,u.nickname,u.mobile_masked,u.status customer_user_status,
                    t.customer_flow_mode,t.customer_pricing_mode,t.customer_contract_total_cents,t.booking_paid_cents AS external_prepayment_cents,
                    t.worker_settlement_mode,t.worker_labor_cents,t.extra_income_rate_bp_snapshot,t.customer_tail_cents,t.platform_receivable_cents,
                    t.worker_balance_credit_cents,t.settlement_status,
                    ms.order_id measurement_state_id,ms.result_status measurement_status,
                    w.display_name AS worker_name
             FROM orders o
             INNER JOIN order_platform_terms t ON t.order_id=o.id
             INNER JOIN users u ON u.id=o.user_id
             LEFT JOIN order_measurement_states ms ON ms.order_id=o.id
             LEFT JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.id=o.assigned_worker_id
             WHERE o.order_source_type='platform'
             ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 100"
        );

        foreach ($rows as &$row) {
            $row['customer_bound'] = (string)($row['customer_user_status'] ?? '') !== 'platform_unbound';
            $row['fulfillment_mode'] = !empty($row['measurement_state_id']) ? 'measure_then_install' : 'direct_install';
            $row['measurement_status'] = !empty($row['measurement_state_id']) ? (string)$row['measurement_status'] : 'not_required';
            $row['customer_flow_mode'] = (string)$row['customer_flow_mode'];

                && $row['measurement_status'] === 'accepted'
                && PlatformOrderPricingReviewReadiness::isReady($this->db, (int)$row['id']);
        }
        unset($row);

        $quotesByOrder = [];
        $invitesByOrder = [];
        if ($rows) {
            $params = [];

            foreach ($rows as $index => $row) {
                $key = 'order_' . $index;

                $params[$key] = (int)$row['id'];
            }
            $quoted = $this->db->fetchAll(
                "SELECT q.id,q.order_id,q.public_id,q.amount_cents,q.description,q.status,q.updated_at,w.display_name,w.verification_status
                 FROM quotes q INNER JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.id=q.worker_id
                 WHERE q.quote_type='worker' AND q.order_id IN (" . implode(',', $marks) . ")
                 ORDER BY q.order_id DESC,q.amount_cents ASC,q.id ASC",
                $params

                        i.claimed_worker_id,w.display_name claimed_worker_name
                 FROM invite_tokens i
                 LEFT JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.id=i.claimed_worker_id
                 WHERE i.purpose='worker_assignment' AND i.order_id IN (" . implode(',', $marks) . ")
                 ORDER BY i.order_id DESC,i.id DESC",

            'categories'=>$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT id,name,order_code FROM service_categories WHERE status='active' ORDER BY sort_order ASC,id ASC"),
        ];

    public function create(array $command, int $adminId): int
    {
        if ((string)($command['customer_flow_mode'] ?? '') !== 'platform_managed') {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单只允许平台托管模式。', 'PLATFORM_CUSTOMER_FLOW_INVALID', 422);

        // 与普通/代下单共用同一 order_submit 版本，不允许误取其他表单的最新 published 版本。
        $schemaVersionId = (int)$this->db->fetchValue(
            "SELECT v.id FROM form_schema_versions v
             INNER JOIN form_schemas s ON s.id=v.schema_id

        $detailAddress = mb_substr(trim((string)($command['address'] ?? '')), 0, 255);
        $fullAddress = trim(implode('', [$province,$city,$district,$detailAddress]));
        $baseMobile = preg_match('/^(1\d{10})/u', (string)$command['contact_mobile'], $mobileMatch) === 1
            ? (string)$mobileMatch[1]
            : (string)$command['contact_mobile'];

        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($command,$userId,$category,$schemaVersionId,$province,$city,$district,$detailAddress,$fullAddress,$baseMobile,$maskedMobile,$expectedFeeType,$expectedFeeCents,$measureFirst,$adminId,$lat,$lng,$locationSource,$mapPointName,$mapPointAddress,$externalPrepayment): int {

                        [

        });
    }

    public function publish(int $orderId, int $adminId, int $quoteDays): void
    {
        $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($orderId,$adminId,$quoteDays): void {
            $order = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT o.*,t.customer_flow_mode,t.customer_contract_total_cents,t.booking_paid_cents
                 FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_platform_terms t ON t.order_id=o.id
                 WHERE o.id=:id AND o.order_source_type='platform' FOR UPDATE",
                ['id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单不存在。', 'PLATFORM_ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            if ((string)$order['customer_flow_mode'] !== 'platform_managed' || (int)$order['booking_fee_cents'] !== 0) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('平台单资金口径仍含旧预约模式，不能发布。', 'PLATFORM_BOOKING_FLOW_INVALID', 409);
            }
            $this->prepaymentVerifier->verifiedPaidCents($db,$orderId,(int)$order['customer_contract_total_cents'],(int)$order['booking_paid_cents'],'platform_managed');
            if ($order['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active' || !empty($order['selected_quote_id']) || !empty($order['assigned_worker_id']) || !empty($order['current_assignment_id'])) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('当前订单阶段不能发布。', 'PLATFORM_PUBLISH_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
            }
            if ((string)$order['publish_status'] === 'published') {
                throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单已经发布，请勿重复刷新报价截止时间。', 'PLATFORM_ALREADY_PUBLISHED', 409);
            }
            if (!in_array((string)($order['refund_status'] ?? 'none'), ['', 'none'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('订单存在退款状态，不能重新发布。', 'PLATFORM_REFUND_BLOCKS_PUBLISH', 409);
            }
            if ($order['lat'] === null || $order['lng'] === null) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('施工地址缺少地图坐标，请先补充地图选点。', 'PLATFORM_LOCATION_REQUIRED', 409);
            }
            $changed = $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET audit_status='approved',publish_status='published',quote_status='waiting',audited_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),published_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),quote_deadline_at=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL {$quoteDays} DAY),audit_note='平台托管条件核验通过后人工异常修复发布',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1
                 WHERE id=:id AND publish_status<>'published' AND selected_quote_id IS NULL AND assigned_worker_id IS NULL AND current_assignment_id IS NULL",
                ['id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if ($changed !== 1) throw new OrderOperationException('订单发布状态已变化，请刷新后重试。', 'PLATFORM_PUBLISH_RACE', 409);
            $this->event($db, $orderId, 'platform_order_published', $adminId, ['quote_days'=>$quoteDays]);
        });
    }

    public function selectQuote(int $orderId, int $quoteId, int $adminId): void
    {
        $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($orderId,$quoteId,$adminId): void {
            $order = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT o.*,t.customer_flow_mode,t.customer_contract_total_cents,t.booking_paid_cents,t.worker_settlement_mode
                 FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_platform_terms t ON t.order_id=o.id
                 WHERE o.id=:id AND o.order_source_type='platform' FOR UPDATE",
                ['id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单不存在。', 'PLATFORM_ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            if ($order['dispatch_mode'] !== 'multi_quote') throw new OrderOperationException('只有师傅报价模式可以由平台选择报价。', 'PLATFORM_QUOTE_MODE_REQUIRED', 409);
            if ((string)$order['customer_flow_mode'] !== 'platform_managed' || (int)$order['booking_fee_cents'] !== 0
                || $order['audit_status'] !== 'approved' || $order['publish_status'] !== 'published' || $order['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active') {
                throw new OrderOperationException('订单尚未满足平台托管/发布条件或已经结束。', 'PLATFORM_ORDER_NOT_READY', 409);
            }
            $this->prepaymentVerifier->verifiedPaidCents($db,$orderId,(int)$order['customer_contract_total_cents'],(int)$order['booking_paid_cents'],'platform_managed');
            if (!empty($order['quote_deadline_at']) && strtotime((string)$order['quote_deadline_at'].' UTC') <= time()) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('本单报价期限已经结束，不能再选择师傅。', 'PLATFORM_QUOTE_DEADLINE_PASSED', 409);
            }
            if (!in_array((string)($order['refund_status'] ?? 'none'), ['', 'none'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('订单存在退款状态，不能选择师傅。', 'PLATFORM_REFUND_BLOCKS_DEAL', 409);
            }
            if (!empty($order['selected_quote_id']) || !empty($order['assigned_worker_id']) || !empty($order['current_assignment_id'])) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('该订单已经成交，请勿重复选择。', 'PLATFORM_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED', 409);
            }

            $quote = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT q.*,w.display_name FROM quotes q INNER JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.id=q.worker_id
                 WHERE q.id=:quote_id AND q.order_id=:order_id AND q.quote_type='worker' AND q.status='active' FOR UPDATE",
                ['quote_id'=>$quoteId,'order_id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if (!$quote) throw new OrderOperationException('师傅报价不存在或已经失效。', 'PLATFORM_QUOTE_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            $labor = max(0, (int)$quote['amount_cents']);
            if ($labor <= 0) throw new OrderOperationException('师傅工费无效。', 'PLATFORM_LABOR_INVALID', 409);
            if ($order['worker_settlement_mode'] === 'worker_collect'
                && (int)$order['customer_contract_total_cents'] - $labor - (int)$order['booking_paid_cents'] < 0) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('选择该报价会形成负差额，请先调整客户价格或让师傅修改报价。', 'PLATFORM_SETTLEMENT_NEGATIVE', 409);
            }

            $nextVersion = 1 + (int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0) FROM commission_rule_versions WHERE order_id=:order_id', ['order_id'=>$orderId]);
            $ruleId = $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO commission_rule_versions(order_id,version_no,rate_bp,min_fee_cents,adjustment_type,adjustment_reason,created_by_admin_id,status,locked_at,created_at)
                 VALUES(:order_id,:version,0,0,'platform_order','平台承接单不重复收取普通平台服务费',:admin_id,'active',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                ['order_id'=>$orderId,'version'=>$nextVersion,'admin_id'=>$adminId ?: null]
            );
            $assignmentId = $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO assignments(public_id,order_id,worker_id,quote_id,assignment_type,commission_rule_version_id,final_amount_cents_snapshot,booking_fee_cents_snapshot,commission_rate_bp_snapshot,commission_min_cents_snapshot,estimated_commission_cents,estimated_offline_collect_cents,estimated_net_income_cents,status,offered_at,accepted_at,created_by_admin_id,created_at,updated_at)
                 VALUES(:public_id,:order_id,:worker_id,:quote_id,'worker_quote',:rule_id,:labor,0,0,0,0,0,:labor,'accepted',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),:admin_id,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                ['public_id'=>\public_id(),'order_id'=>$orderId,'worker_id'=>$quote['worker_id'],'quote_id'=>$quoteId,'rule_id'=>$ruleId,'labor'=>$labor,'admin_id'=>$adminId ?: null]
            );
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE quotes SET status=IF(id=:selected_id,'selected','closed'),selected_at=IF(id=:selected_time,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),selected_at),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE order_id=:order_id AND quote_type='worker' AND status='active'",
                ['selected_id'=>$quoteId,'selected_time'=>$quoteId,'order_id'=>$orderId]
            );
            $changed = $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET selected_quote_id=:quote_id,assigned_worker_id=:worker_id,current_assignment_id=:assignment_id,
                         commission_rule_version_id=:rule_id,commission_rate_bp=0,commission_min_cents=0,quote_status='selected',assignment_status='accepted',publish_status='hidden',
                         contact_revealed_at=COALESCE(contact_revealed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1
                 WHERE id=:order_id AND selected_quote_id IS NULL AND assigned_worker_id IS NULL AND current_assignment_id IS NULL",
                ['quote_id'=>$quoteId,'worker_id'=>$quote['worker_id'],'assignment_id'=>$assignmentId,'rule_id'=>$ruleId,'order_id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if ($changed !== 1) throw new OrderOperationException('该订单刚刚已被其他操作成交，请刷新。', 'PLATFORM_ORDER_DEAL_RACE', 409);
            $db->execute('UPDATE order_platform_terms SET worker_labor_cents=:labor,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:order_id', ['labor'=>$labor,'order_id'=>$orderId]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE invite_tokens SET status='revoked' WHERE order_id=:order_id AND purpose='worker_assignment' AND status='active'", ['order_id'=>$orderId]);
            $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO assignment_history(assignment_id,order_id,worker_id,action,reason,actor_type,actor_id,created_at)
                 VALUES(:assignment_id,:order_id,:worker_id,'accepted','平台承接单：师傅主动报价被平台选中后自动成交','admin',:actor_id,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                ['assignment_id'=>$assignmentId,'order_id'=>$orderId,'worker_id'=>$quote['worker_id'],'actor_id'=>$adminId ?: null]
            );
            $this->event($db, $orderId, 'platform_worker_quote_selected', $adminId, [
                'quote_id'=>$quote['public_id'],'worker_id'=>(int)$quote['worker_id'],'worker_labor_cents'=>$labor,
            ]);
        });
    }

    public function createInvite(int $orderId, int $adminId, int $validDays): array
    {
        $plainToken = rtrim(strtr(base64_encode(random_bytes(24)), '+/', '-_'), '=');
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($orderId,$adminId,$validDays,$plainToken): array {
            $order = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT o.*,t.customer_flow_mode,t.customer_contract_total_cents,t.booking_paid_cents
                 FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_platform_terms t ON t.order_id=o.id
                 WHERE o.id=:id AND o.order_source_type='platform' FOR UPDATE",
                ['id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单不存在。', 'PLATFORM_ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            if ((string)$order['customer_flow_mode'] !== 'platform_managed' || (int)$order['booking_fee_cents'] !== 0
                || $order['audit_status'] !== 'approved' || $order['publish_status'] !== 'published' || $order['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active') {
                throw new OrderOperationException('只有托管条件完整、已发布且仍在接单阶段的平台单可以邀请师傅。', 'PLATFORM_INVITE_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
            }
            $this->prepaymentVerifier->verifiedPaidCents($db,$orderId,(int)$order['customer_contract_total_cents'],(int)$order['booking_paid_cents'],'platform_managed');
            if (!in_array((string)$order['quote_status'], ['waiting','quoting','collecting'], true)
                || !empty($order['selected_quote_id']) || !empty($order['assigned_worker_id']) || !empty($order['current_assignment_id'])) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('该平台单已经成交或不再接收师傅。', 'PLATFORM_INVITE_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
            }
            if (!in_array((string)($order['refund_status'] ?? 'none'), ['', 'none'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('该订单存在退款状态，不能继续邀请师傅。', 'PLATFORM_REFUND_BLOCKS_INVITE', 409);
            }
            if (empty($order['quote_deadline_at']) || strtotime((string)$order['quote_deadline_at'].' UTC') <= time()) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('本单报价期限已经结束，不能再生成邀请。', 'PLATFORM_QUOTE_DEADLINE_PASSED', 409);
            }

            $db->execute("UPDATE invite_tokens SET status='revoked' WHERE order_id=:order_id AND purpose='worker_assignment' AND status='active'", ['order_id'=>$orderId]);
            $ruleId = (int)$db->fetchValue(
                "SELECT id FROM commission_rule_versions WHERE order_id=:order_id AND adjustment_type='platform_order' AND status='active' ORDER BY version_no DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['order_id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if ($ruleId < 1) {
                $nextVersion = 1 + (int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0) FROM commission_rule_versions WHERE order_id=:order_id', ['order_id'=>$orderId]);
                $ruleId = $db->insert(
                    "INSERT INTO commission_rule_versions(order_id,version_no,rate_bp,min_fee_cents,adjustment_type,adjustment_reason,created_by_admin_id,status,locked_at,created_at)
                     VALUES(:order_id,:version,0,0,'platform_order','平台承接单受邀师傅不重复收取普通服务费',:admin_id,'active',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                    ['order_id'=>$orderId,'version'=>$nextVersion,'admin_id'=>$adminId ?: null]
                );
            }
            $expiresAt = gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', min(
                time() + max(1, min(30, $validDays)) * 86400,
                (int)strtotime((string)$order['quote_deadline_at'].' UTC')
            ));
            $inviteId = $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO invite_tokens(order_id,token_hash,purpose,created_by_admin_id,commission_rule_version_id,status,max_claims,claim_count,expires_at,created_at)
                 VALUES(:order_id,:token_hash,'worker_assignment',:admin_id,:rule_id,'active',1,0,:expires_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                [
                    'order_id'=>$orderId,'token_hash'=>hash('sha256',$plainToken),'admin_id'=>$adminId ?: null,
                    'rule_id'=>$ruleId,'expires_at'=>$expiresAt,
                ]
            );
            $this->event($db, $orderId, 'platform_worker_invite_created', $adminId, [
                'invite_id'=>$inviteId,'dispatch_mode'=>(string)$order['dispatch_mode'],'expires_at'=>$expiresAt,
                'message'=>(string)$order['dispatch_mode']==='multi_quote'
                    ? '受邀只是触达渠道，领取后仍需提交师傅工费报价'
                    : '一口价平台单领取邀请即按既定师傅工费成交',
            ]);
            return [
                'order_id'=>$orderId,'order_no'=>(string)$order['public_no'],'invite_id'=>$inviteId,
                'token'=>$plainToken,'expires_at'=>$expiresAt,'dispatch_mode'=>(string)$order['dispatch_mode'],
            ];
        });
    }

    public function revokeInvite(int $orderId, int $inviteId, int $adminId): void
    {
        $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($orderId,$inviteId,$adminId): void {
            $invite = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT i.id,i.status,o.order_source_type FROM invite_tokens i JOIN orders o ON o.id=i.order_id
                 WHERE i.id=:invite_id AND i.order_id=:order_id FOR UPDATE",
                ['invite_id'=>$inviteId,'order_id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if (!$invite || (string)$invite['order_source_type'] !== 'platform') {
                throw new OrderOperationException('平台邀请不存在。', 'PLATFORM_INVITE_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            }
            if ((string)$invite['status'] !== 'active') return;
            $db->execute("UPDATE invite_tokens SET status='revoked' WHERE id=:id AND status='active'", ['id'=>$inviteId]);
            $this->event($db,$orderId,'platform_worker_invite_revoked',$adminId,['invite_id'=>$inviteId]);
        });
    }

    private function ensureUnboundCustomerUser(): int
    {
        $id = (int)$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM users WHERE cloud_user_id=:cloud_id LIMIT 1", ['cloud_id'=>self::UNBOUND_CLOUD_USER_ID]);
        if ($id > 0) return $id;
        try {
            $id = $this->db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO users(public_id,nickname,mobile_masked,status,cloud_user_id,created_at,updated_at)
                 VALUES(:public_id,'平台待绑定客户','','platform_unbound',:cloud_id,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                ['public_id'=>\public_id(),'cloud_id'=>self::UNBOUND_CLOUD_USER_ID]
            );
        } catch (PDOException $exception) {
            if ((string)$exception->getCode() !== '23000') throw $exception;
            $id = (int)$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM users WHERE cloud_user_id=:cloud_id LIMIT 1", ['cloud_id'=>self::UNBOUND_CLOUD_USER_ID]);
        }
        if ($id < 1) throw new OrderOperationException('待绑定客户占位账号初始化失败，请重试。', 'PLATFORM_UNBOUND_CUSTOMER_INIT_FAILED', 500);
        return $id;
    }

    /** @param array<string,mixed> $command @return array{0:float,1:float,2:string,3:string,4:string} */
    private function resolveLocation(array $command): array
    {
        $lat = isset($command['lat']) && is_numeric($command['lat']) ? (float)$command['lat'] : null;
        $lng = isset($command['lng']) && is_numeric($command['lng']) ? (float)$command['lng'] : null;
        if ($lat === null || $lng === null || $lat < -90 || $lat > 90 || $lng < -180 || $lng > 180) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单必须先完成地图选点。', 'PLATFORM_LOCATION_REQUIRED', 422);
        }
        $mapName = mb_substr(trim((string)($command['map_point_name'] ?? '')), 0, 160);
        $mapAddress = mb_substr(trim((string)($command['map_point_address'] ?? '')), 0, 255);
        return [$lat,$lng,'map_picker',$mapName,$mapAddress];
    }

    private function maskContactMobile(string $mobile): string
    {
        if (preg_match('/^(1\d{2})\d{4}(\d{4})(.*)$/u', $mobile, $matches) === 1) {
            return $matches[1] . '****' . $matches[2] . $matches[3];
        }
        return $mobile;
    }

    private function event(Database $db, int $orderId, string $eventType, int $adminId, array $payload): void
    {
        if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
            (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true))->schedule($orderId);
        }
        $mini = ($payload['operator_channel'] ?? '') === 'mini_admin';
        $actorId = $mini ? (int)($payload['operator_user_id'] ?? 0) : $adminId;
        $encoded = json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $eventId = $db->insert(
            "INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at)
             VALUES(:order_id,:event_type,:actor_type,:actor_id,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            ['order_id'=>$orderId,'event_type'=>$eventType,'actor_type'=>$mini ? 'mini_admin' : 'admin','actor_id'=>$actorId > 0 ? $actorId : null,'payload'=>is_string($encoded) ? $encoded : '{}']
        );
        \WorkerAdmin\Services\OrderNotificationService::queuePersistedEvent($db, $orderId, $eventId, $eventType, $payload);
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\External;

use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/** One cross-process refresh coordinator for every PHP caller; Go never owns AppSecret. */
final class WeChatAccessTokenProvider
{
    private string $environment;
    private string $appId;
    private string $secret;
    private string $directory;
    private ?string $exportDirectory;
    private $request;

    public function __construct(string $environment,string $appId,#[\SensitiveParameter] string $secret,string $directory,?string $exportDirectory=null,?callable $request=null)
    {
        if(!in_array($environment,['production','development','test'],true)||preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/D',$appId)!==1||$secret==='')throw new RuntimeException('微信统一凭证配置不可用');
        $this->environment=$environment;$this->appId=$appId;$this->secret=$secret;
        $this->directory=$directory;$this->exportDirectory=$exportDirectory;$this->request=$request;
    }

    public static function fromSettings(): self
    {
        $env=(string)\app_config('app.env','production');if($env==='testing')$env='test';
        return new self($env,trim((string)\setting('wechat.miniapp_appid','')),trim((string)\setting('wechat.miniapp_secret','')),
            \base_path('storage/private/wechat-tokens'),\app_config('chat.safety_credential_export_enabled',false)===true?\base_path('storage/private/chat-credentials'):null);
    }

    public function get(): string
    {
        $this->ensureDirectory($this->directory,0700);
        $cached=$this->read();
        if($this->valid($cached,300)&&$this->exportMatches($cached)){ return $cached['token']; }
        $lock=$this->lock($cached);
        if($lock===null){ return $cached['token']; }
        try{
            $cached=$this->read();
            if($this->valid($cached,300)){ $this->export($cached);return $cached['token']; }
            if(!$this->valid($cached,5))$this->revokeExport();
            $started=time();
            try{
                $response=$this->request!==null?($this->request)($this->appId,$this->secret):$this->requestToken();
                if(!is_array($response)||isset($response['errcode'])&&$response['errcode']!==0
                    ||!is_string($response['access_token']??null)||preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,2048}$/D',$response['access_token'])!==1
                    ||!is_int($response['expires_in']??null)||$response['expires_in']<1||$response['expires_in']>7200)throw new RuntimeException('微信统一凭证响应不可用');
                // Never extend a provider TTL with max(600, expires_in).
                $next=['schema_version'=>1,'env'=>$this->environment,'app_id'=>$this->appId,'token'=>$response['access_token'],
                    'issued_at'=>$started,'expires_at'=>$started+$response['expires_in'],'credential_hash'=>$this->credentialHash()];
                if(!$this->valid($next,5))throw new RuntimeException('微信统一凭证剩余有效期不足');
                $this->write($this->cachePath(),$next,0600);
                $this->export($next);
                return $next['token'];
            }catch(Throwable $error){
                // A failed refresh does not invent a new expiry or discard a
                // still-valid credential. Rejected/rotated credentials fail this.
                if($this->valid($cached,5)){ $this->export($cached);return $cached['token']; }
                throw new RuntimeException('微信统一凭证暂不可用');
            }
        }finally{flock($lock,LOCK_UN);fclose($lock);}
    }

    /** Only invalidate the exact generation actually rejected by a caller. */
    public function rejectGeneration(string $generation): bool
    {
        if(preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D',$generation)!==1)return false;
        $this->ensureDirectory($this->directory,0700);$lock=$this->lock(null);
        try{
            $cached=$this->read();
            if(!is_array($cached)||!hash_equals($this->generation($cached['token']),$generation))return false;
            if(is_file($this->cachePath())&&!unlink($this->cachePath()))throw new RuntimeException('微信统一凭证撤销失败');
            if($this->exportDirectory!==null){$this->revokeExport();}
            return true;
        }finally{flock($lock,LOCK_UN);fclose($lock);}
    }
    public function reject(#[\SensitiveParameter] string $usedToken): bool
    {
        return $usedToken!==''&&$this->rejectGeneration($this->generation($usedToken));
    }
    public function generation(#[\SensitiveParameter] string $token): string {return hash('sha256',$this->environment."\n".$this->appId."\n".$token);}
    public function exportPath(): string
    {
        if($this->exportDirectory===null)throw new RuntimeException('聊天凭证导出未启用');
        return $this->exportDirectory.DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR.$this->environment.'-'.hash('sha256',$this->appId).'.json';
    }
    /** Read-only preflight, including permissions and exact current configuration. */
    public function metadata(): array
    {
        $cached=$this->read();

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Domain\Chat;

/** PHP is the only interpreter of order/assignment states. Input is server-owned facts. */
final class OrderConversationPolicy
{
    /** PHP-owned platform policy; staff authority is intersected again by Go. */
    public function evaluatePlatform(array $facts): ?array
    {
        foreach (['order_id','customer_id','assignment_id','worker_id','worker_user_id'] as $key) {
            if (!$this->id($facts[$key] ?? null)) return null;
        }
        if (($facts['order_source_type'] ?? '') !== 'platform'
            || ($facts['customer_flow_mode'] ?? '') !== 'platform_managed'
            || ($facts['is_demo'] ?? null) !== 0 || ($facts['booking_fee_cents'] ?? null) !== 0
            || ($facts['payment_status'] ?? '') !== 'not_required'
            || !in_array($facts['workflow_profile'] ?? '', ['construction','measurement'], true)
            || (string)($facts['current_assignment_id'] ?? '') !== (string)$facts['assignment_id']
            || (string)($facts['assignment_order_id'] ?? '') !== (string)$facts['order_id']
            || (string)($facts['assigned_worker_id'] ?? '') !== (string)$facts['worker_id']
            || ($facts['worker_user_status'] ?? '') !== 'active'
            || empty($facts['assignment_accepted_at'])
            || (string)$facts['customer_id'] === (string)$facts['worker_user_id']
            || !$this->id($facts['staff_config_version'] ?? null)) return null;
        $lifecycle = (string)($facts['lifecycle_status'] ?? '');
        $episode = 'assignment:'.$facts['assignment_id'].':service';
        $repair = array_key_exists('repair_episode',$facts);
        if ($repair) {
            $accepted = is_array($facts['repair_episode']) ? $this->repair($facts,$facts['repair_episode'],true) : null;
            if (!$accepted) return null;
            $episode = $accepted['episode_key'];
        }
        $open = $lifecycle === 'active' || $repair;
        if (!$open && !in_array($lifecycle, ['completed','cancelled','closed','refunded','cancel_approved_pending_refund'], true)) return null;
        $statuses = $lifecycle === 'active' ? ['accepted','info_released'] : ['accepted','info_released','completed','cancelled'];
        if (!in_array($facts['assignment_status'] ?? '', $statuses, true)
            || !in_array($facts['assignment_record_status'] ?? '', $statuses, true)) return null;
        $members = [];
        if (($facts['customer_status'] ?? '') === 'active') {
            if ((string)$facts['customer_id'] === (string)$facts['worker_user_id']) return null;
            $members[] = $this->member((string)$facts['customer_id'], 'customer', $open);
        } elseif (($facts['customer_status'] ?? '') !== 'platform_unbound') return null;
        $members[] = $this->member((string)$facts['worker_user_id'], 'worker', $open);
        $staff = $facts['platform_staff'] ?? null;
        if (!is_array($staff) || count($staff) > 8) return null;
        $seen = array_fill_keys(array_column($members, 'actor_id'), true);
        foreach ($staff as $person) {
            if (!is_array($person) || !$this->id($person['actor_id'] ?? null)
                || ($person['kind'] ?? '') !== 'mini' || ($person['status'] ?? '') !== 'active'
                || ($person['is_mini_admin'] ?? null) !== true || !$this->id($person['authority_version'] ?? null)) return null;
            $id = (string)$person['actor_id'];
            if (($facts['customer_status'] ?? '') === 'platform_unbound' && $id === (string)$facts['customer_id']) return null;
            // A worker/customer who is also an administrator retains that role.
            if (isset($seen[$id])) continue;
            $seen[$id] = true;
            $member = $this->member($id, 'platform_staff', $open);
            $member['authority_version'] = (string)$person['authority_version'];
            $members[] = $member;
        }
        if (count($members) > 10) return null;
        if (count($members) === 1) $members[0]['can_send'] = false;
        $snapshot = $this->snapshot($facts, $open, $episode);
        $snapshot['schema_version'] = 2;
        $snapshot['staff_config_version'] = (string)$facts['staff_config_version'];
        $snapshot['members'] = $members;
        return $snapshot;
    }

    private function member(string $id, string $role, bool $open): array
    {
        return ['actor_id'=>$id,'kind'=>'mini','role'=>$role,'can_read'=>true,'can_send'=>$open];
    }

    /** A null result means no new grant. Existing grants must be closed by the bridge. */
    public function evaluate(array $facts): ?array
    {
        if (($facts['order_source_type'] ?? '') === 'platform') return $this->evaluatePlatform($facts);
        foreach (['order_id','customer_id','assignment_id','worker_id','worker_user_id'] as $key) {
            if (!$this->id($facts[$key] ?? null)) return null;
        }
        if ((string)($facts['current_assignment_id'] ?? '') !== (string)$facts['assignment_id']
            || (string)($facts['assignment_order_id'] ?? '') !== (string)$facts['order_id']
            || (string)($facts['assigned_worker_id'] ?? '') !== (string)$facts['worker_id']
            || (string)$facts['customer_id'] === (string)$facts['worker_user_id']) return null;
        if (($facts['is_demo'] ?? null) !== 0 || ($facts['customer_status'] ?? '') !== 'active'
            || ($facts['worker_user_status'] ?? '') !== 'active') return null;
        if (!in_array($facts['workflow_profile'] ?? '', ['construction','measurement'],true)
            || !in_array($facts['order_source_type'] ?? '', ['consumer','merchant'],true)) return null;
        if(array_key_exists('repair_episode',$facts)) {
            return is_array($facts['repair_episode'])?$this->repair($facts,$facts['repair_episode']):null;
        }
        // An offered/unaccepted assignment never creates order chat.
        if (($facts['assignment_record_status'] ?? '') !== 'accepted'
            || !in_array($facts['assignment_status'] ?? '', ['accepted','info_released'],true)
            || empty($facts['assignment_accepted_at']) || ($facts['payment_status'] ?? '') !== 'paid') return null;
        $lifecycle = (string)($facts['lifecycle_status'] ?? '');
        $open = $lifecycle === 'active';
        if (!$open && !in_array($lifecycle,['completed','cancelled','closed','refunded','cancel_approved_pending_refund'],true)) return null;
        return $this->snapshot($facts,$open,'assignment:'.$facts['assignment_id'].':service');
    }

    private function repair(array $facts,array $episode,bool $platform=false): ?array
    {
        foreach(['id','after_sale_id'] as $key) if(!$this->id($episode[$key]??null))return null;
        foreach(['order_id'=>'order_id','assignment_id'=>'assignment_id','worker_id'=>'worker_id','accepted_user_id'=>'worker_user_id',
            'repair_order_id'=>'order_id','repair_user_id'=>'customer_id'] as $key=>$fact) {
            if((string)($episode[$key]??'')!==(string)$facts[$fact])return null;
        }
        if(($facts['workflow_profile']??'')!=='construction' || ($facts['lifecycle_status']??'')!=='completed'
            || ($facts['payment_status']??'')!==($platform?'not_required':'paid')
            || !in_array($facts['assignment_record_status']??'',['accepted','completed'],true)
            || !in_array($facts['assignment_status']??'',['accepted','info_released','completed'],true) || empty($facts['assignment_accepted_at'])
            || ($episode['state']??'')!=='active' || empty($episode['accepted_at']) || !empty($episode['closed_at'])
            || ($episode['repair_type']??'')!=='warranty_repair' || ($episode['repair_status']??'')!=='processing'
            || !empty($episode['repair_closed_at']))return null;
        return $this->snapshot($facts,true,'assignment:'.$facts['assignment_id'].':repair:'.$episode['id']);
    }

    private function snapshot(array $facts,bool $open,string $episode): array
    {
        $order=(string)$facts['order_id'];$assignment=(string)$facts['assignment_id'];
        return [
            'schema_version'=>1,'scope_key'=>'order:'.$order.':assignment:'.$assignment,
            'order_id'=>$order,'assignment_id'=>$assignment,'episode_key'=>$episode,
            'state'=>$open?'open':'readonly','can_invite'=>false,
            'members'=>[
                ['actor_id'=>(string)$facts['customer_id'],'kind'=>'mini','role'=>'customer','can_read'=>true,'can_send'=>$open],
                ['actor_id'=>(string)$facts['worker_user_id'],'kind'=>'mini','role'=>'worker','can_read'=>true,'can_send'=>$open],
            ],
        ];
    }

    private function id($value): bool
    {
        if (!is_string($value) && !is_int($value)) return false;
        $id=(string)$value;
        return preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/D',$id)===1
            && (strlen($id)<20 || strcmp($id,'18446744073709551615')<=0);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Domain\Identity;

/**
 * 小程序管理员身份纯规则。
 *
 * 管理员资格绑定真实登录会话 OpenID；进入演示代理后不得继承生产管理员权限。
 */
final class AdminActorPolicy
{
    public function isRealMiniAdmin(array $actor, array $adminOpenIds): bool
    {
        $openid = trim((string) ($actor['payer_openid'] ?? ''));
        if ($openid === '') return false;
        return in_array($openid, $adminOpenIds, true);
    }

    public function isMiniAdmin(array $actor, array $adminOpenIds): bool
    {
        return empty($actor['is_demo_actor']) && $this->isRealMiniAdmin($actor, $adminOpenIds);
    }

    public function isWorker(array $actor): bool
    {
        return (int) ($actor['worker_id'] ?? 0) > 0;
    }

    public function isOrderOwner(array $actor, array $order): bool
    {
        return (int) ($actor['user_id'] ?? 0) > 0
            && (int) ($actor['user_id'] ?? 0) === (int) ($order['user_id'] ?? 0);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Application\Identity;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\SettingsProvider;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Identity\AdminActorPolicy;

/**
 * 服务端身份能力解析入口。
 *
 * 页面/HTTP 模块只问“是否具备能力”，不再重复解释管理员 OpenID、演示身份等组合规则。
 */
final class ActorCapabilityResolver
{
    private SettingsProvider $settings;
    private AdminActorPolicy $policy;

    public function __construct(SettingsProvider $settings, ?AdminActorPolicy $policy = null)
    {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->policy = $policy ?: new AdminActorPolicy();
    }

    /** @return string[] */
    public function adminOpenIds(): array
    {
        $openids = $this->settings->get('wechat.admin_openids', []);
        if (is_string($openids)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($openids, true);
            $openids = is_array($decoded)
                ? $decoded
                : preg_split('/[\s,，]+/', $openids, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        }
        if (!is_array($openids)) return [];
        $openids = array_map(static function ($value): string {
            return trim((string) $value);
        }, $openids);
        return array_values(array_unique(array_filter($openids, static function (string $value): bool {
            return $value !== '';
        })));
    }

    public function isRealMiniAdmin(array $actor): bool
    {
        return $this->policy->isRealMiniAdmin($actor, $this->adminOpenIds());
    }

    public function isMiniAdmin(array $actor): bool
    {
        return $this->policy->isMiniAdmin($actor, $this->adminOpenIds());
    }

    public function isWorker(array $actor): bool
    {
        return $this->policy->isWorker($actor);
    }

    public function isOrderOwner(array $actor, array $order): bool
    {
        return $this->policy->isOrderOwner($actor, $order);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Application\Identity\ActorCapabilityResolver;
use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\SettingsProvider;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;

/** Current real mini-admin facts; no cached setting(), backend admin IDs or tokens. */
final class DatabaseChatPlatformStaff
{
    private Database $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db) { $this->db = $db; }

    /**
     * Current facts for OrderConversationPolicy; never writes memberships.
     * Caller must own the order transaction; all source rows remain shared-locked.
     * Lock order: source rows, per-user authority versions, configuration version.
     */
    public function readLocked(): array
    { return $this->readAuthorityLocked()['platform_staff']; }

    public function readAuthorityLocked(): array
    {
        if (!$this->db->pdo()->inTransaction()) throw new RuntimeException('平台聊天身份必须在订单事务内解析');
        $values = [];
        $rows = $this->db->fetchAll(
            "SELECT setting_key,setting_value,value_type FROM system_settings
             WHERE setting_key IN ('wechat.admin_openids','wechat.miniapp_appid')
             ORDER BY setting_key LOCK IN SHARE MODE"
        );
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $value = $row['setting_value'];
            // These identity settings are plaintext. Unknown/encrypted legacy data
            // cannot silently use a request-local cache or an alternate app ID.
            if (!is_string($value) || strlen($value) > 8192 || strncmp($value, 'enc:v1:', 7) === 0) return $this->authority([]);
            if ($row['value_type'] === 'json') {
                $value = json_decode($value, true);
                if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) return $this->authority([]);
            } elseif ($row['value_type'] !== 'string') return $this->authority([]);
            $values[$row['setting_key']] = $value;
        }
        $settings = new class($values) implements SettingsProvider {
            private array $values;
            public function __construct(array $values) { $this->values = $values; }
            public function get(string $key, $default = null) { return $this->values[$key] ?? $default; }
            public function bool(string $key, bool $default = false): bool { return $default; }
            public function int(string $key, int $default = 0): int { return $default; }
        };
        $capabilities = new ActorCapabilityResolver($settings);
        $configured = $settings->get('wechat.admin_openids', []);
        if (is_string($configured)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($configured, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) $configured = $decoded;
        }
        if (is_array($configured)) foreach ($configured as $value) if (!is_string($value)) return $this->authority([]);
        if (!is_array($configured) && !is_string($configured)) return $this->authority([]);
        $openids = $capabilities->adminOpenIds();
        $app = $settings->get('wechat.miniapp_appid', '');
        if (!is_string($app) || trim($app) === '' || count($openids) < 1 || count($openids) > 8) return $this->authority([]);
        $params = ['app'=>trim($app)]; $slots = [];
        foreach ($openids as $i=>$openid) { $slots[] = ':openid'.$i; $params['openid'.$i] = $openid; }
        $identities = $this->db->fetchAll(
            "SELECT CAST(u.id AS CHAR) actor_id,u.status,wi.openid payer_openid
             FROM wechat_identities wi JOIN users u ON u.id=wi.user_id AND u.status='active'
             WHERE wi.status='active' AND BINARY wi.app_id=BINARY :app
               AND BINARY wi.openid IN (".implode(',', $slots).")
             ORDER BY u.id,wi.id LIMIT 9 LOCK IN SHARE MODE", $params
        );
        if (count($identities) > 8) return $this->authority([]);
        $staff = [];
        foreach ($identities as $actor) {
            // Explicit current locking read: a correlated MAX subquery can retain
            // an earlier REPEATABLE READ snapshot even inside an outer lock read.
            $current = $this->db->fetch(
                "SELECT openid payer_openid FROM wechat_identities
                 WHERE user_id=:user AND status='active' AND BINARY app_id=BINARY :app
                 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE",
                ['user'=>$actor['actor_id'],'app'=>trim($app)]
            );
            if (!$current || !$capabilities->isMiniAdmin($current)) continue;
            $staff[(string)$actor['actor_id']] = ['actor_id'=>(string)$actor['actor_id'],'kind'=>'mini','status'=>'active','is_mini_admin'=>true,
                'authority_version'=>$this->versionLocked((string)$actor['actor_id'])];
        }
        return $this->authority(array_values($staff));
    }
    private function authority(array $staff): array
    {
        return ['platform_staff'=>$staff,'staff_config_version'=>$this->versionLocked('0')];
    }

    private function versionLocked(string $user): string
    {
        $version=$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT CAST(authority_version AS CHAR) FROM chat_staff_authority_versions WHERE user_id=:id LOCK IN SHARE MODE',['id'=>$user]);
        if (!is_string($version) || preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/D',$version)!==1) throw new RuntimeException('平台聊天权限代次不可用');
        return $version;
    }
}

<?php

function chatClosureContract(Database $db,DatabaseOrderConversationBridge $bridge): void
{

        $prefix='WorkerAdmin\\';
        if (strpos($class,$prefix)!==0) return;
        $file=dirname(__DIR__).'/app/'.str_replace('\\','/',substr($class,strlen($prefix))).'.php';
        if (is_file($file)) require_once $file;
    });
    $create=static function(int $id)use($db,$bridge):void {
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO assignments(id,order_id,worker_id,status,accepted_at) VALUES(:id,:id_order,10,'accepted',UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['id'=>$id,'id_order'=>$id]);
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO orders(id,user_id,is_demo,workflow_profile,order_source_type,lifecycle_status,payment_status,assignment_status,current_assignment_id,assigned_worker_id) VALUES(:id,1,0,'construction','consumer','active','paid','accepted',:assignment,10)",['id'=>$id,'assignment'=>$id]);
        $db->transaction(static function()use($bridge,$id):void{$bridge->synchronize($id);});
        policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=:id',['id'=>$id])==='open','closure fixture starts open');
    };
    $classes=['DatabaseOrderCompletionRepository','DatabaseOrderMeasurementCompletionRepository',
        'DatabaseOrderCancellationRepository','DatabasePaidPaymentSettlement','DatabaseOrderRunEmptyRepository',
        'DatabaseOrderNegotiationRepository','DatabaseOrderDisputeRepository','DatabaseMiniAdminOrderRepository',
        'DatabaseOrderInvitationRepository','SchedulerOrderEventWriter',
        'DatabaseOrderQuoteSwitchRepository','DatabasePaymentCreationRepository'];
    foreach($classes as $index=>$class) {
        $id=1000+$index;$create($id);
        $scope='order:'.$id.':assignment:'.$id;
        $beforeEvents=(int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_business_events WHERE aggregate_key=:scope',['scope'=>$scope]);
        $db->transaction(static function(Database $db)use($class,$id):void {
            // Only notification delivery is replaced; execute each production SQL event outlet.
            $reflection=new ReflectionClass('WorkerAdmin\\Infrastructure\\Persistence\\'.$class);
            $repository=$reflection->newInstanceWithoutConstructor();
            if($class==='SchedulerOrderEventWriter') {
                $repository->record($db,$id,'fixture_closed','fixture_closure',3,[]);
            } else {
                $event=$reflection->getMethod('event');$event->setAccessible(true);
                if(in_array($class,['DatabasePaidPaymentSettlement','DatabasePaymentCreationRepository'],true)) {
                    $property=$reflection->getProperty('db');$property->setAccessible(true);$property->setValue($repository,$db);
                    $args=[$id,'fixture_closed','system',0,[]];
                } elseif($class==='DatabaseOrderNegotiationRepository') {
                    $args=[$db,['id'=>$id,'user_id'=>1],['user_id'=>1,'worker_id'=>10],'fixture_closed',[]];
                } elseif(in_array($class,['DatabaseMiniAdminOrderRepository','DatabaseOrderInvitationRepository'],true)) {
                    $args=[$db,$id,'fixture_closed',1,[]];
                } else {
                    $args=[$db,$id,'fixture_closed','system',0,[]];
                    if(in_array($class,['DatabaseOrderRunEmptyRepository','DatabaseOrderDisputeRepository'],true)) $args[]=false;
                }
                $event->invokeArgs($repository,$args);
            }
            // The event may precede final order writes. The hook must observe final state.
            $db->execute("UPDATE orders SET lifecycle_status='cancelled',assignment_status='cancelled' WHERE id=:id",['id'=>$id]);
            policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=:id',['id'=>$id])==='open','policy writes deferred to outer commit');
        });
        policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=:id',['id'=>$id])==='readonly',$class.' closes send permission');
        policyAssert((int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_business_events WHERE aggregate_key=:scope',['scope'=>$scope])===$beforeEvents+1,$class.' emits one closure');
        if($class==='SchedulerOrderEventWriter') policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT event_key FROM order_events WHERE order_id=:id',['id'=>$id])==='scheduler:fixture_closure:order:'.$id.':v3','scheduler preserves original deterministic event key');
    }
    // Actual automatic acceptance DML, including its callback-independent hook.
    $db->execute("ALTER TABLE orders ADD fulfillment_status VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'submitted',ADD version INT DEFAULT 1,ADD completion_submitted_at DATETIME NULL,ADD auto_accept_at DATETIME NULL,ADD accepted_at DATETIME NULL,ADD auto_review_at DATETIME NULL,ADD closed_at DATETIME NULL,ADD updated_at DATETIME NULL");
    $db->execute('ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD completed_orders INT DEFAULT 0,ADD updated_at DATETIME NULL');
    $db->execute('CREATE TABLE completion_submissions(order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,status VARCHAR(24),accepted_at DATETIME NULL,accepted_type VARCHAR(24),updated_at DATETIME NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB');
    $db->execute('CREATE TABLE order_deadlines(order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,deadline_type VARCHAR(40),status VARCHAR(24),version INT,due_at DATETIME,created_at DATETIME,updated_at DATETIME,block_reason TEXT,processed_at DATETIME,UNIQUE KEY(order_id,deadline_type)) ENGINE=InnoDB');
    $events=0;$finance=0;
    $record=static function(...$args)use(&$events):void{$events++;};
    $finalize=static function(...$args)use(&$finance):void{$finance++;};
    $accept=static function(int $id)use($db,$record,$finalize):void {
        $db->transaction(static function(Database $db)use($id,$record,$finalize):void {
            $order=$db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE',['id'=>$id]);
            (new OrderAutomaticAcceptanceWriter())->apply($db,$order,$record,$finalize);
        });
    };
    foreach([1100,1101] as $id) {
        $create($id);
        $db->execute("UPDATE orders SET completion_submitted_at=DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL 73 HOUR) WHERE id=:id",['id'=>$id]);
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO completion_submissions(order_id,status) VALUES(:id,'submitted')",['id'=>$id]);
    }
    $accept(1100);
    policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT lifecycle_status FROM orders WHERE id=1100')==='completed','automatic acceptance ran actual business writes');
    policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=1100')==='readonly','automatic acceptance closes even with inert event callback');
    policyAssert($events===1 && $finance===1,'existing callbacks retained, no financial provider called');
    $db->execute("CREATE TRIGGER fixture_accept_event_failure BEFORE INSERT ON chat_business_events FOR EACH ROW SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='fixture'");
    $failed=false;
    try{$accept(1101);}catch(PDOException $error){$failed=($error->errorInfo[1]??0)===1644;}
    $db->execute('DROP TRIGGER fixture_accept_event_failure');
    policyAssert($failed && $db->fetchValue('SELECT lifecycle_status FROM orders WHERE id=1101')==='active','chat failure rolls actual acceptance back');
    policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT status FROM completion_submissions WHERE order_id=1101')==='submitted','submission update rolled back with acceptance');
    policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=1101')==='open','failed acceptance leaves original guard');
    $db->execute('ALTER TABLE assignments ADD updated_at DATETIME NULL');
    $db->execute('ALTER TABLE orders ADD final_amount_cents INT DEFAULT 10000');
    $db->execute('CREATE TABLE payment_orders(order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,business_type VARCHAR(40),status VARCHAR(24),amount_cents INT) ENGINE=InnoDB');
    $db->execute('CREATE TABLE order_measurement_states(order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED PRIMARY KEY,result_status VARCHAR(24),accepted_at DATETIME,settlement_status VARCHAR(24),gross_amount_cents INT,service_rate_bp_snapshot INT,service_min_cents_snapshot INT,service_fee_cents INT,worker_net_cents INT,hold_until DATETIME,max_hold_until DATETIME,settled_at DATETIME,updated_at DATETIME) ENGINE=InnoDB');
    $db->execute('CREATE TABLE worker_balance_ledger(worker_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,entry_type VARCHAR(40),direction VARCHAR(24),amount_cents INT,available_delta_cents INT,frozen_delta_cents INT,business_type VARCHAR(40),business_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) UNIQUE,description TEXT,status VARCHAR(24),created_at DATETIME) ENGINE=InnoDB');
    foreach([1200=>'measurement_accepted',1201=>'measurement_auto_accepted'] as $id=>$type) {
        $create($id);
        $db->execute("UPDATE orders SET workflow_profile='measurement' WHERE id=:id",['id'=>$id]);
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO payment_orders VALUES(:id,'order_booking','paid',10000)",['id'=>$id]);
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO order_measurement_states(order_id,result_status) VALUES(:id,'submitted')",['id'=>$id]);
        $db->transaction(static function(Database $db)use($id,$type,$record):void {
            $order=$db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE',['id'=>$id]);
            $assignment=$db->fetch('SELECT * FROM assignments WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE',['id'=>$id]);
            $assignment['commission_rate_bp_snapshot']=1000;
            (new \WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence\OrdinaryMeasurementAcceptanceWriter())->apply($db,$order,$assignment,5,7,30,$record,$type,'fixture');
        });
        policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=:id',['id'=>$id])==='readonly',$type.' closes after assignment becomes completed');
        policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT status FROM assignments WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$id])==='completed','actual measurement assignment completion');
        policyAssert((int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT frozen_delta_cents FROM worker_balance_ledger WHERE business_id=:id',['id'=>$id])===9000,'actual isolated measurement ledger preserved');
    }
    echo "订单关闭事件出口、真实施工/测量验收与事务回滚验证通过\n";
}

<?php

/** Called only by chat_policy_contract.php with its explicit loopback test config. */
function chatAssignmentContract(array $config): void
{
    policyAssert($config['host']==='127.0.0.1' && strpos($config['database'],'bixuan_test_policy_')===0,'assignment fixture boundary');
    $config['database']='mysql';$admin=new Database($config);
    $name='bixuan_test_policy_assignment_'.bin2hex(random_bytes(5));

    $config['database']=$name;$db=new Database($config);
    try {
        (new SqlScriptRunner())->runFile($db->pdo(),dirname(__DIR__).'/database/database.sql');
        foreach([10001,10002,10003,10004] as $id)$db->execute("INSERT INTO users(id,public_id,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(:id,:public_id,'active',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['id'=>$id,'public_id'=>public_id()]);

        $db->execute("INSERT INTO orders(id,public_no,user_id,audit_status,lifecycle_status,payment_status,assignment_status,final_amount_cents,booking_fee_cents,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(77,'CHAT-ASG',10001,'approved','active','paid','accepted',20000,5000,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
        $rule=$db->insert("INSERT INTO commission_rule_versions(order_id,version_no,rate_bp,min_fee_cents,status,created_at) VALUES(77,1,1000,1000,'active',UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO assignments(id,public_id,order_id,worker_id,assignment_type,commission_rule_version_id,final_amount_cents_snapshot,booking_fee_cents_snapshot,commission_rate_bp_snapshot,commission_min_cents_snapshot,estimated_commission_cents,estimated_offline_collect_cents,estimated_net_income_cents,status,offered_at,accepted_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(100,:public_id,77,10,'admin',:rule,20000,5000,1000,1000,2000,15000,18000,'accepted',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['public_id'=>public_id(),'rule'=>$rule]);
        $db->execute("UPDATE orders SET current_assignment_id=100,assigned_worker_id=10,commission_rule_version_id=:rule WHERE id=77",['rule'=>$rule]);
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO order_role_grants(order_id,user_id,grant_type,status,created_at) VALUES(77,10002,'assignment','active',UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
        $bridge=new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true);
        $db->transaction(static function()use($bridge):void{$bridge->synchronize(77);});
        $workbench=new DatabaseAdminWorkbenchOperationsRepository($db);
        $workbench->reassignWorker(['user_id'=>10004],'CHAT-ASG',20,'fixture reassign');
        $offered=(int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT current_assignment_id FROM orders WHERE id=77');
        policyAssert($offered!==100 && $db->fetchValue('SELECT status FROM assignments WHERE id=100')==='cancelled','actual admin reassign creates a new assignment');
        policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE assignment_id=100')==='readonly','admin reassign immediately closes old worker chat');
        policyAssert((int)$db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE state='open'")===0,'new offered worker has no chat grant');
        policyAssert($db->fetchValue("SELECT status FROM order_role_grants WHERE order_id=77 AND user_id=10002")==='revoked','original order access revocation retained');
        $quote=$db->insert("INSERT INTO quotes(public_id,order_id,quote_type,worker_id,amount_cents,booking_fee_cents,status,current_version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(:public_id,77,'worker',10,20000,5000,'active',1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['public_id'=>public_id()]);
        $db->insert("INSERT INTO quote_versions(quote_id,version_no,amount_cents,booking_fee_cents,commission_rate_bp_snapshot,commission_min_cents_snapshot,rule_acknowledged_at,operator_type,created_at) VALUES(:quote,1,20000,5000,1000,1000,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'worker',UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['quote'=>$quote]);
        $db->insert("INSERT INTO payment_orders(public_no,business_type,business_id,order_id,payer_user_id,amount_cents,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES('CHAT-PAY','order_booking',77,77,10001,5000,'paid',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
        $quotePublic=(string)$db->fetchValue('SELECT public_id FROM quotes WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$quote]);

        $failed=false;try{$switch->switchWorker(['user_id'=>10001],'CHAT-ASG',$quotePublic,'fixture');}catch(PDOException $error){$failed=($error->errorInfo[1]??0)===1644;}
        $db->execute('DROP TRIGGER fixture_switch_event_failure');

        policyAssert((int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments')===$count && $db->fetchValue('SELECT status FROM assignments WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$offered])==='offered','failed switch preserves assignment history and current offer');
        $switch->switchWorker(['user_id'=>10001],'CHAT-ASG',$quotePublic,'fixture');

/** Real source tables from database.sql; no miniature imitation of staff SQL. */
function chatPlatformStaffContract(Database $db,array $config): void
{
    $staffReader=new \WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence\DatabaseChatPlatformStaff($db);
    $outside=false;try{$staffReader->readLocked();}catch(RuntimeException $error){$outside=true;}
    policyAssert($outside,'platform staff requires owning transaction');
    $write=static function(string $key,string $value,string $type='string')use($db):void{
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO system_settings(setting_key,setting_value,value_type,created_at,updated_at)
            VALUES(:key,:value,:type,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE setting_value=VALUES(setting_value),value_type=VALUES(value_type)",['key'=>$key,'value'=>$value,'type'=>$type]);
    };
    $identity=static function(int $user,string $app,string $openid,string $status='active')use($db):int{
        return $db->insert("INSERT INTO wechat_identities(user_id,app_id,openid,status,created_at,updated_at)
            VALUES(:user,:app,:openid,:status,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['user'=>$user,'app'=>$app,'openid'=>$openid,'status'=>$status]);
    };
    $read=static function()use($db,$staffReader):array{return $db->transaction(static function()use($staffReader):array{return $staffReader->readLocked();});};
    foreach([10101,10102,10103,10104] as $id)$db->execute("INSERT INTO users(id,public_id,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(:id,:public,'active',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['id'=>$id,'public'=>public_id()]);
    $write('wechat.miniapp_appid','chat-staff-app');
    $write('wechat.admin_openids','["StaffA","StaffB","Disabled","WrongApp"]','json');
    $identity(10101,'chat-staff-app','StaffA');$identity(10102,'chat-staff-app','StaffB');
    $identity(10103,'chat-staff-app','Disabled');$identity(10104,'other-app','WrongApp');
    $db->execute("UPDATE users SET status='disabled' WHERE id=10103");
    $expected=['10101','10102'];
    policyAssert(array_column($read(),'actor_id')===$expected,'only current active configured mini identities, bounded and ordered');
    $write('wechat.admin_openids'," StaffB，StaffA  StaffA\n");
    policyAssert(array_column($read(),'actor_id')===$expected,'legacy delimiter normalization matches existing mini-admin authority');
    $write('wechat.admin_openids','["StaffA","staffb"]','json');
    policyAssert(array_column($read(),'actor_id')===['10101'],'OpenID comparisons are exact, not database case folding');
    $write('wechat.admin_openids','["StaffA","StaffB"]','json');
    $newIdentity=$identity(10101,'chat-staff-app','NonAdminLatest');
    policyAssert(array_column($read(),'actor_id')===['10102'],'old configured identity cannot override latest active app identity');
    $db->execute("UPDATE wechat_identities SET status='revoked' WHERE id=:id",['id'=>$newIdentity]);
    policyAssert(array_column($read(),'actor_id')===$expected,'latest active identity matches original repository rule');
    foreach([['[["StaffA"]]','json'],['["StaffA",{}]','string'],['{"broken"','json'],['enc:v1:unusable','string'],['1','integer']] as [$value,$type]){
        $write('wechat.admin_openids',$value,$type);policyAssert($read()===[],'invalid configuration fails closed without scalar coercion');
    }
    $write('wechat.admin_openids',json_encode(range(1,9)),'json');policyAssert($read()===[],'non-string admin IDs rejected');
    $write('wechat.admin_openids',json_encode(array_map('strval',range(1,9))),'json');policyAssert($read()===[],'over-budget staff configuration cannot grant partial list');
    $write('wechat.admin_openids','["StaffA","StaffB"]','json');
    $other=new Database($config);
    $db->transaction(static function(Database $db)use($other,$staffReader):void{
        $db->fetchValue("SELECT setting_value FROM system_settings WHERE setting_key='wechat.admin_openids'");
        $other->execute("UPDATE system_settings SET setting_value='[\"StaffB\"]' WHERE setting_key='wechat.admin_openids'");
        policyAssert(array_column($staffReader->readLocked(),'actor_id')===['10102'],'configuration source bypasses stale transaction snapshots');
    });
    $write('wechat.admin_openids','["StaffA","StaffB"]','json');
    $db->transaction(static function(Database $db)use($other,$staffReader,$identity):void{
        $db->fetchValue('SELECT MAX(id) FROM wechat_identities WHERE user_id=10101');
        $other->execute("INSERT INTO wechat_identities(user_id,app_id,openid,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(10101,'chat-staff-app','NewerNonAdmin','active',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
        policyAssert(array_column($staffReader->readLocked(),'actor_id')===['10102'],'latest identity read also bypasses stale transaction snapshots');
    });
    $other->execute("UPDATE wechat_identities SET status='revoked' WHERE openid='NewerNonAdmin'");
    $other->execute('SET SESSION innodb_lock_wait_timeout=1');
    foreach([
        "UPDATE system_settings SET setting_value='[]' WHERE setting_key='wechat.admin_openids'",
        "UPDATE wechat_identities SET status='revoked' WHERE user_id=10101 AND openid='StaffA'",
        "UPDATE users SET status='disabled' WHERE id=10101",
    ] as $mutation){
        $db->transaction(static function()use($other,$staffReader,$mutation):void{
            $staffReader->readLocked();$blocked=false;
            try{$other->execute($mutation);}catch(PDOException $error){$blocked=($error->errorInfo[1]??0)===1205;}
            policyAssert($blocked,'source shared locks serialize actual staff revocation mutations');
        });
    }
    policyAssert(array_column($read(),'actor_id')===$expected,'failed concurrent mutation preserves authority');
    // Actual source/config changes are observable; integration hooks are c3.b.
    $write('wechat.admin_openids','["StaffB"]','json');
    policyAssert(array_column($read(),'actor_id')===['10102'],'removed administrator disappears immediately from fresh candidate facts');
    $db->execute("UPDATE wechat_identities SET status='revoked' WHERE user_id=10102 AND openid='StaffB'");
    policyAssert($read()===[],'revoked identity cannot create a staff candidate');
    $platformCount=(int)$db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_policy_guards g JOIN orders o ON o.id=g.order_id WHERE o.order_source_type='platform'");
    policyAssert($platformCount===0,'candidate reader never writes or grants production platform scope');
    echo "平台工作人员真实设置/微信身份/状态、最新快照及共享锁专项通过\n";
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

if ((string)getenv('V250_PLATFORM_MYSQL_TEST') !== '1') {
    fwrite(STDOUT, "[SKIP] V250 MySQL transaction regression disabled.\n");
    exit(0);
}

$root = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
require_once $root . '/server/app/Core/Database.php';

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;

function txAssert(bool $condition, string $label): void
{
    if (!$condition) {
        fwrite(STDERR, '[FAIL] ' . $label . "\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    fwrite(STDOUT, '[PASS] ' . $label . "\n");
}

$config = [
    'host'=>(string)(getenv('V250_DB_HOST') ?: '127.0.0.1'),
    'port'=>(int)(getenv('V250_DB_PORT') ?: 3306),
    'database'=>(string)(getenv('V250_DB_NAME') ?: 'worker_test'),
    'username'=>(string)(getenv('V250_DB_USER') ?: 'root'),
    'password'=>(string)(getenv('V250_DB_PASSWORD') ?: 'root'),
    'charset'=>'utf8mb4',
];

$db = new Database($config);
$db->execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS v250_transaction_probe');
$db->execute('CREATE TABLE v250_transaction_probe(id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, marker VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4');

try {
    $db->transaction(function (Database $db): void {
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO v250_transaction_probe(marker) VALUES('outer_ok')");
        $db->transaction(function (Database $db): void {
            $db->execute("INSERT INTO v250_transaction_probe(marker) VALUES('inner_ok')");
        });
    });
    txAssert((int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v250_transaction_probe') === 2, '正常嵌套事务只由最外层提交');

    $rollbackOnlyThrown = false;
    try {
        $db->transaction(function (Database $db): void {
            $db->execute("INSERT INTO v250_transaction_probe(marker) VALUES('outer_before_fail')");

    txAssert((int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v250_transaction_probe') === 2, 'rollback-only 未留下任何部分写入');

    $failed=false;

    });}catch(RuntimeException $error){$failed=$error->getMessage()==='fixture hook failure';}

    $called=0;$failed=false;

    });}catch(RuntimeException $error){$failed=true;}

            });}catch(RuntimeException $ignored){}

    $pdo1 = $db->pdo();
    $db2 = new Database($config);
    $pdo2 = $db2->pdo();

    $pdo1->beginTransaction();
