<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use Throwable;
use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\MessageOutboxRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\MessageOutboxPolicy;

final class DatabaseMessageOutboxRepository implements MessageOutboxRepository
{
    private Database $db;
    public function __construct(Database $db) { $this->db = $db; }
    public function schema(): array
    {
        try {
            $exists = (int) $this->db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='message_outbox'");
            if ($exists < 1) {
                return [
                    'ready' => false,
                    'columns' => [],
                    'message' => '消息发送记录表尚未建立，请先在系统升级页完成当前版本数据库升级。',
                ];
            }

            $columnRows = $this->db->fetchAll('SHOW COLUMNS FROM message_outbox');
            $columns = [];
            foreach ($columnRows as $columnRow) {
                $field = (string) ($columnRow['Field'] ?? $columnRow['field'] ?? '');
                if ($field !== '') $columns[$field] = true;
            }
            $required = ['id', 'topic', 'business_key', 'status'];
            $missing = array_values(array_filter($required, static function (string $field) use ($columns): bool {
                return !isset($columns[$field]);
            }));
            if ($missing) {
                \write_log('admin-message-outbox', '[' . date('c') . '] schema missing columns: ' . implode(',', $missing) . "\n");
                return [
                    'ready' => false,
                    'columns' => $columns,
                    'message' => '消息发送记录表结构与当前版本不一致，请先完成数据库升级后再查看。',
                ];
            }
            return ['ready' => true, 'columns' => $columns, 'message' => ''];
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            \write_log('admin-message-outbox', '[' . date('c') . '] schema read failed: ' . mb_substr($exception->getMessage(), 0, 500) . "\n");
            return [
                'ready' => false,
                'columns' => [],
                'message' => '消息发送记录暂时无法读取，请检查数据库升级状态后重试。',
            ];
        }
    }

    public function dashboard(string $status, string $q, int $page, string $tab = 'records'): array
    {
        $result = ['rows'=>[], 'total'=>0, 'page'=>1, 'pages'=>1, 'per_page'=>20];
        $suppressionResult = ['rows'=>[], 'total'=>0, 'page'=>1, 'pages'=>1, 'per_page'=>20];
        $failedCount = 0;
        $schema = $this->schema();
        $schemaWarning = (string) ($schema['message'] ?? '');

        if (!empty($schema['ready'])) {
            $columns = (array) ($schema['columns'] ?? []);
            $has = static function (string $field) use ($columns): bool { return isset($columns[$field]); };
            try {
                $where = ['1=1'];
                $params = [];
                if ($status !== '') {
                    $where[] = 'm.status=:status';
                    $params['status'] = $status;
                }
                if ($q !== '') {
                    $like = '%' . $q . '%';
                    $searchParts = ['CAST(m.business_key AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE :q_key'];
                    $params['q_key'] = $like;
                    if ($has('last_error')) {
                        $searchParts[] = 'CAST(m.last_error AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE :q_error';
                        $params['q_error'] = $like;
                    }
                    if ($has('payload_json')) {
                        $searchParts[] = 'CAST(m.payload_json AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE :q_payload';
                        $params['q_payload'] = $like;
                    }
                    $where[] = '(' . implode(' OR ', $searchParts) . ')';
                }

                $paidSmsReady = $this->db->tableExists('order_worker_sms_invites') && $this->db->tableExists('order_worker_sms_batches');
                $select = [
                    'm.id', 'm.topic', 'm.business_key', 'm.status',
                    $has('payload_json') ? 'm.payload_json AS _payload_json' : 'NULL AS _payload_json',
                    $has('attempt_count') ? 'm.attempt_count' : '0 AS attempt_count',
                    $has('next_attempt_at') ? 'm.next_attempt_at' : 'NULL AS next_attempt_at',
                    $has('last_error') ? 'm.last_error' : 'NULL AS last_error',
                    $has('created_at') ? 'm.created_at' : 'NULL AS created_at',
                    $has('processed_at') ? 'm.processed_at' : ($has('updated_at') ? 'm.updated_at AS processed_at' : 'NULL AS processed_at'),
                ];
                $join = '';
                if ($paidSmsReady) {
                    $select[] = 'psi.delivery_status AS paid_delivery_status';
                    $select[] = 'psi.billing_status AS paid_billing_status';
                    $select[] = 'psi.worker_name_snapshot AS paid_worker_name';
                    $select[] = 'psi.fee_cents_snapshot AS paid_fee_cents';
                    $select[] = 'psb.public_no AS paid_batch_no';
                    $join = ' LEFT JOIN order_worker_sms_invites psi ON psi.outbox_id=m.id LEFT JOIN order_worker_sms_batches psb ON psb.id=psi.batch_id';
                } else {
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_delivery_status';
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_billing_status';
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_worker_name';
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_fee_cents';
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_batch_no';
                }
                $result = $this->paginate(
                    'SELECT ' . implode(',', $select) . ' FROM message_outbox m' . $join . ' WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where) . ' ORDER BY m.id DESC',
                    'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_outbox m WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where),
                    $params, $tab === 'records' ? $page : 1
                );

                foreach ($result['rows'] as &$messageRow) {
                    $safeError = (string) ($messageRow['last_error'] ?? '');
                    $safeError = preg_replace('/(?<!\\d)1[3-9]\\d{9}(?!\\d)/', '1**********', $safeError);
                    $safeError = preg_replace('#https?://qyapi\\.weixin\\.qq\\.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send\\?key=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+#i', '企业微信 Webhook 地址已隐藏', $safeError);
                    $messageRow['last_error_display'] = mb_substr((string) $safeError, 0, 1000);
                }
                unset($messageRow);

                if ($has('attempt_count')) {
                    $failedCount = (int) $this->db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_outbox WHERE topic IN ('aliyun_sms','wecom_webhook','wechat_subscribe') AND status='failed' AND attempt_count>=5");
                }
            } catch (Throwable $exception) {
                \write_log('admin-message-outbox', '[' . date('c') . '] list read failed: ' . mb_substr($exception->getMessage(), 0, 500) . "\n");
                $result = ['rows'=>[], 'total'=>0, 'page'=>1, 'pages'=>1, 'per_page'=>20];
                $failedCount = 0;
                $schemaWarning = '消息发送记录读取失败。后台其他功能不受影响，请检查数据库升级状态或服务器日志后重试。';
            }
        }

        if($this->db->tableExists('sms_recipient_suppressions')){
            try{
                $suppressionResult=$this->paginate(
                    "SELECT id,mobile_masked,reason,note,status,created_at,updated_at FROM sms_recipient_suppressions WHERE status='active' ORDER BY id DESC",
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sms_recipient_suppressions WHERE status='active'",
                    [], $tab === 'suppressions' ? $page : 1
                );
            }catch(Throwable $exception){
                \write_log('admin-sms-suppression','['.date('c').'] list failed: '.mb_substr($exception->getMessage(),0,500)."\n");
            }
        }

        return [
            'result'=>$result,
            'suppressionResult'=>$suppressionResult,
            'status'=>$status,
            'q'=>$q,
            'failedCount'=>$failedCount,
            'schemaWarning'=>$schemaWarning,
        ];

    }

    public function retry(int $id): array
    {
        $schema = $this->schema();
        $columns = (array) ($schema['columns'] ?? []);
        if (empty($schema['ready']) || !isset($columns['attempt_count'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException((string)(($schema['message'] ?? '') ?: '消息发送记录表缺少重试字段，请先完成数据库升级。'));
        }

        $message = $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($id, $columns) {
            $row = $db->fetch('SELECT id,topic,status,attempt_count FROM message_outbox WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE', ['id' => $id]);
            MessageOutboxPolicy::requireDeadLetter($row, 'retry');
            $sets = ["status='pending'", 'attempt_count=0'];
            if (isset($columns['next_attempt_at'])) $sets[] = 'next_attempt_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()';
            if (isset($columns['last_error'])) $sets[] = 'last_error=NULL';
            if (isset($columns['processed_at'])) $sets[] = 'processed_at=NULL';
            $changed = $db->execute('UPDATE message_outbox SET ' . implode(',', $sets) . " WHERE id=:id AND status='failed' AND attempt_count>=5", ['id' => $id]);
            if ($changed !== 1) throw new RuntimeException('消息状态已变化，没有重复加入重试队列。');
            return $row;
        });
        return $message;
    }

    public function close(int $id): array
    {
        $schema = $this->schema();
        $columns = (array) ($schema['columns'] ?? []);
        if (empty($schema['ready']) || !isset($columns['attempt_count'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException((string)(($schema['message'] ?? '') ?: '消息发送记录表缺少结案所需字段，请先完成数据库升级。'));
        }

        $message = $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($id, $columns) {
            $row = $db->fetch('SELECT id,topic,status,attempt_count FROM message_outbox WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE', ['id' => $id]);
            MessageOutboxPolicy::requireDeadLetter($row, 'close');
            $sets = ["status='closed'"];
            if (isset($columns['next_attempt_at'])) $sets[] = 'next_attempt_at=NULL';
            $changed = $db->execute('UPDATE message_outbox SET ' . implode(',', $sets) . " WHERE id=:id AND status='failed' AND attempt_count>=5", ['id' => $id]);
            if ($changed !== 1) throw new RuntimeException('消息状态已变化，没有执行结案。');
            return $row;
        });
        return $message;
    }

    public function addSuppression(string $hmac, string $masked, string $reason, string $note, int $adminId): void
    {
        if(!$this->db->tableExists('sms_recipient_suppressions')){
            throw new RuntimeException('短信抑制名单表尚未建立，请先完成数据库升级。');
        }
        $this->db->execute(
            "INSERT INTO sms_recipient_suppressions
             (mobile_hmac,mobile_masked,reason,note,status,created_by_admin_id,created_at,updated_at)
             VALUES(:hmac,:masked,:reason,:note,'active',:admin,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())
             ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mobile_masked=VALUES(mobile_masked),reason=VALUES(reason),note=VALUES(note),
                                     status='active',created_by_admin_id=VALUES(created_by_admin_id),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()",
            ['hmac'=>$hmac,'masked'=>$masked,'reason'=>$reason,'note'=>$note!==''?$note:null,'admin'=>$adminId]
        );
    }

    public function removeSuppression(int $id): array
    {
        $row=$this->db->fetch('SELECT id,mobile_masked,status FROM sms_recipient_suppressions WHERE id=:id LIMIT 1',['id'=>$id]);
        if(!$row)throw new RuntimeException('抑制名单记录不存在。');
        $this->db->execute(
            "UPDATE sms_recipient_suppressions SET status='inactive',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id AND status='active'",
            ['id'=>$id]
        );
        return $row;
    }
    private function paginate($sql, $countSql, array $params, int $page)
    {
        $page=max(1,$page); $perPage=20; $total=(int)$this->db->fetchValue($countSql,$params); $pages=max(1,(int)ceil($total/$perPage)); $page=min($page,$pages); $offset=($page-1)*$perPage;
        $rows=$this->db->fetchAll($sql.' LIMIT '.$perPage.' OFFSET '.$offset,$params);
        return ['rows'=>$rows,'total'=>$total,'page'=>$page,'pages'=>$pages,'per_page'=>$perPage];
    }
}

final class DatabaseSubscriptionRepository implements SubscriptionRepository
{

    public function preferences(int $userId): array { return SubscriptionQuotaStore::subscriptionPreferences($this->db, $userId); }
    public function save(int $userId, string $key, bool $enabled, string $status): array
    { return SubscriptionQuotaStore::saveSubscriptionPreference($this->db, $userId, $key, $enabled, $status); }
    public function diagnose(int $userId): array
    {
        $where="topic='wechat_subscribe' AND JSON_VALID(payload_json) AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json,'$.user_id')) AS UNSIGNED)=:user_id";
        $pending=(int)$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_outbox WHERE ".$where." AND status IN ('pending','processing')",['user_id'=>$userId]);
        $processed24h=(int)$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_outbox WHERE ".$where." AND status='processed' AND processed_at>=DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL 1 DAY)",['user_id'=>$userId]);
        $failed24h=(int)$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_outbox WHERE ".$where." AND status='failed' AND created_at>=DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL 1 DAY)",['user_id'=>$userId]);
        $lastError=(string)($this->db->fetchValue("SELECT last_error FROM message_outbox WHERE ".$where." AND status='failed' AND last_error IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",['user_id'=>$userId])?:'');
        $lastErrorCode='';
        if($lastError!==''&&preg_match('/微信订阅消息发送失败（(\d+)）/u',$lastError,$match)===1)$lastErrorCode=(string)($match[1]??'');
        $dispatcherRecent=(int)$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduler_runs WHERE job_name='sms_dispatch' AND started_at>=DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)")>0;
        $dispatcherLast=$this->db->fetch("SELECT status,started_at,finished_at,failure_count FROM scheduler_runs WHERE job_name='sms_dispatch' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1");
        $dispatcherHealthy=$dispatcherRecent&&((string)($dispatcherLast['status']??'')==='success');
        return [
            'subscribe_enabled'=>filter_var(\setting('wechat.subscribe_enabled',true),FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN),
            'appid_configured'=>trim((string)\setting('wechat.miniapp_appid',''))!=='',
            'secret_configured'=>trim((string)\setting('wechat.miniapp_secret',''))!=='',
            'env_version'=>(string)\setting('wechat.miniapp_env_version','formal'),
            'dispatcher_recent'=>$dispatcherRecent,
            'dispatcher_healthy'=>$dispatcherHealthy,
            'dispatcher_last_status'=>(string)($dispatcherLast['status']??''),
            'dispatcher_last_at'=>(string)($dispatcherLast['started_at']??''),
            'pending_count'=>$pending,
            'processed_24h'=>$processed24h,
            'failed_24h'=>$failed24h,
            'last_failure_code'=>$lastErrorCode,
        ];

    }
}

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;
use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;

/** 自动验收事务步骤；调用者负责锁订单、到期/风险校验及任务领取。与测试限定入口共用。 */
final class OrderAutomaticAcceptanceWriter
{
    public function apply(Database $db,array $order,callable $recordEvent,callable $finalizeCommission): void
    {
        $orderId=(int)$order['id'];$businessVersion=max(1,(int)$order['version']);
        if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
            (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true))->schedule($orderId);
        }
        $updated = $db->execute(
            "UPDATE orders SET fulfillment_status='accepted',lifecycle_status='completed',auto_accept_at=COALESCE(auto_accept_at,DATE_ADD(completion_submitted_at,INTERVAL 72 HOUR)),accepted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),auto_review_at=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL 5 DAY),closed_at=COALESCE(closed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id AND accepted_at IS NULL AND lifecycle_status='active'",
            ['id' => $orderId]
        );
        if ($updated !== 1) {
            throw new RuntimeException('订单状态已变化，自动验收未写入。');
        }

        $versionAfter = (int) $order['version'] + 1;
        $db->execute(
            "UPDATE completion_submissions SET status='accepted',accepted_at=COALESCE(accepted_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),accepted_type='auto_72h',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('submitted','pending','pending_acceptance')",
            ['id' => $orderId]
        );
        $db->execute(
            "UPDATE order_deadlines SET status='completed',processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND deadline_type IN ('auto_accept','auto_accept_completion') AND status IN ('pending','blocked','claimed')",
            ['id' => $orderId]
        );
        $db->execute(
            "INSERT INTO order_deadlines(order_id,deadline_type,status,version,due_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (:order_id,'auto_review_order','pending',:version,DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL 5 DAY),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status='pending',due_at=VALUES(due_at),block_reason=NULL,processed_at=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()",
            ['order_id' => $orderId, 'version' => $versionAfter]
        );
        $recordEvent($db, $orderId, 'auto_accepted_72h', 'auto_accept_completion', $businessVersion, [
            'message' => '师傅提交完工满 72 小时，系统自动确认验收。',
        ]);
        // 三种来源共用同一订单自动验收状态机，平台单则走平台收入款与工费结算，
        // 绝不能创建普通订单佣金；与客户手动验收共用同一个资金写入器。
        if ((string)($order['order_source_type'] ?? '') === 'platform') {
            $platformTerms = $db->fetch(
                'SELECT * FROM order_platform_terms WHERE order_id=:id FOR UPDATE',
                ['id'=>$orderId]
            );
            $platformAssignment = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT * FROM assignments WHERE id=:id AND worker_id=:worker_id AND status='accepted' FOR UPDATE",
                ['id'=>$order['current_assignment_id'] ?: 0, 'worker_id'=>$order['assigned_worker_id'] ?: 0]
            );
            if (!$platformTerms || !$platformAssignment) {
                throw new RuntimeException('平台单自动验收时成交关系或结算条件不存在');
            }
            $settlement = (new PlatformOrderSettlementWriter())->apply($db, $order, $platformTerms, $platformAssignment);
            $recordEvent($db, $orderId, 'platform_auto_accepted_settlement',
                'auto_accept_platform_settlement', $businessVersion, [
                    'customer_tail_cents'=>$settlement['customer_tail_cents'],
                    'booking_paid_cents'=>$settlement['booking_paid_cents'],
                    'worker_labor_cents'=>(int)$platformTerms['worker_labor_cents'],
                    'platform_receivable_cents'=>$settlement['platform_receivable_cents'],
                    'worker_balance_credit_cents'=>$settlement['worker_balance_credit_cents'],
                    'settlement_status'=>$settlement['settlement_status'],
                ]);
        } else {
            // 普通订单仍按原流程生成/正式化服务费。
            $finalizeCommission($db,$orderId);
        }
        if(!empty($order['assigned_worker_id'])){$count=(int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE assigned_worker_id=:worker_id AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL',['worker_id'=>$order['assigned_worker_id']]);$db->execute('UPDATE worker_profiles SET completed_orders=:count,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id',['count'=>$count,'id'=>$order['assigned_worker_id']]);}
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;

/**
 * 普通测量成果确认后的统一资金与终态写入。
 *
 * 调用者负责锁定 order / measurement state / assignment，以及 actor、到期和异常阻断校验。
 */
final class OrdinaryMeasurementAcceptanceWriter
{
    /** @return array{gross_amount_cents:int,service_fee_cents:int,worker_net_cents:int,freeze_days:int,max_freeze_days:int} */
    public function apply(
        Database $db,
        array $order,
        array $assignment,
        int $autoReviewDays,
        int $freezeDays,
        int $maxFreezeDays,
        callable $recordEvent,
        string $eventType,
        string $message
    ): array {
        $orderId=(int)($order['id']??0);
        if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
            (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true))->schedule($orderId);
        }
        if($orderId<1||(string)($order['workflow_profile']??'')!=='measurement'||(string)($order['order_source_type']??'consumer')==='platform'){
            throw new RuntimeException('普通测量确认写入器收到无效订单');
        }
        if((int)($assignment['worker_id']??0)<1||(string)($assignment['status']??'')!=='accepted'){
            throw new RuntimeException('普通测量确认缺少 accepted assignment');
        }

        $gross=max(0,(int)($order['final_amount_cents']??0));
        $paid=(int)$db->fetchValue(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0)
             FROM payment_orders
             WHERE order_id=:order_id
               AND business_type IN ('order_booking','measurement_balance','measurement_change')
               AND status='paid'",
            ['order_id'=>$orderId]
        );
        if($gross<1||$paid<$gross){
            throw new RuntimeException('测量服务款尚未全部到账，不能确认');
        }

        $rate=max(0,min(10000,(int)($assignment['commission_rate_bp_snapshot']??0)));
        $minimum=max(0,(int)($assignment['commission_min_cents_snapshot']??0));
        $fee=$this->commissionAmount($gross,$rate,$minimum);
        $net=max(0,$gross-$fee);
        $autoReviewDays=max(1,min(30,$autoReviewDays));
        $freezeDays=max(1,min(36500,$freezeDays));
        $maxFreezeDays=max($freezeDays,min(36500,$maxFreezeDays));

        $updated=$db->execute(
            "UPDATE order_measurement_states
             SET result_status='accepted',
                 accepted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),
                 settlement_status='frozen',
                 gross_amount_cents=:gross,
                 service_rate_bp_snapshot=:rate,
                 service_min_cents_snapshot=:minimum,
                 service_fee_cents=:fee,
                 worker_net_cents=:net,
                 hold_until=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL {$freezeDays} DAY),
                 max_hold_until=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL {$maxFreezeDays} DAY),
                 settled_at=NULL,
                 updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
             WHERE order_id=:order_id AND result_status='submitted'",
            [
                'gross'=>$gross,
                'rate'=>$rate,
                'minimum'=>$minimum,
                'fee'=>$fee,
                'net'=>$net,
                'order_id'=>$orderId,
            ]
        );
        if($updated!==1)throw new RuntimeException('测量成果状态已变化，确认未写入');

        if($net>0){
            $db->execute(
                "INSERT IGNORE INTO worker_balance_ledger(
                    worker_id,entry_type,direction,amount_cents,available_delta_cents,frozen_delta_cents,
                    business_type,business_id,idempotency_key,description,status,created_at
                 ) VALUES(
                    :worker_id,'measurement_income_frozen','credit',:amount,0,:frozen,
                    'order_measurement',:business_id,:key,:description,'effective',UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 )",
                [
                    'worker_id'=>(int)$assignment['worker_id'],
                    'amount'=>$net,
                    'frozen'=>$net,
                    'business_id'=>$orderId,
                    'key'=>'order-measurement:'.$orderId.':frozen',
                    'description'=>$eventType==='measurement_auto_accepted'
                        ?'测量成果自动确认，净收入进入冻结余额'
                        :'测量成果确认，净收入进入冻结余额',
                ]
            );
        }

        $db->execute(
            "UPDATE assignments SET status='completed',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
             WHERE id=:id AND status='accepted'",
            ['id'=>(int)$assignment['id']]
        );
        $orderUpdated=$db->execute(
            "UPDATE orders
             SET fulfillment_status='accepted',
                 lifecycle_status='completed',
                 accepted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),
                 auto_review_at=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL {$autoReviewDays} DAY),
                 closed_at=COALESCE(closed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),
                 version=version+1,
                 updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
             WHERE id=:id AND lifecycle_status='active' AND fulfillment_status='submitted'",
            ['id'=>$orderId]
        );
        if($orderUpdated!==1)throw new RuntimeException('测量订单状态已变化，确认未写入');

        $db->insert(
            "INSERT INTO order_deadlines(order_id,deadline_type,status,version,due_at,created_at,updated_at)
             VALUES(:order_id,'auto_review','pending',:version,DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL {$autoReviewDays} DAY),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            ['order_id'=>$orderId,'version'=>(int)$order['version']+1]
        );

        $payload=[
            'gross_amount_cents'=>$gross,
            'service_fee_cents'=>$fee,
            'worker_net_cents'=>$net,
            'freeze_days'=>$freezeDays,
            'message'=>$message,
        ];
        $recordEvent($db,$orderId,$eventType,(int)$order['version']+1,$payload);

        return[
            'gross_amount_cents'=>$gross,
            'service_fee_cents'=>$fee,
            'worker_net_cents'=>$net,
            'freeze_days'=>$freezeDays,
            'max_freeze_days'=>$maxFreezeDays,
        ];
    }

    private function commissionAmount(int $amount,int $rateBp,int $minimum): int
    {
        if($amount<=0||$rateBp<=0)return 0;
        return min($amount,max((int)round($amount*$rateBp/10000,0,PHP_ROUND_HALF_UP),max(0,$minimum)));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DateTimeZone;
use Throwable;
use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\AdminWorkbenchOperationsRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Scheduling\PlatformOrderAutoPublishTask;
use WorkerAdmin\Services\OrderNotificationService;

final class DatabaseAdminWorkbenchOperationsRepository implements AdminWorkbenchOperationsRepository
{
    private Database $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db){$this->db=$db;}

    public function reassignWorker(array $actor,string $orderNo,int $workerId,string $reason):array
    {
        $miniUserId=(int)($actor['user_id']??0);
        return $this->db->transaction(function(Database $db)use($orderNo,$workerId,$reason,$miniUserId):array{
            $order=$db->fetch("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE",['public_no'=>$orderNo]);
            if(!$order)throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在','ORDER_NOT_FOUND',404);
            if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
                (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true))->schedule((int)$order['id']);
            }
            if((string)$order['lifecycle_status']!=='active'||in_array((string)$order['fulfillment_status'],['submitted','accepted'],true))throw new OrderOperationException('完工已提交、已验收或已结束的订单不能直接改派','ADMIN_REASSIGN_STAGE_BLOCKED',409);
            if(!in_array((string)($order['refund_status']??'none'),['','none'],true)
                ||(bool)$db->fetchValue("SELECT 1 FROM refunds WHERE order_id=:id AND status NOT IN ('failed','closed','cancelled','rejected') LIMIT 1",['id'=>$order['id']])
                ||(bool)$db->fetchValue("SELECT 1 FROM order_cancel_requests WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('pending','processing') LIMIT 1",['id'=>$order['id']]))throw new OrderOperationException('订单正在取消或退款处理中，不能直接改派','ADMIN_REASSIGN_FINANCE_BLOCKED',409);
            if((bool)$db->fetchValue("SELECT 1 FROM change_requests WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('pending','processing','negotiating') LIMIT 1",['id'=>$order['id']]))throw new OrderOperationException('订单存在待确认的费用调整，请先处理后再改派','ADMIN_REASSIGN_CHANGE_BLOCKED',409);
            if((string)($order['order_source_type']??'')==='platform'){$settlement=(string)$db->fetchValue('SELECT settlement_status FROM order_platform_terms WHERE order_id=:id LIMIT 1',['id'=>$order['id']]);if($settlement!==''&&$settlement!=='pending')throw new OrderOperationException('平台单已进入结算阶段，不能直接改派','ADMIN_REASSIGN_SETTLEMENT_BLOCKED',409);}

            $assignmentId=(int)($order['current_assignment_id']??0);
            $old=$assignmentId>0?$db->fetch("SELECT a.*,w.user_id old_worker_user_id,w.display_name old_worker_name FROM assignments a JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.id=a.worker_id WHERE a.id=:id AND a.order_id=:order_id FOR UPDATE",['id'=>$assignmentId,'order_id'=>$order['id']]):null;
            if(!$old||!in_array((string)$old['status'],['offered','accepted'],true))throw new OrderOperationException('当前没有可改派的有效师傅指派','ADMIN_REASSIGN_ASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED',409);
            if((int)$old['worker_id']===$workerId)throw new OrderOperationException('请选择另一位师傅','ADMIN_REASSIGN_SAME_WORKER',409);

            $worker=$db->fetch("SELECT w.id,w.user_id,w.public_id,w.display_name,w.verification_status,w.cloud_record_mode,u.status user_status FROM worker_profiles w JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id WHERE w.id=:id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",['id'=>$workerId]);
            if(!$worker||(string)$worker['verification_status']!=='approved'||(string)$worker['user_status']!=='active')throw new OrderOperationException('新师傅不存在、未审核通过或账号不可用','ADMIN_REASSIGN_WORKER_UNAVAILABLE',422);
            $orderIsDemo=!empty($order['is_demo']);$workerIsDemo=(string)($worker['cloud_record_mode']??'')==='demo_local';if($orderIsDemo!==$workerIsDemo)throw new OrderOperationException('演示与真实数据环境不能互相改派','DEMO_DATA_BOUNDARY',403);
            $measurementWorker=$db->fetchValue("SELECT worker_id FROM order_relations WHERE child_order_id=:id AND relation_type='measurement_construction' AND status='active' LIMIT 1",['id'=>$order['id']]);
            if($measurementWorker!==false&&(int)$measurementWorker!==$workerId)throw new OrderOperationException('关联测量单施工仍绑定原测量师傅；如需更换请新建普通施工单','MEASUREMENT_WORKER_BOUND',409);

            $db->execute("UPDATE assignments SET status='cancelled',cancelled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id AND status IN ('offered','accepted')",['id'=>$old['id']]);
            $db->insert("INSERT INTO assignment_history(assignment_id,order_id,worker_id,action,reason,actor_type,actor_id,snapshot_json,created_at) VALUES(:assignment_id,:order_id,:worker_id,'reassigned',:reason,'mini_admin',:actor_id,:snapshot,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",[
                'assignment_id'=>$old['id'],'order_id'=>$order['id'],'worker_id'=>$old['worker_id'],'reason'=>$reason,'actor_id'=>$miniUserId,'snapshot'=>$this->json(['reassigned_to_worker_id'=>$workerId])
            ]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE order_role_grants SET status='revoked',revoked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:order_id AND user_id=:user_id AND status='active'",['order_id'=>$order['id'],'user_id'=>$old['old_worker_user_id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE order_worker_contact_reveal_requests SET status='cancelled',review_note='订单已由管理员改派其他师傅',reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:order_id AND worker_id=:worker_id AND status='pending'",['order_id'=>$order['id'],'worker_id'=>$old['worker_id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE invite_tokens SET status='revoked' WHERE order_id=:order_id AND status IN ('active','claimed')",['order_id'=>$order['id']]);

            $acceptHours=max(1,min(72,(int)(function_exists('setting')?\setting('order.assignment_accept_hours',24):24)));
            $newAssignmentId=$db->insert("INSERT INTO assignments(public_id,order_id,worker_id,quote_id,assignment_type,commission_rule_version_id,final_amount_cents_snapshot,booking_fee_cents_snapshot,commission_rate_bp_snapshot,commission_min_cents_snapshot,estimated_commission_cents,estimated_offline_collect_cents,estimated_net_income_cents,status,offered_at,accept_deadline_at,created_by_admin_id,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(:public_id,:order_id,:worker_id,NULL,'admin',:rule_id,:final_amount,:booking_fee,:rate,:minimum,:commission,:offline,:net,'offered',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL {$acceptHours} HOUR),NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",[
                'public_id'=>\public_id(),'order_id'=>$order['id'],'worker_id'=>$workerId,'rule_id'=>$old['commission_rule_version_id']?:null,'final_amount'=>$old['final_amount_cents_snapshot'],'booking_fee'=>$old['booking_fee_cents_snapshot'],'rate'=>$old['commission_rate_bp_snapshot'],'minimum'=>$old['commission_min_cents_snapshot'],'commission'=>$old['estimated_commission_cents'],'offline'=>$old['estimated_offline_collect_cents'],'net'=>$old['estimated_net_income_cents']
            ]);
            $db->insert("INSERT INTO assignment_history(assignment_id,order_id,worker_id,action,reason,actor_type,actor_id,snapshot_json,created_at) VALUES(:assignment_id,:order_id,:worker_id,'offered',:reason,'mini_admin',:actor_id,:snapshot,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",[
                'assignment_id'=>$newAssignmentId,'order_id'=>$order['id'],'worker_id'=>$workerId,'reason'=>$reason,'actor_id'=>$miniUserId,'snapshot'=>$this->json(['reassigned_from_worker_id'=>(int)$old['worker_id'],'requires_worker_acceptance'=>true])
            ]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE orders SET current_assignment_id=:assignment_id,assigned_worker_id=:worker_id,assignment_status='offered',fulfillment_status='not_started',contact_revealed_at=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id",['assignment_id'=>$newAssignmentId,'worker_id'=>$workerId,'id'=>$order['id']]);

            $eventKey='admin-reassign:'.$order['id'].':'.$newAssignmentId;
            $payload=['message'=>'平台已改派师傅；新师傅仍需本人确认接单','old_worker_id'=>(int)$old['worker_id'],'old_worker_name'=>(string)$old['old_worker_name'],'new_worker_id'=>$workerId,'new_worker_name'=>(string)$worker['display_name'],'reason'=>$reason,'operator_user_id'=>$miniUserId,'notify_recipients'=>['user','worker']];
            $db->insert("INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(:order_id,'worker_replaced_by_admin',:event_key,'mini_admin',:actor_id,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['order_id'=>$order['id'],'event_key'=>substr($eventKey,0,128),'actor_id'=>$miniUserId,'payload'=>$this->json($payload)]);
            OrderNotificationService::queue($db,(int)$order['id'],$eventKey,'worker_replaced_by_admin',$payload);

            $oldNoticeData=$this->json(['order_id'=>(int)$order['id'],'event_key'=>$eventKey,'reassigned_to_worker_id'=>$workerId]);
            $oldNoticeExists=$db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE recipient_type='worker' AND recipient_id=:worker_id AND channel='in_app' AND template_key='worker_replaced_by_admin_old' AND BINARY data_json=BINARY :data LIMIT 1",['worker_id'=>$old['worker_id'],'data'=>$oldNoticeData]);
            if(!$oldNoticeExists){
                $db->insert("INSERT INTO notifications(public_id,recipient_type,recipient_id,channel,template_key,title,content,data_json,status,scheduled_at,created_at) VALUES(:public_id,'worker',:worker_id,'in_app','worker_replaced_by_admin_old','订单已由平台改派',:content,:data,'pending',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",[
                    'public_id'=>\public_id(),'worker_id'=>$old['worker_id'],'content'=>'订单 '.(string)$order['public_no'].' 已由平台改派其他师傅，本单访问权限已收回。原因：'.mb_substr($reason,0,120),'data'=>$oldNoticeData,
                ]);
            }
            return ['order_id'=>(string)$order['public_no'],'assignment_id'=>$newAssignmentId,'old_worker'=>['id'=>(int)$old['worker_id'],'name'=>(string)$old['old_worker_name']],'new_worker'=>['id'=>$workerId,'name'=>(string)$worker['display_name']],'assignment_status'=>'offered','requires_worker_acceptance'=>true];
        });
    }

    public function interveneRepair(array $actor,string $orderNo,string $afterSaleNo,string $reason):array
    {
        $miniUserId=(int)($actor['user_id']??0);
        return $this->db->transaction(function(Database $db)use($orderNo,$afterSaleNo,$reason,$miniUserId):array{
            $order=$db->fetch('SELECT id,public_no,version FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE',['public_no'=>$orderNo]);if(!$order)throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在','ORDER_NOT_FOUND',404);
            $repair=$db->fetch("SELECT id,public_no,status,resolution FROM after_sales WHERE order_id=:order_id AND BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no AND type='warranty_repair' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",['order_id'=>$order['id'],'public_no'=>$afterSaleNo]);
            if(!$repair||!in_array((string)$repair['status'],['open','processing'],true))throw new OrderOperationException('维修申请不存在或已结束','REPAIR_NOT_ACTIVE',409);
            $already=strpos((string)($repair['resolution']??''),'平台主动介入：')===0||(bool)$db->fetchValue("SELECT 1 FROM order_events WHERE order_id=:order_id AND event_type='repair_platform_intervention_started' AND payload_json LIKE :needle LIMIT 1",['order_id'=>$order['id'],'needle'=>'%\"after_sale_id\":\"'.$afterSaleNo.'\"%']);
            if($already)return ['order_id'=>$orderNo,'after_sale_id'=>$afterSaleNo,'status'=>'processing','already_intervened'=>true];
            $db->execute("UPDATE after_sales SET status='processing',resolution=:resolution,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id",['resolution'=>'平台主动介入：'.$reason,'id'=>$repair['id']]);
            $db->execute('UPDATE orders SET updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $eventKey='admin-repair-intervention:'.$repair['id'];$payload=['after_sale_id'=>$afterSaleNo,'reason'=>$reason,'message'=>'平台已主动介入本次维修售后','operator_user_id'=>$miniUserId,'notify_recipients'=>['user','worker']];
            $db->insert("INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(:order_id,'repair_platform_intervention_started',:event_key,'mini_admin',:actor_id,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['order_id'=>$order['id'],'event_key'=>$eventKey,'actor_id'=>$miniUserId,'payload'=>$this->json($payload)]);
            OrderNotificationService::queue($db,(int)$order['id'],$eventKey,'repair_platform_intervention_started',$payload);
            return ['order_id'=>$orderNo,'after_sale_id'=>$afterSaleNo,'status'=>'processing','already_intervened'=>false];
        });
    }

    public function retryPlatformAutoPublish(array $actor,string $orderNo,string $sourceId):array
    {
        $order=$this->db->fetch("SELECT id,public_no,order_source_type,publish_status FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no LIMIT 1",['public_no'=>$orderNo]);
        if(!$order)throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在','ORDER_NOT_FOUND',404);if((string)$order['order_source_type']!=='platform')throw new OrderOperationException('只有平台承接单支持自动发布恢复','AUTO_PUBLISH_RETRY_NOT_PLATFORM',409);
        $failure=$this->db->fetch("SELECT id FROM scheduled_job_failures WHERE job_name='platform_auto_publish' AND business_key=:business_key AND resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",['business_key'=>'order:'.(int)$order['id']]);
        if($sourceId!==''&&$failure&&ctype_digit($sourceId)&&(int)$failure['id']!==(int)$sourceId)throw new OrderOperationException('该失败事项已经变化，请刷新后重试','ADMIN_RETRY_STALE_TASK',409);
        $result=(new PlatformOrderAutoPublishTask($this->db,1))->retryOrder((int)$order['id']);if(empty($result['ok']))throw new OrderOperationException((string)($result['message']??'当前条件仍不满足自动发布'),'ADMIN_RETRY_NOT_READY',409);
        $this->internalRevision((int)$order['id'],'admin_internal_recovery',(int)($actor['user_id']??0),['note'=>'管理员手动重新检查平台自动发布','result'=>(string)($result['status']??'')]);
        return ['order_id'=>$orderNo]+$result;
    }

    public function addInternalFollowup(array $actor,string $orderNo,string $note,?string $followUpAt):array
    {
        $order=$this->db->fetch('SELECT id,public_no FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no LIMIT 1',['public_no'=>$orderNo]);if(!$order)throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在','ORDER_NOT_FOUND',404);
        $utc=$this->normalizeFollowupTime($followUpAt);$revisionId=$this->internalRevision((int)$order['id'],'admin_internal_followup',(int)($actor['user_id']??0),['note'=>$note,'follow_up_at'=>$utc]);
        return ['order_id'=>$orderNo,'followup_event_id'=>$revisionId,'note'=>$note,'follow_up_at'=>$utc,'completed'=>false];
    }

    public function completeInternalFollowup(array $actor,string $orderNo,int $followupEventId,string $note):array
    {
        $order=$this->db->fetch('SELECT id,public_no FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no LIMIT 1',['public_no'=>$orderNo]);if(!$order)throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在','ORDER_NOT_FOUND',404);
        $followup=$this->db->fetch("SELECT id FROM order_revisions WHERE id=:id AND order_id=:order_id AND operator_type='mini_admin' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(changes_json,'$.kind'))='admin_internal_followup' LIMIT 1",['id'=>$followupEventId,'order_id'=>$order['id']]);
        if(!$followup)throw new OrderOperationException('跟进事项不存在','ADMIN_FOLLOWUP_NOT_FOUND',404);
        $completed=(bool)$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT 1 FROM order_revisions WHERE order_id=:order_id AND operator_type='mini_admin' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(changes_json,'$.completed_of')) AS UNSIGNED)=:completed_of LIMIT 1",['order_id'=>$order['id'],'completed_of'=>$followupEventId]);
        if(!$completed)$this->internalRevision((int)$order['id'],'admin_internal_followup_completed',(int)($actor['user_id']??0),['completed_of'=>$followupEventId,'note'=>$note]);
        return ['order_id'=>$orderNo,'followup_event_id'=>$followupEventId,'completed'=>true];
    }

    public function workerOptions(string $orderNo,string $keyword,int $limit):array
    {
        $order=$this->db->fetch('SELECT id,is_demo,assigned_worker_id FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no LIMIT 1',['public_no'=>$orderNo]);if(!$order)throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在','ORDER_NOT_FOUND',404);
        $limit=max(1,min(50,$limit));$params=[];$where=["w.verification_status='approved'","u.status='active'",!empty($order['is_demo'])?"w.cloud_record_mode='demo_local'":"COALESCE(w.cloud_record_mode,'')<>'demo_local'"];
        if($keyword!==''){$where[]='(w.display_name LIKE :q_name OR w.public_id LIKE :q_public OR w.mobile_masked LIKE :q_mobile)';$like='%'.mb_substr($keyword,0,50).'%';$params=['q_name'=>$like,'q_public'=>$like,'q_mobile'=>$like];}
        $rows=$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT w.id,w.public_id,w.display_name,w.mobile_masked,w.verification_status FROM worker_profiles w JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id WHERE ".implode(' AND ',$where)." ORDER BY (w.id=:current_worker) DESC,w.id DESC LIMIT {$limit}",$params+['current_worker'=>(int)($order['assigned_worker_id']??0)]);
        foreach($rows as &$row){$row['id']=(int)$row['id'];$row['is_current']=$row['id']===(int)($order['assigned_worker_id']??0);}unset($row);return $rows;
    }

    public function internalFollowups(string $orderNo,int $limit):array
    {
        $orderId=(int)$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT id FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no LIMIT 1',['public_no'=>$orderNo]);if($orderId<1)throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在','ORDER_NOT_FOUND',404);$limit=max(1,min(50,$limit));
        $rows=$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT r.id,r.changes_json,r.created_at,r.operator_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_revisions c WHERE c.order_id=r.order_id AND c.operator_type='mini_admin' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.changes_json,'$.completed_of')) AS UNSIGNED)=r.id) completed FROM order_revisions r WHERE r.order_id=:order_id AND r.operator_type='mini_admin' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.changes_json,'$.kind'))='admin_internal_followup' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT {$limit}",['order_id'=>$orderId]);
        $items=[];$now=time();foreach($rows as $row){$payload=json_decode((string)$row['changes_json'],true);if(!is_array($payload))$payload=[];$followAt=trim((string)($payload['follow_up_at']??''));$ts=$followAt!==''?strtotime($followAt.' UTC'):false;$items[]=['id'=>(int)$row['id'],'note'=>(string)($payload['note']??''),'follow_up_at'=>$followAt?:null,'created_at'=>(string)$row['created_at'],'operator_user_id'=>(int)($row['operator_id']??0),'completed'=>(bool)$row['completed'],'due'=>!(bool)$row['completed']&&$ts!==false&&$ts<=$now];}return $items;
    }

    private function normalizeFollowupTime(?string $value):?string
    {
        $value=trim((string)$value);if($value==='')return null;try{$timezone=(string)(function_exists('app_config')?\app_config('app.timezone','Asia/Shanghai'):'Asia/Shanghai');return(new DateTimeImmutable($value,new DateTimeZone($timezone)))->setTimezone(new DateTimeZone('UTC'))->format('Y-m-d H:i:s');}catch(Throwable $e){throw new OrderOperationException('跟进时间格式不正确','ADMIN_FOLLOWUP_TIME_INVALID',422);}
    }

    private function internalRevision(int $orderId,string $kind,int $actorId,array $payload):int
    {
        $version=(int)$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT version FROM orders WHERE id=:id LIMIT 1',['id'=>$orderId]);$changes=['kind'=>$kind]+$payload+['visibility'=>'internal'];
        return $this->db->insert("INSERT INTO order_revisions(order_id,version_before,version_after,changes_json,reason,operator_type,operator_id,created_at) VALUES(:order_id,:version_before,:version_after,:changes,:reason,'mini_admin',:operator_id,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['order_id'=>$orderId,'version_before'=>$version,'version_after'=>$version,'changes'=>$this->json($changes),'reason'=>$kind==='admin_internal_followup'?'管理员内部跟进':($kind==='admin_internal_followup_completed'?'管理员完成内部跟进':'管理员恢复操作'),'operator_id'=>$actorId]);
    }

    private function json(array $payload):string{$json=json_encode($payload,JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);return is_string($json)?$json:'{}';}
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\OrderQuoteSwitchRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
use WorkerAdmin\Services\OrderNotificationService;

/** 开工前更换已报价师傅；不产生新的报价金额，也不修改真实预约费支付记录。 */
final class DatabaseOrderQuoteSwitchRepository implements OrderQuoteSwitchRepository
{
    private Database $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    public function switchWorker(array $actor, string $orderPublicNo, string $quotePublicId, string $reason): array
    {
        $order = $this->db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no LIMIT 1', ['public_no'=>$orderPublicNo]);
        if (!$order || (int)$order['user_id'] !== (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0)) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('只能更换自己订单的师傅', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
        }
        if ((string)($order['order_source_type'] ?? '') === 'platform') {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单由平台安排履约师傅，客户不能直接更换', 'PLATFORM_ORDER_ADMIN_ASSIGNS_WORKER', 409);
        }
        if ((string)($order['workflow_profile'] ?? 'construction') === 'measurement') {
            throw new OrderOperationException('测量成交后不直接更换师傅，如无法继续请走售后处理', 'MEASUREMENT_SWITCH_REQUIRES_AFTERSALE', 409);
        }

        $result = $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$order,$quotePublicId,$reason): array {
            $locked = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            if (!$locked || $locked['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active' || $locked['payment_status'] !== 'paid'
                || empty($locked['current_assignment_id']) || empty($locked['assigned_worker_id'])) {
                throw new RuntimeException('当前订单不满足更换师傅条件');
            }
            if ((string)($locked['order_source_type'] ?? '') === 'platform') throw new RuntimeException('平台承接单由平台安排履约师傅');
            if (in_array((string)$locked['fulfillment_status'], ['scheduled','in_progress','submitted','accepted'], true)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('已预约、开工或完工后不能直接更换师傅，请联系平台介入');
            }
            if ($db->fetchValue('SELECT id FROM appointment_records WHERE order_id=:id LIMIT 1', ['id'=>$locked['id']])
                || $db->fetchValue('SELECT id FROM change_requests WHERE order_id=:id LIMIT 1', ['id'=>$locked['id']])
                || $db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM disputes WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('open','processing') LIMIT 1", ['id'=>$locked['id']])) {
                throw new RuntimeException('订单已产生预约、费用变更或争议，不能直接更换师傅，请联系平台处理');
            }

            $bookingPayment = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT id,public_no,amount_cents FROM payment_orders
                 WHERE order_id=:order_id AND business_type='order_booking' AND status='paid'
                 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['order_id'=>$locked['id']]
            );
            if (!$bookingPayment) throw new RuntimeException('真实预约费支付记录不存在，暂不能更换师傅');

            $old = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT * FROM assignments WHERE id=:id AND order_id=:order_id AND status IN ('offered','accepted') LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['id'=>$locked['current_assignment_id'],'order_id'=>$locked['id']]
            );
            if (!$old) throw new RuntimeException('原师傅指派状态已变化，请刷新后重试');

            $quote = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT q.*,qv.id quote_version_id,qv.commission_rate_bp_snapshot,qv.commission_min_cents_snapshot,qv.rule_acknowledged_at
                 FROM quotes q
                 JOIN quote_versions qv ON qv.quote_id=q.id AND qv.version_no=q.current_version
                 WHERE q.order_id=:order_id AND BINARY q.public_id=BINARY :public_id
                   AND q.quote_type='worker' AND q.worker_id IS NOT NULL AND q.worker_id<>:old_worker
                   AND q.status IN ('active','closed') LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['order_id'=>$locked['id'],'public_id'=>$quotePublicId,'old_worker'=>$old['worker_id']]
            );
            if (!$quote) throw new RuntimeException('请选择该订单中另一位已报价师傅');

            $worker = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT w.id,w.verification_status,u.status user_status
                 FROM worker_profiles w JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id
                 WHERE w.id=:worker_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['worker_id'=>$quote['worker_id']]
            );
            if (!$worker || (string)$worker['verification_status'] !== 'approved' || (string)$worker['user_status'] !== 'active') {
                throw new RuntimeException('新师傅当前已不具备接单资格，请选择其他报价');
            }

            $rate = $quote['rule_acknowledged_at'] ? (int)$quote['commission_rate_bp_snapshot'] : (int)$locked['commission_rate_bp'];
            $minimum = $quote['rule_acknowledged_at'] ? (int)$quote['commission_min_cents_snapshot'] : (int)$locked['commission_min_cents'];
            $amount = (int)$quote['amount_cents'];
            $booking = min($amount, (int)$locked['booking_fee_cents'], (int)$bookingPayment['amount_cents']);
            $commission = $this->commissionAmount($amount, $rate, $minimum);
            $ruleId = $this->ensureRuleVersion($db, $locked, $rate, $minimum);

            $db->execute("UPDATE assignments SET status='cancelled',cancelled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id", ['id'=>$old['id']]);
            $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO assignment_history(assignment_id,order_id,worker_id,action,reason,actor_type,actor_id,created_at)
                 VALUES(:assignment_id,:order_id,:worker_id,'cancelled',:reason,'user',:actor_id,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                ['assignment_id'=>$old['id'],'order_id'=>$locked['id'],'worker_id'=>$old['worker_id'],'reason'=>'用户更换师傅：'.$reason,'actor_id'=>$actor['user_id']]
            );
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE order_role_grants g JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.user_id=g.user_id
                 SET g.status='revoked',g.revoked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE g.order_id=:order_id AND g.status='active' AND w.id=:worker_id",
                ['order_id'=>$locked['id'],'worker_id'=>$old['worker_id']]
            );
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE quotes
                 SET status=CASE WHEN id=:new_id THEN 'selected' WHEN id=:old_id THEN 'closed' ELSE status END,
                     selected_at=CASE WHEN id=:new_time THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP() ELSE selected_at END,
                     updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE order_id=:order_id",
                ['new_id'=>$quote['id'],'old_id'=>$old['quote_id'] ?: 0,'new_time'=>$quote['id'],'order_id'=>$locked['id']]
            );
            $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO quote_selections(order_id,quote_id,quote_version_id,user_id,amount_cents_snapshot,booking_fee_cents_snapshot,status,payment_expires_at,selected_at,confirmed_at)
                 VALUES(:order_id,:quote_id,:version_id,:user_id,:amount,:booking,'confirmed',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                ['order_id'=>$locked['id'],'quote_id'=>$quote['id'],'version_id'=>$quote['quote_version_id'],'user_id'=>$actor['user_id'],'amount'=>$amount,'booking'=>$booking]
            );

            // 先按旧成交关系生成旧师傅通知，再切换订单当前师傅。
            OrderNotificationService::queue(
                $db,(int)$locked['id'],'worker-switch-old:'.$old['id'],'worker_replaced_by_user',
                ['reason'=>$reason,'role'=>'old_worker','notify_recipients'=>['worker']]
            );

            $assignmentPublicId = \public_id();
            $assignmentId = $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO assignments(public_id,order_id,worker_id,quote_id,assignment_type,commission_rule_version_id,
                    final_amount_cents_snapshot,booking_fee_cents_snapshot,commission_rate_bp_snapshot,commission_min_cents_snapshot,
                    estimated_commission_cents,estimated_offline_collect_cents,estimated_net_income_cents,status,offered_at,accept_deadline_at,created_at,updated_at)
                 VALUES(:public_id,:order_id,:worker_id,:quote_id,'worker_quote',:rule_id,:amount,:booking,:rate,:minimum,:commission,:offline,:net,'offered',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                [
                    'public_id'=>$assignmentPublicId,'order_id'=>$locked['id'],'worker_id'=>$quote['worker_id'],'quote_id'=>$quote['id'],'rule_id'=>$ruleId,
                    'amount'=>$amount,'booking'=>$booking,'rate'=>$rate,'minimum'=>$minimum,'commission'=>$commission,
                    'offline'=>max(0,$amount-$booking),'net'=>$amount-$commission,
                ]
            );
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET selected_quote_id=:quote_id,final_amount_cents=:amount,assigned_worker_id=:worker_id,current_assignment_id=:assignment_id,
                        commission_rule_version_id=:rule_id,assignment_status='offered',contact_revealed_at=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id",
                ['quote_id'=>$quote['id'],'amount'=>$amount,'worker_id'=>$quote['worker_id'],'assignment_id'=>$assignmentId,'rule_id'=>$ruleId,'id'=>$locked['id']]
            );
            $this->autoAcceptWorkerQuoteAssignment(
                $db,(int)$locked['id'],$assignmentId,(int)$quote['worker_id'],$ruleId,
                '用户选择另一位已报价师傅，报价即视为承接意愿',(int)$actor['user_id']
            );
            $this->event($db, (int)$locked['id'], 'worker_replaced_by_user', 'user', (int)$actor['user_id'], [
                'old_worker_id'=>(int)$old['worker_id'],'new_worker_id'=>(int)$quote['worker_id'],'reason'=>$reason,
                'quote_id'=>(string)$quote['public_id'],'booking_payment_no'=>(string)$bookingPayment['public_no'],
                'message'=>'用户在开工前更换已报价师傅，新师傅按其报价意愿自动接单；旧师傅后续订单访问权已撤销。',
            ]);
            return ['assignment_id'=>$assignmentPublicId,'quote_id'=>(string)$quote['public_id'],'amount_cents'=>$amount];
        });

        return [
            'message'=>'已更换师傅，新师傅已按报价意愿自动接单；原师傅后续订单访问权限已撤销',
            'data'=>$result,
        ];
    }

    /** @param array<string,mixed> $order */
    private function ensureRuleVersion(Database $db, array $order, int $rate, int $minimum): int
    {
        $ruleId = (int)($order['commission_rule_version_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($ruleId > 0 && $db->fetchValue('SELECT id FROM commission_rule_versions WHERE id=:id AND order_id=:order_id LIMIT 1', ['id'=>$ruleId,'order_id'=>$order['id']])) {
            return $ruleId;
        }
        $version = 1 + (int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0) FROM commission_rule_versions WHERE order_id=:order_id', ['order_id'=>$order['id']]);
        return $db->insert(
            "INSERT INTO commission_rule_versions(order_id,version_no,rate_bp,min_fee_cents,adjustment_type,status,locked_at,created_at)
             VALUES(:order_id,:version,:rate,:minimum,'default','active',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            ['order_id'=>$order['id'],'version'=>$version,'rate'=>$rate,'minimum'=>$minimum]
        );
    }

    private function autoAcceptWorkerQuoteAssignment(Database $db, int $orderId, int $assignmentId, int $workerId, int $ruleId, string $reason, int $actorUserId): void
    {
        $assignment = $db->fetch(
            "SELECT * FROM assignments WHERE id=:id AND order_id=:order_id AND worker_id=:worker_id FOR UPDATE",
            ['id'=>$assignmentId,'order_id'=>$orderId,'worker_id'=>$workerId]
        );
        if (!$assignment || $assignment['assignment_type'] !== 'worker_quote') throw new RuntimeException('师傅报价指派不存在或状态异常');
        if ($assignment['status'] !== 'offered') throw new RuntimeException('师傅报价指派状态已变化');
        $db->execute("UPDATE assignments SET status='accepted',accepted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),accept_deadline_at=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id", ['id'=>$assignmentId]);
        $db->execute(
            "UPDATE orders SET assigned_worker_id=:worker_id,current_assignment_id=:assignment_id,assignment_status='accepted',publish_status='hidden',
                    contact_revealed_at=COALESCE(contact_revealed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:order_id",
            ['worker_id'=>$workerId,'assignment_id'=>$assignmentId,'order_id'=>$orderId]
        );
        if ($ruleId > 0) $db->execute('UPDATE commission_rule_versions SET locked_at=COALESCE(locked_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()) WHERE id=:id', ['id'=>$ruleId]);
        $db->execute("UPDATE assignments SET status='cancelled',cancelled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:order_id AND id<>:id AND status='offered'", ['order_id'=>$orderId,'id'=>$assignmentId]);
        $db->insert(
            "INSERT INTO assignment_history(assignment_id,order_id,worker_id,action,reason,actor_type,actor_id,created_at)
             VALUES(:assignment_id,:order_id,:worker_id,'accepted',:reason,'system',:actor_id,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            ['assignment_id'=>$assignmentId,'order_id'=>$orderId,'worker_id'=>$workerId,'reason'=>$reason,'actor_id'=>$actorUserId]
        );
        $this->event($db, $orderId, 'assignment_auto_accepted', 'system', 0, ['worker_id'=>$workerId,'source'=>'worker_quote','message'=>$reason]);
        OrderNotificationService::queue($db, $orderId, 'worker-quote-auto-accepted:'.$assignmentId, 'assignment_accepted', ['auto_accepted'=>1,'source'=>'worker_quote']);
    }

    private function commissionAmount(int $amount, int $rateBp, int $minimum): int
    {
        if ($amount <= 0) return 0;
        return min($amount, max((int)round($amount * $rateBp / 10000, 0, PHP_ROUND_HALF_UP), max(0,$minimum)));
    }

    /** @param array<string,mixed> $payload */
    private function event(Database $db, int $orderId, string $type, string $actorType, int $actorId, array $payload): void
    {
        if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
            (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true))->schedule($orderId);
        }
        $json = json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $db->insert(
            "INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at)
             VALUES(:order_id,:type,:event_key,:actor_type,:actor_id,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            [
                'order_id'=>$orderId,'type'=>$type,'event_key'=>$type.':'.$orderId.':'.bin2hex(random_bytes(6)),
                'actor_type'=>$actorType,'actor_id'=>$actorId > 0 ? $actorId : null,'payload'=>is_string($json) ? $json : '{}',
            ]
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Scheduling;

use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Safety\TestingEnvironmentPolicy;
use WorkerAdmin\Services\OrderNotificationService;

/**
 * 派单/抢单占位超时的单笔正式处理器。
 *
 * 生产 scheduler 负责扫描候选，本类只锁定并处理一个 assignment。
 * testing 入口必须绑定一个 built test_instance，且只允许 demo 非审核样例订单。
 */
final class AssignmentTimeoutProcessor
{
    private Database $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db)
    {
        $this->db=$db;
    }

    public function expireProduction(int $assignmentId): bool
    {
        if($assignmentId<1)return false;
        return $this->expire($assignmentId,0,null);
    }

    /** @return array<string,mixed> */
    public function expireTestInstance(int $instanceId,bool $advanceClock=true): array
    {
        if(!TestingEnvironmentPolicy::active())throw new RuntimeException('派单超时实例执行只允许 testing 环境');
        if($instanceId<1)throw new RuntimeException('测试实例无效');

        $target=$this->db->fetch(
            "SELECT ti.id instance_id,ti.order_id,ti.order_no_snapshot,ti.scenario_key,ti.build_status,ti.archived_at,ti.deleted_at,
                    o.public_no,o.is_demo,o.current_assignment_id,o.lifecycle_status,
                    a.id assignment_id,a.status assignment_status,a.assignment_type,a.offered_at,a.accept_deadline_at
             FROM test_instances ti
             JOIN orders o ON o.id=ti.order_id
             JOIN assignments a ON a.id=o.current_assignment_id AND a.order_id=o.id
             WHERE ti.id=:instance
             LIMIT 1",
            ['instance'=>$instanceId]
        );
        if(!$target
            ||(string)$target['build_status']!=='built'
            ||!empty($target['archived_at'])
            ||!empty($target['deleted_at'])
            ||(int)$target['is_demo']!==1
            ||(string)$target['public_no']!==(string)$target['order_no_snapshot']
            ||strpos((string)$target['public_no'],'BXDEMOHALL')===0
            ||(string)$target['lifecycle_status']!=='active'
            ||(string)$target['assignment_status']!=='offered'){
            throw new RuntimeException('派单超时测试实例边界失败');
        }

        $deadline=$this->deadline((string)($target['accept_deadline_at']??''),(string)($target['offered_at']??''));
        if($deadline===null)throw new RuntimeException('当前派单缺少可验证的接受截止时间');
        $asOf=$advanceClock
            ?gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',max(time(),strtotime($deadline.' UTC')+1))
            :gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s');

        $expired=$this->expire((int)$target['assignment_id'],$instanceId,$asOf);
        return[
            'expired'=>$expired,
            'assignment_id'=>(int)$target['assignment_id'],
            'order_id'=>(int)$target['order_id'],
            'assignment_type'=>(string)$target['assignment_type'],
            'deadline_at'=>$deadline,
            'as_of'=>$asOf,
            'clock_fixture'=>$advanceClock,
            'scope'=>'test_instance',
        ];
    }

    private function expire(int $assignmentId,int $testInstanceId,?string $asOf): bool
    {
        return$this->db->transaction(function(Database $db)use($assignmentId,$testInstanceId,$asOf):bool{
            if($testInstanceId>0&&!TestingEnvironmentPolicy::active())throw new RuntimeException('禁止跨测试域执行派单超时');

            $params=['id'=>$assignmentId];
            $dueSql='COALESCE(accept_deadline_at,DATE_ADD(offered_at,INTERVAL 24 HOUR))<=UTC_TIMESTAMP()';
            if($testInstanceId>0){
                $dueSql='COALESCE(accept_deadline_at,DATE_ADD(offered_at,INTERVAL 24 HOUR))<=:as_of';
                $params['as_of']=$asOf;
            }
            $assignment=$db->fetch(
                "SELECT * FROM assignments
                 WHERE id=:id AND status='offered' AND {$dueSql}
                 FOR UPDATE",
                $params
            );
            if(!$assignment)return false;

            if($testInstanceId>0){
                $order=$db->fetch(
                    "SELECT o.*
                     FROM orders o
                     JOIN test_instances ti ON ti.id=:instance AND ti.order_id=o.id
                     WHERE o.id=:id
                       AND o.is_demo=1
                       AND BINARY o.public_no=BINARY ti.order_no_snapshot
                       AND ti.build_status='built'
                       AND ti.archived_at IS NULL
                       AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL
                     FOR UPDATE",
                    ['instance'=>$testInstanceId,'id'=>$assignment['order_id']]
                );
                if(!$order||strpos((string)$order['public_no'],'BXDEMOHALL')===0)throw new RuntimeException('派单超时测试订单边界失败');
                if((int)($order['current_assignment_id']??0)!==(int)$assignment['id'])throw new RuntimeException('当前测试指派已经变化');
            }else{
                $order=$db->fetch(
                    'SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=:id AND COALESCE(is_demo,0)=0 FOR UPDATE',
                    ['id'=>$assignment['order_id']]
                );
            }

            if(!$order||(string)$order['lifecycle_status']!=='active')return false;
            if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
                (new \WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence\DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true))->schedule((int)$order['id']);
            }

            $changed=$db->execute(
                "UPDATE assignments
                 SET status='expired',rejected_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE id=:id AND status='offered'",
                ['id'=>$assignment['id']]
            );
            if($changed!==1)return false;

            $timeoutReason=(string)$assignment['assignment_type']==='single_grab'
                ?'抢单后未在规定时间提交报价，系统自动释放并重新开放抢单'
                :'派单超过处理期限未处理，系统自动释放';
            $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO assignment_history(assignment_id,order_id,worker_id,action,reason,actor_type,actor_id,created_at)
                 VALUES(:assignment_id,:order_id,:worker_id,'expired',:reason,'system',NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                [
                    'assignment_id'=>$assignment['id'],
                    'order_id'=>$assignment['order_id'],
                    'worker_id'=>$assignment['worker_id'],
                    'reason'=>$timeoutReason,
                ]
            );

            if((int)($order['current_assignment_id']??0)===(int)$assignment['id']){
                if((string)$assignment['assignment_type']==='single_grab'){
                    $db->execute(
                        "UPDATE orders
                         SET current_assignment_id=NULL,assigned_worker_id=NULL,assignment_status='unassigned',
                             publish_status='published',quote_status='waiting',contact_revealed_at=NULL,
                             updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1
                         WHERE id=:id",
                        ['id'=>$order['id']]
                    );
                }else{
                    $db->execute(
                        "UPDATE orders
                         SET current_assignment_id=NULL,assigned_worker_id=NULL,assignment_status='unassigned',
                             publish_status='hidden',contact_revealed_at=NULL,
                             updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1
                         WHERE id=:id",
                        ['id'=>$order['id']]
                    );
                }
            }

            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE order_role_grants g
                 JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.user_id=g.user_id
                 SET g.status='revoked',g.revoked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE g.order_id=:order_id AND g.status='active' AND w.id=:worker_id",
                ['order_id'=>$order['id'],'worker_id'=>$assignment['worker_id']]
            );

            $payload=[
                'assignment_id'=>(int)$assignment['id'],
                'message'=>(string)$assignment['assignment_type']==='single_grab'
                    ?'抢单后未在规定时间提交报价，系统已释放并重新开放抢单。'
                    :'派单超过处理期限未处理，系统已自动释放。',
            ];
            if($testInstanceId>0){
                $payload['test_instance_id']=$testInstanceId;
                $payload['clock_fixture']=$asOf!==null;
                $payload['as_of']=$asOf;
            }
            $this->recordOrderEvent($db,(int)$order['id'],(int)$order['version'],$payload);
            return true;
        });
    }

    private function recordOrderEvent(Database $db,int $orderId,int $version,array $payload): void
    {
        $eventKey='scheduler:assignment_timeout:order:'.$orderId.':v'.max(1,$version);
        $db->execute(
            "INSERT IGNORE INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at)
             VALUES(:order_id,'assignment_expired',:event_key,'system',NULL,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            [
                'order_id'=>$orderId,
                'event_key'=>substr($eventKey,0,128),
                'payload'=>json_encode($payload,JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES),
            ]
        );
        OrderNotificationService::queue(
            $db,
            $orderId,
            substr($eventKey,0,128),
            'assignment_expired',
            $payload
        );
    }

    private function deadline(string $explicit,string $offeredAt): ?string
    {
        $explicit=trim($explicit);
        if($explicit!==''){
            $timestamp=strtotime($explicit.' UTC');
            if($timestamp!==false)return gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',$timestamp);
        }
        $offeredAt=trim($offeredAt);
        if($offeredAt==='')return null;
        $timestamp=strtotime($offeredAt.' UTC');
        return$timestamp===false?null:gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',$timestamp+86400);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence\DatabaseChatRepairEpisodes;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence\DatabaseOrderConversationBridge;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence\DatabaseOrderNegotiationRepository;

/** Reuses the full disposable install from chat_assignment_contract.php. */
function chatRepairEpisodeContract(Database $db): void
{
    $db->execute("INSERT INTO orders(id,public_no,user_id,audit_status,lifecycle_status,payment_status,assignment_status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(78,'CHAT-REPAIR',10001,'approved','active','paid','accepted',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
    $rule=$db->insert("INSERT INTO commission_rule_versions(order_id,version_no,rate_bp,min_fee_cents,status,created_at) VALUES(78,1,1000,1000,'active',UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
    $db->execute("INSERT INTO assignments(id,public_id,order_id,worker_id,assignment_type,commission_rule_version_id,final_amount_cents_snapshot,booking_fee_cents_snapshot,commission_rate_bp_snapshot,commission_min_cents_snapshot,estimated_commission_cents,estimated_offline_collect_cents,estimated_net_income_cents,status,offered_at,accepted_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(200,:public_id,78,10,'admin',:rule,20000,5000,1000,1000,2000,15000,18000,'accepted',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['public_id'=>public_id(),'rule'=>$rule]);
    $db->execute('UPDATE orders SET current_assignment_id=200,assigned_worker_id=10 WHERE id=78');
    $bridge=new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true);
    $db->transaction(static function()use($bridge):void{$bridge->synchronize(78);});
    $db->transaction(static function(Database $db)use($bridge):void{$db->execute("UPDATE orders SET lifecycle_status='completed' WHERE id=78");$bridge->synchronize(78);});
    $repair=(int)$db->insert("INSERT INTO after_sales(public_no,order_id,user_id,type,description,status,opened_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES('CHAT-AFTER',78,10001,'warranty_repair','fixture','processing',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
    policyAssert((int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_repair_episodes')===0,'processing application is not explicit chat acceptance');
    $episodes=new DatabaseChatRepairEpisodes($db,true);
    $outside=false;try{$episodes->acceptWorker(78,$repair,10);}catch(RuntimeException $e){$outside=true;}policyAssert($outside,'acceptance fact cannot escape original transaction');
    $repo=new DatabaseOrderNegotiationRepository($db);
    $actor=['user_id'=>10002,'worker_id'=>10];
    $db->execute("CREATE TRIGGER fixture_repair_episode_failure BEFORE INSERT ON chat_repair_episodes FOR EACH ROW SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='fixture'");
    $failed=false;try{$repo->respond($actor,'CHAT-REPAIR','repair','CHAT-AFTER','accepted','fixture');}catch(PDOException $e){$failed=($e->errorInfo[1]??0)===1644;}
    $db->execute('DROP TRIGGER fixture_repair_episode_failure');
    policyAssert($failed && $db->fetchValue('SELECT resolution FROM after_sales WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$repair])===null,'episode write failure rolls real repair acceptance back');
    $repo->respond($actor,'CHAT-REPAIR','repair','CHAT-AFTER','accepted','fixture');
    $first=(string)$db->fetchValue('SELECT id FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE active_order_id=78');
    policyAssert($first!=='' && $db->fetchValue('SELECT accepted_user_id FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$first])==10002,'explicit acceptance binds actual assignment and user');
    $same=$db->transaction(static function()use($episodes,$repair):?string{return $episodes->acceptWorker(78,$repair,10);});
    policyAssert($same===$first && (int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_repair_episodes')===1,'replayed acceptance does not invent a generation');
    $firstSnapshot=json_decode((string)$db->fetchValue('SELECT snapshot_json FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=78'),true,32,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    policyAssert($firstSnapshot['state']==='open' && $firstSnapshot['episode_key']==='assignment:200:repair:'.$first,'explicit acceptance opens only its new repair episode');
    $repo->respond($actor,'CHAT-REPAIR','repair','CHAT-AFTER','complete','fixture');
    policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$first])==='closed','actual worker completion closes accepted episode');
    policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT status FROM after_sales WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$repair])==='resolved','original repair completion retained');
    $closed=json_decode((string)$db->fetchValue('SELECT snapshot_json FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=78'),true,32,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    policyAssert($closed['state']==='readonly' && $closed['episode_key']===$firstSnapshot['episode_key'],'completion retains the closing repair identity');
    $db->transaction(static function()use($bridge):void{policyAssert($bridge->synchronize(78)===[],'completed repair never flaps back to service identity');});
    $rejected=false;try{$db->transaction(static function()use($episodes,$repair):void{$episodes->acceptWorker(78,$repair,10);});}catch(RuntimeException $e){$rejected=true;}
    policyAssert($rejected && (int)$db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE state='active'")===0,'resolved request cannot resurrect an accepted generation');
    $next=(int)$db->insert("INSERT INTO after_sales(public_no,order_id,user_id,type,description,status,opened_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES('CHAT-AFTER2',78,10001,'warranty_repair','fixture','processing',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
    $repo->respond($actor,'CHAT-REPAIR','repair','CHAT-AFTER2','accepted','fixture');
    $second=(string)$db->fetchValue('SELECT id FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE active_order_id=78');
    policyAssert($second!==$first && $db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$first])==='closed','new request creates a new immutable generation');
    $reflection=new ReflectionClass('WorkerAdmin\\Infrastructure\\Persistence\\DatabaseOrderFulfillmentAuxiliaryRepository');
    $auxiliary=$reflection->newInstanceWithoutConstructor();$property=$reflection->getProperty('db');$property->setAccessible(true);$property->setValue($auxiliary,$db);
    $auxiliary->withdrawRepair(['user_id'=>10001],'CHAT-REPAIR','CHAT-AFTER2');
    policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=78')==='readonly','actual customer withdrawal closes the guard');
    $db->transaction(static function()use($episodes,$next):void{$episodes->close(78,$next);});
    policyAssert((int)$db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE state='closed'")===2,'repeated closure is idempotent');
    $third=(int)$db->insert("INSERT INTO after_sales(public_no,order_id,user_id,type,description,status,resolution,opened_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES('CHAT-AFTER3',78,10001,'warranty_repair','fixture','processing','用户申请平台介入：fixture',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())");
    $db->execute("INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(78,'repair_platform_intervention_requested','user',10001,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['payload'=>json_encode(['after_sale_id'=>'CHAT-AFTER3'],JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)]);
    $admin=new \WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence\DatabaseAdminRepairResolutionRepository($db);
    $operator=['channel'=>'mini_admin','user_id'=>10004];
    $admin->resolve($operator,'CHAT-REPAIR','CHAT-AFTER3','continue','fixture');
    policyAssert((int)$db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE state='active'")===0
        && $db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=78')==='readonly','platform continue alone never impersonates worker acceptance');
    $repo->respond($actor,'CHAT-REPAIR','repair','CHAT-AFTER3','accepted','fixture');
    policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=78')==='open','worker explicitly accepts after platform continue');
    $admin->resolve($operator,'CHAT-REPAIR','CHAT-AFTER3','closed','fixture');
    policyAssert($db->fetchValue('SELECT state FROM chat_policy_guards WHERE order_id=78')==='readonly'
        && (int)$db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_repair_episodes WHERE state='active'")===0,'actual platform closure ends both guard and episode');
    $disabled=new DatabaseChatRepairEpisodes(new Database([]));
    policyAssert($disabled->acceptWorker(0,0,0)===null,'disabled episode writer does no IO');
    echo "售后明确受理、授权区间、完成/撤回/平台关闭、继续处理与回滚验证通过\n";
}
