<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging;

use RuntimeException;

final class MessageOutboxPolicy
{

    /** Eligibility is checked against the row locked by the persistence operation. */
    public static function requireDeadLetter(?array $row, string $operation): void
    {
        if ($row && $row['topic'] === 'aliyun_paid_sms' && $operation === 'retry') {
            throw new RuntimeException('付费短信禁止从普通消息重试入口重新发送；仅允许用户在明确失败且费用已释放后重新发起。');
        }
        if (!$row || !in_array((string)$row['topic'], ['aliyun_sms','wecom_webhook','wechat_subscribe'], true)) {
            throw new RuntimeException($operation === 'retry' ? '该消息类型不由通用消息调度器发送，请在对应业务页面处理。' : '该消息类型不支持在此结案，请在对应业务页面处理。');
        }
        if ($row['status'] !== 'failed' || (int)$row['attempt_count'] < 5) {
            throw new RuntimeException($operation === 'retry' ? '仅可人工重试已达到 5 次自动重试上限的失败消息；请刷新页面确认当前状态。' : '仅可结案已达到 5 次自动重试上限的失败消息；请刷新页面确认当前状态。');
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;

/**
 * 平台承接单外部预付款核验。
 *
 * 平台承接单只允许 platform_managed：客户侧款项由外部渠道托管，系统不创建微信
 * order_booking/booking_fee 支付记录。普通客户（包含后台代下单）的微信预约费走普通订单
 * 支付链，绝不能进入本核验器。
 *
 * 调用方必须先在同一事务中锁定 orders 行；本类只核对平台专属资金事实，不发起支付/退款。
 */
final class PlatformOrderBookingPaymentVerifier
{
    /**
     * 返回当前可参与平台单结算的外部已收预付款金额。
     *
     * $expectedCents 为调用方已锁定的 order_platform_terms.booking_paid_cents；为兼容少量旧调用
     * 允许传 null，此时直接从平台条款读取。customerFlowMode 仅用于验证，不再支持 miniapp_booking。
     */
    public function verifiedPaidCents(
        Database $db,
        int $orderId,
        int $customerTotalCents,
        ?int $expectedCents = null,
        ?string $customerFlowMode = null
    ): int {
        if ($orderId <= 0 || $customerTotalCents <= 0) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接订单金额或编号无效', 'PLATFORM_BOOKING_INVALID', 409);
        }

        $terms = null;
        if ($expectedCents === null || trim((string)$customerFlowMode) === '') {
            $terms = $db->fetch(
                'SELECT customer_flow_mode,booking_paid_cents FROM order_platform_terms WHERE order_id=:order_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE',
                ['order_id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if (!$terms) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单缺少托管资金条款，请先修复订单数据', 'PLATFORM_TERMS_REQUIRED', 409);
            }
        }

        $flow = trim((string)($customerFlowMode ?? ($terms['customer_flow_mode'] ?? '')));
        if ($flow !== 'platform_managed') {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单只允许平台托管模式；旧小程序预约模式必须先完成数据清理', 'PLATFORM_BOOKING_FLOW_INVALID', 409);
        }

        $externalPaid = $expectedCents !== null
            ? $expectedCents
            : (int)($terms['booking_paid_cents'] ?? 0);
        if ($externalPaid < 0 || $externalPaid > $customerTotalCents) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台外部已收预付款金额异常，请先核对订单资金条件', 'PLATFORM_BOOKING_AMOUNT_MISMATCH', 409);
        }

        // 平台托管单出现真实微信预约费，意味着订单来源/支付链串线或客户被重复收费。
        $payments = $db->fetchAll(
            "SELECT id,amount_cents FROM payment_orders
             WHERE order_id=:order_id AND business_type IN ('order_booking','booking_fee')
               AND status='paid' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE",
            ['order_id'=>$orderId]
        );
        if ($payments) {
            throw new OrderOperationException(
                '平台托管单检测到微信预约费付款，请先按资金异常核对；该笔款不能与外部预付款重复抵扣',
                'PLATFORM_BOOKING_UNEXPECTED_PAYMENT',
                409
            );
        }

        return $externalPaid;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Messaging;

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;

final class SubscriptionQuotaStore
{

    public static function subscriptionPreferences(Database $db, int $userId): array
    {
        if ($userId < 1) return [];
        $raw = (string) ($db->fetchValue('SELECT setting_value FROM system_settings WHERE setting_key=:key LIMIT 1', ['key'=>self::subscriptionPreferenceKey($userId)]) ?: '');
        $decoded = $raw === '' ? [] : json_decode($raw, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) return [];
        // 无需新增表字段：旧 enabled/consumed 偏好在读取时补成计数模型，下次授权或消费即写回新结构。
        $scenes = SubscriptionCatalog::subscriptionSceneDefinitions();
        foreach ($decoded as $sceneKey => &$pref) {
            if (!is_array($pref)) { $pref = []; continue; }
            $scene = $scenes[$sceneKey] ?? [];
            $type = trim((string)($pref['subscription_type'] ?? $scene['subscription_type'] ?? 'one_time'));
            if (!in_array($type, ['one_time','long_term'], true)) $type = 'one_time';
            $status = (string)($pref['authorization_status'] ?? '');
            $legacyAccepted = !empty($pref['enabled']) && in_array($status, ['accept','acceptWithAudio','acceptWithAlert'], true);
            if ($type === 'one_time') {
                $remaining = array_key_exists('remaining_count', $pref) ? max(0, (int)$pref['remaining_count']) : ($legacyAccepted ? 1 : 0);
                $pref['remaining_count'] = $remaining;
                if (!array_key_exists('total_authorized_count', $pref)) $pref['total_authorized_count'] = $remaining;
                // 一次性订阅的“拒绝”只代表本次没有新增额度，不应抹掉之前已经积累的可发送次数。
                // 旧数据若出现 remaining_count>0 但状态为 reject/consumed，读取时恢复为可用。
                if ($remaining > 0 && in_array($status, ['consumed','reject'], true)) $pref['authorization_status'] = 'accept';
                if (!array_key_exists('last_request_status', $pref) && $status !== '') $pref['last_request_status'] = $status;
            } else {
                $pref['remaining_count'] = null;
                if (!array_key_exists('total_authorized_count', $pref)) $pref['total_authorized_count'] = $legacyAccepted ? 1 : 0;
            }
            $pref['subscription_type'] = $type;
        }
        unset($pref);
        return $decoded;
    }

    public static function saveSubscriptionPreference(Database $db, int $userId, string $sceneKey, bool $enabled, string $authorizationStatus): array
    {
        $scenes = SubscriptionCatalog::subscriptionSceneDefinitions();
        if ($userId < 1 || !isset($scenes[$sceneKey])) throw new \RuntimeException('订阅场景不存在。');
        if ($enabled && empty($scenes[$sceneKey]['available'])) throw new \RuntimeException('该订阅场景尚未在后台配置可用模板。');
        $allowed = ['accept','acceptWithAudio','acceptWithAlert','reject','ban','filter','disabled','consumed','error',''];
        if (!in_array($authorizationStatus, $allowed, true)) $authorizationStatus = $enabled ? 'accept' : 'disabled';
        if ($enabled && $authorizationStatus === '') $authorizationStatus = 'accept';
        $preferences = self::subscriptionPreferences($db, $userId);
        $previous = is_array($preferences[$sceneKey] ?? null) ? $preferences[$sceneKey] : [];
        $type = (string)($scenes[$sceneKey]['subscription_type'] ?? 'one_time');
        $accepted = in_array($authorizationStatus, ['accept','acceptWithAudio','acceptWithAlert'], true);
        $remaining = $type === 'one_time' ? max(0, (int)($previous['remaining_count'] ?? 0)) : null;
        $total = max(0, (int)($previous['total_authorized_count'] ?? 0));
        $effectiveStatus = $authorizationStatus;
        if ($accepted) {
            $enabled = true;
            if ($type === 'one_time') $remaining++;
            $total++;
        } elseif ($type === 'one_time' && in_array($authorizationStatus, ['reject','filter'], true)) {
            // reject 只是本次没有新增额度；filter 是微信因同标题过滤，本质也不是授权失效。
            // 两种情况都保留之前已经积累的 remaining_count。
            $enabled = $remaining > 0;
            $effectiveStatus = $remaining > 0 ? 'accept' : $authorizationStatus;
        } elseif (in_array($authorizationStatus, ['ban','disabled'], true)) {
            $enabled = false;
        } elseif ($type === 'one_time' && $remaining > 0) {
            $enabled = true;
            $effectiveStatus = 'accept';
        }
        $preferences[$sceneKey] = array_merge($previous, [
            'enabled'=>(bool)$enabled,
            'authorization_status'=>$effectiveStatus,
            'last_request_status'=>$authorizationStatus,
            'subscription_type'=>$type,
            'remaining_count'=>$remaining,
            'total_authorized_count'=>$total,
            'template_id'=>(string)$scenes[$sceneKey]['template_id'],
            'updated_at'=>gmdate('c'),
        ]);
        if ($accepted) $preferences[$sceneKey]['last_authorized_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $json = json_encode($preferences, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO system_settings(setting_key,setting_value,value_type,group_name,is_public,description,updated_by,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(:key,:value,'json','notification_user',0,'用户微信订阅消息偏好',NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE setting_value=VALUES(setting_value),value_type='json',group_name='notification_user',is_public=0,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()", ['key'=>self::subscriptionPreferenceKey($userId),'value'=>$json]);
        return $preferences[$sceneKey];
    }

    public static function markSubscriptionConsumed(Database $db, int $userId, string $sceneKey): void
    {
        $preferences = self::subscriptionPreferences($db, $userId);
        if (!isset($preferences[$sceneKey]) || !is_array($preferences[$sceneKey])) return;
        $pref = $preferences[$sceneKey];
        $type = (string)($pref['subscription_type'] ?? 'one_time');
        if ($type === 'one_time') {
            $remaining = max(0, (int)($pref['remaining_count'] ?? 0) - 1);
            $pref['remaining_count'] = $remaining;
            $pref['authorization_status'] = $remaining > 0 ? 'accept' : 'consumed';
        } else {
            $pref['authorization_status'] = 'accept';
        }
        $pref['last_consumed_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $pref['updated_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $preferences[$sceneKey] = $pref;
        $json = json_encode($preferences, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $db->execute('UPDATE system_settings SET setting_value=:value,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE setting_key=:key', ['value'=>$json,'key'=>self::subscriptionPreferenceKey($userId)]);
    }

    public static function markSubscriptionPermissionUnavailable(Database $db, int $userId, string $sceneKey): void
    {
        $preferences = self::subscriptionPreferences($db, $userId);
        if (!isset($preferences[$sceneKey]) || !is_array($preferences[$sceneKey])) return;
        $pref = $preferences[$sceneKey];
        if ((string)($pref['subscription_type'] ?? 'one_time') === 'one_time') $pref['remaining_count'] = 0;
        $pref['authorization_status'] = 'consumed';
        $pref['updated_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $preferences[$sceneKey] = $pref;
        $json = json_encode($preferences, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $db->execute('UPDATE system_settings SET setting_value=:value,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE setting_key=:key', ['value'=>$json,'key'=>self::subscriptionPreferenceKey($userId)]);
    }

    private static function subscriptionPreferenceKey(int $userId): string
    {
        return 'wechat.subscription.user.'.$userId;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

/** 小程序详情与 Web 正常核价入口共用可操作条件。 */
final class PlatformOrderPricingReviewReadiness
{
    public static function isReady(\WorkerAdmin\Core\Database $db, int $orderId): bool
    {
        return (bool)$db->fetchValue(
            "SELECT 1
             FROM orders o
             JOIN order_measurement_states ms ON ms.order_id=o.id AND ms.result_status='accepted'
             JOIN order_platform_terms t ON t.order_id=o.id
                                        AND t.customer_flow_mode='platform_managed'
                                        AND t.settlement_status='pending'
                                        AND t.booking_paid_cents<=t.customer_contract_total_cents
             JOIN assignments a ON a.id=o.current_assignment_id
                               AND a.order_id=o.id
                               AND a.worker_id=o.assigned_worker_id
                               AND a.status='accepted'
             WHERE o.id=:order_id
               AND o.order_source_type='platform'
               AND o.booking_fee_cents=0
               AND o.workflow_profile='measurement'
               AND o.lifecycle_status='active'
               AND COALESCE(o.dispute_status,'none') IN ('','none','resolved')
               AND COALESCE(o.refund_status,'none') IN ('','none','failed')
               AND NOT EXISTS(
                   SELECT 1 FROM payment_orders p
                   WHERE p.order_id=o.id AND p.business_type IN ('order_booking','booking_fee') AND p.status='paid'
               )
               AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM disputes d WHERE d.order_id=o.id AND d.status IN ('open','pending','processing'))
               AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.id AND r.status NOT IN ('failed','closed','cancelled','rejected','succeeded'))
               AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_cancel_requests cr WHERE cr.order_id=o.id AND cr.status IN ('pending','processing'))
               AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM change_requests c WHERE c.order_id=o.id AND c.status IN ('pending','processing','negotiating'))
               AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM after_sales s WHERE s.order_id=o.id AND s.status IN ('open','processing'))
             LIMIT 1",
            ['order_id'=>$orderId]
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\OrderNegotiationRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\NegotiationPolicy;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\FulfillmentActor;
use WorkerAdmin\Services\OrderNotificationService;

// 2026-10-08：所有写操作先锁订单，再锁原业务记录；升级只创建一份现有平台争议。
final class DatabaseOrderNegotiationRepository implements OrderNegotiationRepository
{
    private Database $db;
    public function __construct(Database $db) { $this->db = $db; }

    private function order(Database $db, array $actor, string $orderNo): array
    {
        $order = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :no FOR UPDATE', ['no'=>$orderNo]);
        if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在', 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);
        $owner = (int)$order['user_id'] === (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0);
        $worker = (int)($actor['worker_id'] ?? 0) > 0 && (int)$order['assigned_worker_id'] === (int)$actor['worker_id'];
        if (!$owner && !$worker) throw new OrderOperationException('只有订单双方可以处理协商', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
        return $order;
    }

    public function respond(array $actor, string $orderNo, string $kind, string $reference, string $decision, string $note): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$orderNo,$kind,$reference,$decision,$note): array {
            $order = $this->order($db, $actor, $orderNo);
            if (FulfillmentActor::assisted($actor) && ($kind!=='repair' || $decision!=='complete')) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('协助入口只能提交维修处理结果','ASSISTANCE_NOT_ALLOWED',422);
            }
            if ($kind === 'refund') {
                $request = $this->refund($db, (int)$order['id'], $reference);
                $this->requireCounterparty($actor, $order, $request);
                if ($decision === 'accepted') return (new DatabaseOrderCancellationRepository($db))->approveByAgreement($actor, $reference);
                if ($decision !== 'rejected') throw new OrderOperationException('退款只能接受或拒绝', 'NEGOTIATION_RESPONSE_INVALID', 422);
                $db->execute("UPDATE order_cancel_requests SET reason_code='bilateral_refund_rejected',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id", ['id'=>$request['id']]);
            } elseif ($kind === 'repair') {
                $this->requireWorker($actor, $order);
                $repair = $db->fetch("SELECT * FROM after_sales WHERE order_id=:id AND BINARY public_no=BINARY :no AND type='warranty_repair' FOR UPDATE", ['id'=>$order['id'],'no'=>$reference]);
                if (!$repair || !in_array((string)$repair['status'], ['open','processing'], true)
                    || strpos((string)$repair['resolution'], '用户申请平台介入') === 0 || strpos((string)$repair['resolution'], '平台主动介入') === 0 || strpos((string)$repair['resolution'], '师傅拒绝维修') === 0) {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('维修已经响应、结束或平台介入', 'REPAIR_NOT_ACTIVE', 409);
                }
                if ($decision === 'accepted' && strpos((string)$repair['resolution'], '师傅接受维修') === 0) {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('已经接受处理，请记录预约或完成维修', 'REPAIR_ALREADY_ACCEPTED', 409);
                }
                $resolution = ($decision === 'rejected' ? '师傅拒绝维修：' : ($decision === 'complete' ? '师傅已完成维修：' : '师傅接受维修：')).$note;
                if (FulfillmentActor::assisted($actor)) $resolution='管理员补录维修处理结果：'.$note;
                $db->execute("UPDATE after_sales SET status=:status,resolution=:resolution,closed_at=IF(:done=1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),NULL),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id",
                    ['status'=>$decision === 'complete' ? 'resolved' : 'processing','resolution'=>$resolution,'done'=>$decision === 'complete' ? 1 : 0,'id'=>$repair['id']]);
                if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
                    $episodes=new DatabaseChatRepairEpisodes($db,true);
                    if($decision==='accepted') $episodes->acceptWorker((int)$order['id'],(int)$repair['id'],(int)$actor['worker_id']);
                    else $episodes->close((int)$order['id'],(int)$repair['id']);
                }
            } elseif ($kind === 'dispute') {
                $this->requireWorker($actor, $order);
                $dispute = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM disputes WHERE order_id=:id AND BINARY public_no=BINARY :no FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$order['id'],'no'=>$reference]);
                if (!$dispute || (string)$dispute['status'] !== 'negotiating' || !empty($dispute['resolution']) || $decision === 'complete') {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('异议已经响应或不在协商阶段', 'DISPUTE_RESPONSE_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
                }
                $db->execute('UPDATE disputes SET resolution=:note,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id',
                    ['note'=>($decision === 'rejected' ? '师傅拒绝异议：' : '师傅接受异议，处理中：').$note,'id'=>$dispute['id']]);
            } elseif ($kind === 'measurement') {
                $this->requireWorker($actor, $order);
                $state = $this->measurement($db, $order, $reference);
                if ($decision !== 'rejected') throw new OrderOperationException('补测请直接补充成果后提交', 'MEASUREMENT_RESPONSE_INVALID', 422);
                if ($state['status'] === 'rejected') throw new OrderOperationException('已拒绝本次补测', 'MEASUREMENT_ALREADY_REJECTED', 409);
                $this->event($db, $order, $actor, 'measurement_rework_rejected', ['rework_id'=>$reference,'note'=>$note,'message'=>'师傅拒绝补测：'.$note]);
            } else {
                throw new OrderOperationException('加价请使用原有同意/拒绝入口', 'NEGOTIATION_RESPONSE_INVALID', 422);
            }
            // 补测拒绝已经记录专属事件并通知客户；不要再投递一次通用响应。
            if ($kind !== 'measurement') {
                $event = $kind === 'repair' ? ['accepted'=>'repair_worker_accepted','rejected'=>'repair_worker_rejected','complete'=>'repair_worker_completed'][$decision] : 'negotiation_responded';
                $this->event($db, $order, $actor, $event, ['after_sale_id'=>$kind === 'repair' ? $reference : null,'kind'=>$kind,'reference'=>$reference,'decision'=>$decision,'note'=>$note,'message'=>FulfillmentActor::assisted($actor) ? '管理员已补录维修处理结果' : ($decision === 'complete' ? '师傅已提交维修处理结果' : ($decision === 'rejected' ? '对方拒绝方案，可继续协商或申请平台介入' : '对方已接受处理'))]);
            }
            $db->execute('UPDATE orders SET version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id', ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            return ['reference'=>$reference,'decision'=>$decision];
        });
    }

    public function proposeRefund(array $actor, string $orderNo, string $reference, int $amount, string $note): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$orderNo,$reference,$amount,$note): array {
            $order = $this->order($db, $actor, $orderNo);
            $request = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM order_cancel_requests WHERE order_id=:id AND BINARY public_id=BINARY :no FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$order['id'],'no'=>$reference]);
            if (!$request || (string)$request['status'] !== 'pending' || NegotiationPolicy::refundStatus((string)$request['reason_code']) !== 'rejected'
                || (string)$order['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active') throw new OrderOperationException('拒绝后才能重新提出退款方案', 'REFUND_PROPOSAL_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
            $type = (int)$order['user_id'] === (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0) ? 'user' : 'worker';
            // 报价式方案只记录双方意愿，执行时仍重新核对真实可退支付，不相信客户端金额。
            $db->execute("UPDATE order_cancel_requests SET applicant_type=:type,applicant_id=:actor,requested_refund_cents=:amount,reason=:note,reason_code='bilateral_refund_pending',requested_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id",
                ['type'=>$type,'actor'=>in_array($type,['user','mini_admin'],true) ? $actor['user_id'] : $actor['worker_id'],'amount'=>$amount,'note'=>$note,'id'=>$request['id']]);
            $this->event($db, $order, $actor, 'cancel_requested', ['reference'=>$reference,'requested_refund_cents'=>$amount,'message'=>'双方重新提出退款方案，等待对方接受或拒绝']);
            $db->execute('UPDATE orders SET version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id', ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            return ['reference'=>$reference,'status'=>'pending'];
        });
    }

    public function withdrawRefund(array $actor, string $orderNo, string $reference, string $note): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$orderNo,$reference,$note): array {
            $order = $this->order($db, $actor, $orderNo);
            if ((string)$order['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active') {
                throw new OrderOperationException('订单已进入取消、退款或结束流程，不能撤回退款方案', 'REFUND_WITHDRAW_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
            }
            $request = $db->fetch(
                'SELECT * FROM order_cancel_requests WHERE order_id=:id AND BINARY public_id=BINARY :no FOR UPDATE',
                ['id'=>$order['id'],'no'=>$reference]
            );
            if (!$request || (string)$request['status'] !== 'pending'
                || !in_array((string)$request['reason_code'], ['bilateral_refund_pending','bilateral_refund_rejected'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('退款方案已进入平台处理、资金执行或已经结束，不能撤回', 'REFUND_WITHDRAW_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
            }

            $userApplicant = (string)$request['applicant_type'] === 'user'
                && (int)$request['applicant_id'] === (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0)
                && (int)$order['user_id'] === (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0);
            $workerApplicant = (string)$request['applicant_type'] === 'worker'
                && (int)$request['applicant_id'] === (int)($actor['worker_id'] ?? 0)
                && (int)($actor['worker_id'] ?? 0) > 0
                && (int)$order['assigned_worker_id'] === (int)$actor['worker_id'];
            if (!$userApplicant && !$workerApplicant) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('只有当前退款方案提出方可以撤回', 'REFUND_WITHDRAW_FORBIDDEN', 403);
            }

            if ($db->fetchValue(
                "SELECT id FROM refunds
                 WHERE cancel_request_id=:request_id AND status NOT IN ('failed','closed','cancelled','rejected')
                 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['request_id'=>$request['id']]
            )) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('本方案已经产生退款资金记录，不能恢复履约', 'REFUND_WITHDRAW_FINANCE_STARTED', 409);
            }

            $snapshot = json_decode((string)($request['order_state_snapshot_json'] ?? ''), true);
            if (!is_array($snapshot)) $snapshot = [];
            $restoreRefund = (string)($snapshot['refund_status'] ?? 'none');
            if (!in_array($restoreRefund, ['', 'none','failed'], true)) $restoreRefund = 'none';
            if ($restoreRefund === '') $restoreRefund = 'none';
            $restorePublish = (string)($snapshot['publish_status'] ?? 'hidden');
            if (!in_array($restorePublish, ['published','hidden'], true)) $restorePublish = 'hidden';

            $hasMeasurementLink = (bool)$db->fetchValue(
                "SELECT 1 FROM order_relations
                 WHERE child_order_id=:id AND relation_type='measurement_construction' AND status='active' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['id'=>$order['id']]
            );
            $hasActiveDispute = !in_array((string)($order['dispute_status'] ?? 'none'), ['', 'none','resolved'], true)
                || (bool)$db->fetchValue(
                    "SELECT id FROM disputes WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('negotiating','open','pending','processing') LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                    ['id'=>$order['id']]
                );
            if ($hasMeasurementLink || $hasActiveDispute) $restorePublish = 'hidden';

            $changed = $db->execute(
                "UPDATE order_cancel_requests
                 SET status='cancelled',reason_code='bilateral_refund_withdrawn',closed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE id=:id AND status='pending' AND reason_code IN ('bilateral_refund_pending','bilateral_refund_rejected')",
                ['id'=>$request['id']]
            );
            if ($changed !== 1) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('退款方案状态已变化，请刷新', 'REFUND_WITHDRAW_CHANGED', 409);
            }
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders
                 SET refund_status=:refund_status,publish_status=:publish_status,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE id=:id AND lifecycle_status='active'",
                ['refund_status'=>$restoreRefund,'publish_status'=>$restorePublish,'id'=>$order['id']]
            );
            $this->event($db, $order, $actor, 'negotiation_responded', [
                'kind'=>'refund','reference'=>$reference,'decision'=>'withdrawn','note'=>$note,
                'message'=>'退款方案已由提出方撤回，订单恢复继续履约',
            ]);
            return ['reference'=>$reference,'status'=>'withdrawn','order_resumed'=>true];
        });
    }

    public function escalate(array $actor, string $orderNo, string $kind, string $reference, string $note): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$orderNo,$kind,$reference,$note): array {
            $order = $this->order($db, $actor, $orderNo);
            if ((string)$order['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active') throw new OrderOperationException('订单已结束', 'ORDER_NOT_ACTIVE', 409);
            if ($kind === 'dispute') return (new DatabaseOrderDisputeRepository($db))->escalate($actor, $reference, $note);
            if ($kind === 'repair') return (new DatabaseOrderRepairInterventionRepository($db))->request($actor, $orderNo, $reference, $note);
            if ($kind === 'refund') {
                $request = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM order_cancel_requests WHERE order_id=:id AND BINARY public_id=BINARY :no FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$order['id'],'no'=>$reference]);
                if (!$request || (string)$request['status'] !== 'pending') throw new OrderOperationException('退款方案已经结束', 'REFUND_PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND', 409);
                $eligibility = NegotiationPolicy::evaluate(NegotiationPolicy::refundStatus((string)$request['reason_code']), $request['requested_at']);
                $this->requireEligible($eligibility);
                $db->execute("UPDATE order_cancel_requests SET reason_code='bilateral_refund_escalated',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id", ['id'=>$request['id']]);
                $this->event($db, $order, $actor, 'cancel_requested', ['message'=>'双方退款协商未解决，已申请平台介入','reference'=>$reference,'note'=>$note,'notify_recipients'=>['user','worker','admin']]);
            } else {
                if ($kind === 'change') {
                    $change = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM change_requests WHERE order_id=:id AND BINARY public_id=BINARY :no FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$order['id'],'no'=>$reference]);
                    $latest = $db->fetchValue('SELECT public_id FROM change_requests WHERE order_id=:id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1', ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                    if (!$change || $latest !== $reference || in_array((string)$order['fulfillment_status'], ['submitted','accepted'], true)) {
                        throw new OrderOperationException('加价事项已失效或被新方案替代', 'CHANGE_NOT_ACTIVE', 409);
                    }
                    $eligibility = NegotiationPolicy::evaluate((string)$change['status'], $change['submitted_at']);
                } elseif ($kind === 'measurement') {
                    $this->requireOwner($actor, $order);
                    $state = $this->measurement($db, $order, $reference);
                    $eligibility = NegotiationPolicy::evaluate($state['status'], $state['opened_at']);
                } else throw new OrderOperationException('协商类型不支持升级', 'NEGOTIATION_INVALID', 422);
                $this->requireEligible($eligibility);
                if (!in_array((string)($order['dispute_status'] ?? 'none'), ['', 'none','resolved'], true)
                    || $db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM disputes WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('negotiating','open','pending','processing') LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE", ['id'=>$order['id']])) {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('本单已有争议正在处理中', 'DISPUTE_ALREADY_ACTIVE', 409);
                }
                $disputeNo = \business_no('DSP');
                $type = (int)$order['user_id'] === (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0) ? 'user' : 'worker';
                $db->insert("INSERT INTO disputes(public_no,order_id,raised_by_type,raised_by_id,dispute_type,title,description,status,responsibility,opened_at,created_at,updated_at)
                    VALUES(:no,:order,:type,:actor,:kind,:title,:description,'open','undetermined',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                    ['no'=>$disputeNo,'order'=>$order['id'],'type'=>$type,'actor'=>$type === 'user' ? $actor['user_id'] : $actor['worker_id'],'kind'=>$kind === 'change' ? 'fee_negotiation' : 'measurement_rework',
                     'title'=>$kind === 'change' ? '加价协商未解决，申请平台介入' : '补测未解决，申请平台介入','description'=>'关联事项 '.$reference.'；'.$note]);
                $db->execute("UPDATE orders SET dispute_status='open',publish_status='hidden' WHERE id=:id", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $this->event($db, $order, $actor, 'dispute_opened', ['dispute_no'=>$disputeNo,'reference'=>$reference,'intervention_reason'=>$eligibility['reason'],'message'=>'双方协商未解决，已申请平台介入','notify_recipients'=>['user','worker']]);
                OrderNotificationService::queueAdminTask($db, 'dispute:'.$disputeNo, 'completion_dispute_opened', '双方协商未解决，申请平台介入', ['订单号'=>$orderNo,'事项'=>$kind,'协商说明'=>$note]);
            }
            $db->execute('UPDATE orders SET version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id', ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            return ['reference'=>$reference,'status'=>'escalated','intervention_reason'=>$eligibility['reason']];
        });
    }

    private function refund(Database $db, int $orderId, string $reference): array
    {
        $row = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM order_cancel_requests WHERE order_id=:id AND BINARY public_id=BINARY :no FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$orderId,'no'=>$reference]);
        if (!$row || (string)$row['status'] !== 'pending' || (string)$row['reason_code'] !== 'bilateral_refund_pending') throw new OrderOperationException('退款方案已经响应或不在协商阶段', 'REFUND_PROPOSAL_NOT_PENDING', 409);
        return $row;
    }

    private function requireCounterparty(array $actor, array $order, array $request): void
    {
        if ((string)$request['applicant_type'] === 'user') $this->requireWorker($actor, $order);
        elseif ((string)$request['applicant_type'] === 'worker') $this->requireOwner($actor, $order);
        else throw new OrderOperationException('该退款需平台处理', 'REFUND_PROPOSAL_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
    }

    private function requireWorker(array $actor, array $order): void
    {
        if ((int)($actor['worker_id'] ?? 0) < 1 || (int)$order['assigned_worker_id'] !== (int)$actor['worker_id']) throw new OrderOperationException('只能由成交师傅响应', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
    }
    private function requireOwner(array $actor, array $order): void
    {
        if ((int)$order['user_id'] !== (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0)) throw new OrderOperationException('只能由订单客户申请', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
    }
    private function requireEligible(array $eligibility): void
    {
        if (empty($eligibility['eligible'])) throw new OrderOperationException('请先协商；对方拒绝或满48小时未解决后才可申请平台介入', 'NEGOTIATION_WAIT_REQUIRED', 409, $eligibility);
    }
    private function measurement(Database $db, array $order, string $reference): array
    {
        $state = $db->fetch('SELECT result_status FROM order_measurement_states WHERE order_id=:id FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$order['id']]);
        $rework = $db->fetch("SELECT id,created_at FROM order_events WHERE order_id=:id AND event_type='measurement_rework_requested' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
        if (!$state || !$rework || (string)$rework['id'] !== $reference || (string)$state['result_status'] !== 'editing'
            || !in_array((string)($order['dispute_status'] ?? 'none'), ['', 'none','resolved'], true)) throw new OrderOperationException('补测已提交或正在平台处理中', 'MEASUREMENT_REWORK_NOT_ACTIVE', 409);
        $rejected = $db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM order_events WHERE order_id=:id AND event_type='measurement_rework_rejected' AND id>:rework LIMIT 1", ['id'=>$order['id'],'rework'=>$rework['id']]);
        return ['status'=>$rejected ? 'rejected' : 'pending','opened_at'=>$rework['created_at']];
    }
    private function event(Database $db, array $order, array $actor, string $event, array $payload): void
    {
        if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
            (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true))->schedule((int)$order['id']);
        }
        $type = (int)$order['user_id'] === (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0) ? 'user' : 'worker';
        if (FulfillmentActor::assisted($actor)) { $type='mini_admin'; $payload += FulfillmentActor::metadata($actor); }
        $key = $event.':'.$order['id'].':'.bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        $payload += ['notify_recipients'=>$type==='mini_admin' ? ['user','worker'] : [$type === 'user' ? 'worker' : 'user']];
        $db->insert('INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(:order,:event,:key,:type,:actor,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())',
            ['order'=>$order['id'],'event'=>$event,'key'=>$key,'type'=>$type,'actor'=>$type === 'user' ? $actor['user_id'] : $actor['worker_id'],'payload'=>json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)]);
        OrderNotificationService::queue($db, (int)$order['id'], $key, $event, $payload);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\AdminRepairResolutionRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
use WorkerAdmin\Services\OrderNotificationService;

/**
 * 平台介入维修裁定。
 *
 * mini_admin 的 users.id 只写带类型的 order_events，不写 after_sales.handled_by；
 * web_admin 的 admin_users.id 与 handled_by 外键同域，可作为后台处理人落库。
 * 资金补偿/退款继续走退款与争议领域，不在本仓储混合处理。
 */
final class DatabaseAdminRepairResolutionRepository implements AdminRepairResolutionRepository
{
    private Database $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    public function resolve(
        array $operator,
        string $orderNo,
        string $afterSaleNo,
        string $decision,
        string $note
    ): array {
        $channel = trim((string)($operator['channel'] ?? ''));
        $operatorUserId = (int)($operator['user_id'] ?? 0);
        if (!in_array($channel, ['mini_admin','web_admin'], true) || $operatorUserId < 1) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('管理员身份无效', 'ADMIN_REQUIRED', 403);
        }
        if (!in_array($decision, ['continue','resolved','closed'], true)) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台售后处理动作无效', 'REPAIR_PLATFORM_DECISION_INVALID', 422);
        }

        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($channel,$operatorUserId,$orderNo,$afterSaleNo,$decision,$note): array {
            $order = $db->fetch(
                'SELECT id,public_no,version FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE',
                ['public_no'=>$orderNo]
            );
            if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在', 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);

            $afterSale = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT * FROM after_sales
                 WHERE order_id=:order_id AND BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no AND type='warranty_repair'
                 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['order_id'=>$order['id'],'public_no'=>$afterSaleNo]
            );
            if (!$afterSale) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('维修售后不存在', 'REPAIR_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            }
            if (!in_array((string)$afterSale['status'], ['open','processing'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('该售后已结束，请刷新', 'REPAIR_PLATFORM_REVIEW_CHANGED', 409);
            }

            $currentResolution = (string)($afterSale['resolution'] ?? '');
            $alreadyContinued = strpos($currentResolution, '平台介入：要求继续维修：') === 0;
            $hasIntervention = strpos($currentResolution, '用户申请平台介入') === 0;
            if (!$hasIntervention) {
                $hasIntervention = (bool)$db->fetchValue(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM order_events
                     WHERE order_id=:order_id AND event_type='repair_platform_intervention_requested'
                       AND payload_json LIKE :needle
                     ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                    [
                        'order_id'=>$order['id'],
                        'needle'=>'%"after_sale_id":"'.$afterSaleNo.'"%',
                    ]
                );
            }
            if (!$hasIntervention) {
                throw new OrderOperationException(
                    '请先由用户按规则申请平台介入',
                    'REPAIR_PLATFORM_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED',
                    409
                );
            }
            if ($decision === 'continue' && $alreadyContinued) {
                throw new OrderOperationException(
                    '平台已要求继续维修，请等待处理后再确认解决或关闭售后',
                    'REPAIR_PLATFORM_CONTINUE_ALREADY_REQUESTED',
                    409
                );
            }

            $status = 'processing';
            $resolution = '平台介入：要求继续维修：'.$note;
            $eventType = 'repair_platform_continue';
            $message = '平台介入后要求师傅继续维修：'.$note;
            $closeNow = 0;
            if ($decision === 'resolved') {
                $status = 'resolved';
                $resolution = '平台裁定：问题已解决：'.$note;
                $eventType = 'repair_platform_resolved';
                $message = '平台已确认本次售后问题解决：'.$note;
                $closeNow = 1;
            } elseif ($decision === 'closed') {
                $status = 'closed';
                $resolution = '平台裁定：关闭售后：'.$note;
                $eventType = 'repair_platform_closed';
                $message = '平台已关闭本次售后：'.$note;
                $closeNow = 1;
            }

            $handledBy = $channel === 'web_admin' ? $operatorUserId : 0;
            $changed = $db->execute(
                "UPDATE after_sales
                 SET status=:status,resolution=:resolution,
                     handled_by=IF(:handled_by>0,:handled_by,handled_by),
                     closed_at=IF(:close_now=1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),NULL),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE id=:id AND status IN ('open','processing')",
                [
                    'status'=>$status,
                    'resolution'=>$resolution,
                    'handled_by'=>$handledBy,
                    'close_now'=>$closeNow,
                    'id'=>$afterSale['id'],
                ]
            );
            if ($changed !== 1) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('该售后状态已变化，请刷新', 'REPAIR_PLATFORM_REVIEW_CHANGED', 409);
            }

            if ($closeNow === 1) {
                if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
                    (new DatabaseChatRepairEpisodes($db,true))->close((int)$order['id'],(int)$afterSale['id']);
                }
                // 售后结束后，尚未处理的维修电话公开申请不再有业务上下文，直接关闭为 rejected。
                $db->execute(
                    "UPDATE order_worker_contact_reveal_requests
                     SET status='rejected',review_note='售后已由平台结案',reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                     WHERE order_id=:order_id AND after_sale_id=:after_sale_id AND context_type='repair' AND status='pending'",
                    ['order_id'=>$order['id'],'after_sale_id'=>$afterSale['id']]
                );
            }

            $db->execute(
                'UPDATE orders SET version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id',
                ['id'=>$order['id']]
            );

            $actorType = $channel === 'web_admin' ? 'admin' : 'mini_admin';
            $eventKey = $eventType.':'.$order['id'].':'.bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
            $payload = [
                'after_sale_id'=>$afterSaleNo,
                'decision'=>$decision,
                'note'=>$note,
                'message'=>$message,
                'operator_channel'=>$channel,
                'operator_user_id'=>$channel === 'mini_admin' ? $operatorUserId : null,
                'operator_admin_id'=>$channel === 'web_admin' ? $operatorUserId : null,
                'notify_recipients'=>['user','worker'],
            ];
            $db->insert(
                'INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at)
                 VALUES(:order_id,:event_type,:event_key,:actor_type,:actor_id,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())',
                [
                    'order_id'=>$order['id'],
                    'event_type'=>$eventType,
                    'event_key'=>$eventKey,
                    'actor_type'=>$actorType,
                    'actor_id'=>$operatorUserId,
                    'payload'=>json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES),
                ]
            );
            OrderNotificationService::queue($db, (int)$order['id'], $eventKey, $eventType, $payload);

            return [
                'order_id'=>(string)$order['public_no'],
                'after_sale_id'=>$afterSaleNo,
                'status'=>$status,
                'decision'=>$decision,
                'order_version'=>(int)$order['version'] + 1,
            ];
        });
    }
}

{
    private SettingsProvider $settings;
    public function __construct(SettingsProvider $settings) { $this->settings=$settings; }
    public function subscriptionTestEventOptions(string $sceneKey):array
    {
        $options=[];
        foreach(MessageEventCatalog::all() as $eventType=>$meta){
            if(!is_array($meta)||(string)($meta['subscription_scene']??'')!==$sceneKey)continue;
            $status=trim((string)($meta['status']??''));if($status==='')continue;
            $label=trim((string)($meta['label']??''));if($label==='')$label=$status;
            $options[(string)$eventType]=['label'=>$label,'status'=>$status];
        }
        return $options;
    }

    public function subscriptionTestSampleValues(string $sceneKey):array
    {
        $eventOptions= $this->subscriptionTestEventOptions($sceneKey);$first=$eventOptions?(array)reset($eventOptions):[];
        $platformName=trim((string)$this->settings->get('site.name','壁选'));if($platformName==='')$platformName='壁选';
        return [
            'order_no'=>'TEST'.date('YmdHis'),
            'status'=>(string)($first['status']??'测试通知'),
            'time'=>date('Y-m-d H:i'),
            'amount'=>'128.00',
            'quote_party'=>'张师傅',
            'platform_name'=>$platformName,
            'merchant_name'=>'示例家居门店',
            'worker_name'=>'张师傅',
            'service_category'=>'墙布施工',
            'order_title'=>'客厅墙布施工',
            'service_address'=>'杭州市西湖区示例路',
            'requirement_note'=>'墙面需先检查基层',
            'audit_note'=>'资料齐全，审核通过',
            'expected_visit_time'=>date('Y-m-d H:i',time()+86400),
            'contact_name'=>'张**',
            'appointment_time'=>date('Y-m-d H:i',time()+86400),
            'appointment_note'=>'上门前请电话联系',
        ];
    }

    public function buildSubscriptionTestData(string $sceneKey,array $scene,array $input=[]):array
    {
        if($sceneKey==='reviewResult'){
            return [
                'name1'=>['value'=>'测试师傅'],
                'phone_number2'=>['value'=>'13800000000'],
                'phrase3'=>['value'=>'测试通知'],
                'thing5'=>['value'=>'后台订阅消息链路测试'],
            ];
        }
        $fieldMap=is_array($scene['field_map']??null)?$scene['field_map']:[];
        if(!$fieldMap)throw new \RuntimeException('该订阅场景尚未配置字段映射，不能发送测试。');
        $samples= $this->subscriptionTestSampleValues($sceneKey);
        $eventOptions= $this->subscriptionTestEventOptions($sceneKey);
        $eventPost=is_array($input['test_event_type']??null)?$input['test_event_type']:[];
        $eventType=trim((string)($eventPost[$sceneKey]??''));
        if($eventType!==''&&isset($eventOptions[$eventType]))$samples['status']=(string)$eventOptions[$eventType]['status'];
        $valuesPost=is_array($input['test_values']??null)?($input['test_values'][$sceneKey]??[]):[];
        if(is_array($valuesPost)){
            foreach($valuesPost as $semantic=>$value){
                $semantic=(string)$semantic;if(!array_key_exists($semantic,$samples)||is_array($value))continue;
                // 有真实业务节点可选时，状态必须来自事件目录，避免“测试成功但生产不存在这种状态”。
                if($semantic==='status'&&$eventOptions)continue;
                $value=mb_substr(trim((string)$value),0,500);if($value!=='')$samples[$semantic]=$value;
            }
        }
        $data=[];
        foreach($fieldMap as $semantic=>$wechatKey){
            $semantic=(string)$semantic;$wechatKey=trim((string)$wechatKey);
            if($wechatKey===''||!array_key_exists($semantic,$samples))continue;
            $formatted=WechatTemplateValue::format($wechatKey,(string)$samples[$semantic]);
            if($formatted===null||$formatted==='')throw new \RuntimeException('测试字段 '.$semantic.' → '.$wechatKey.' 无法生成合法示例值，请检查字段映射或测试值。');
            $data[$wechatKey]=['value'=>$formatted];
        }
        foreach((array)($scene['field_defaults']??[]) as $wechatKey=>$fixedValue){
            $wechatKey=trim((string)$wechatKey);$fixedValue=trim((string)$fixedValue);
            if($wechatKey===''||$fixedValue===''||isset($data[$wechatKey]))continue;
            $formatted=WechatTemplateValue::format($wechatKey,$fixedValue);
            if($formatted===null||$formatted==='')throw new \RuntimeException('固定字段 '.$wechatKey.' 无法生成合法测试值，请检查高级设置。');
            $data[$wechatKey]=['value'=>$formatted];
        }
        foreach((array)($scene['template_fields']??[]) as $templateField)if(!isset($data[$templateField]))throw new \RuntimeException('模板字段 '.$templateField.' 尚未配置数据来源，不能测试发送。');
        if(!$data)throw new \RuntimeException('没有可用于测试发送的模板字段。');
        return $data;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Messaging;

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\MessageEventCatalog;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\OrderMessageDefinition;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\WechatTemplateValue;

final class OrderSubscriptionQueue
{

    public static function subscriptionBusinessValues(Database $db,int $orderId,string $eventType,array $definition,array $parameters):array
    {
        $row=$db->fetch("SELECT o.public_no,o.order_source_type,o.merchant_profile_id,o.category_name_snapshot,o.category_names_snapshot,o.title,o.description,o.audit_note,o.expected_visit_at,o.city,o.district,o.address_summary,o.assigned_worker_id,mp.business_name merchant_business_name,oa.address_summary address_snapshot,oa.contact_name_masked,wp.display_name worker_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN merchant_profiles mp ON mp.id=o.merchant_profile_id LEFT JOIN order_addresses oa ON oa.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN worker_profiles wp ON wp.id=o.assigned_worker_id WHERE o.id=:id LIMIT 1",['id'=>$orderId]);
        if(!$row)$row=[];
        $appointment=$db->fetch("SELECT appointment_at,note,wait_customer_notice FROM appointment_records WHERE order_id=:id AND context_type='service' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",['id'=>$orderId]);
        if(!$appointment)$appointment=[];
        $platformName=trim((string)\setting('site.name','壁选'));
        if($platformName==='')$platformName='壁选';
        $serviceCategory=trim((string)($row['category_names_snapshot']??''));
        if($serviceCategory===''||$serviceCategory==='不确定类目')$serviceCategory=trim((string)($row['category_name_snapshot']??''));
        if($serviceCategory==='')$serviceCategory='施工服务';
        $orderTitle=trim((string)($row['title']??''));if($orderTitle==='')$orderTitle=$serviceCategory;
        $address=trim((string)($row['address_snapshot']??''));if($address==='')$address=trim((string)($row['address_summary']??''));
        if($address==='')$address=trim((string)(($row['city']??'').($row['district']??'')));if($address==='')$address='请查看订单详情';
        $merchantName=trim((string)($row['merchant_business_name']??''));if($merchantName==='')$merchantName=((string)($row['order_source_type']??'consumer')==='merchant'?'商家订单':'个人订单');
        $workerName=trim((string)($row['worker_name']??''));if($workerName==='')$workerName='待安排师傅';
        $requirement=trim((string)($row['description']??''));if($requirement==='')$requirement='无特殊要求';
        $auditNote=trim((string)($row['audit_note']??''));if($auditNote==='')$auditNote='请查看订单详情';
        $expectedVisit=trim((string)($row['expected_visit_at']??''));if($expectedVisit==='')$expectedVisit=(string)($parameters['time']??date('Y-m-d H:i'));
        $appointmentTime=trim((string)($appointment['appointment_at']??''));if($appointmentTime==='')$appointmentTime=$expectedVisit;
        $appointmentNote=trim((string)($appointment['note']??''));
        if($appointmentNote==='')$appointmentNote=!empty($appointment['wait_customer_notice'])?'等待客户另行通知':'请查看订单详情';
        $quoteParty=$eventType==='platform_quoted'?$platformName:($workerName==='待安排师傅'?'师傅报价':$workerName);
        return [
            'order_no'=>(string)($parameters['order_no']??($row['public_no']??'')),
            'status'=>(string)($definition['status']??($parameters['status']??'')),
            'time'=>(string)($parameters['time']??date('Y-m-d H:i')),
            'amount'=>(string)($parameters['amount']??'0.00').'元',
            'quote_party'=>$quoteParty,
            'platform_name'=>$platformName,
            'merchant_name'=>$merchantName,
            'worker_name'=>$workerName,
            'service_category'=>$serviceCategory,
            'order_title'=>$orderTitle,
            'service_address'=>$address,
            'requirement_note'=>$requirement,
            'audit_note'=>$auditNote,
            'expected_visit_time'=>$expectedVisit,
            'contact_name'=>trim((string)($row['contact_name_masked']??''))?:'订单联系人',
            'appointment_time'=>$appointmentTime,
            'appointment_note'=>$appointmentNote,
        ];
    }

    public static function queueOrderSubscription(Database $db, int $orderId, string $eventKey, string $eventType, array $definition, array $order, array $parameters, array $smsFallback=[], string $sceneOverride=''): array
    {
        $sceneKey=$sceneOverride!==''?$sceneOverride:self::subscriptionSceneForEvent($eventType);if($sceneKey==='')return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'scene_missing'];
        $scenes=SubscriptionCatalog::subscriptionSceneDefinitions();$scene=$scenes[$sceneKey]??null;
        if(!$scene)return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'scene_missing'];
        if(empty($scene['available'])||empty($scene['field_map']))return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>(string)($scene['availability_reason']??'scene_unavailable')];
        $recipient=(string)($scene['recipient']??'user');
        if(!in_array($recipient,(array)($definition['recipients']??[]),true))return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'recipient_mismatch'];
        $workerProfile=null;
        if($recipient==='worker'){
            if(empty($order['assigned_worker_id']))return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'worker_missing'];
            $workerProfile=$db->fetch('SELECT user_id FROM worker_profiles WHERE id=:id LIMIT 1',['id'=>(int)$order['assigned_worker_id']]);
            if(!$workerProfile)return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'worker_missing'];
        }
        $userId=$recipient==='worker'?(int)$workerProfile['user_id']:(int)$order['user_id'];
        $pref=SubscriptionQuotaStore::subscriptionPreferences($db,$userId)[$sceneKey]??[];
        $authorizationStatus=(string)($pref['authorization_status']??'');
        $subscriptionType=(string)($scene['subscription_type']??'one_time');
        if($subscriptionType==='one_time'){
            if(in_array($authorizationStatus,['ban','disabled'],true))return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>$authorizationStatus];
            if(max(0,(int)($pref['remaining_count']??0))<1)return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'count_exhausted'];
        }else{
            if(empty($pref['enabled'])||!in_array($authorizationStatus,['accept','acceptWithAudio','acceptWithAlert'],true))return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'not_authorized'];
        }
        $openid=(string)$db->fetchValue("SELECT openid FROM wechat_identities WHERE user_id=:id AND status='active' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",['id'=>$userId]);
        if($openid==='')return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'openid_missing'];
        $values=self::subscriptionBusinessValues($db,$orderId,$eventType,$definition,$parameters);
        $data=[];
        foreach((array)$scene['field_map'] as $semantic=>$wechatKey){
            $wechatKey=trim((string)$wechatKey);
            if(!isset($values[$semantic])||preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_]+\d+$/',$wechatKey)!==1)continue;
            $formatted=WechatTemplateValue::format($wechatKey,(string)$values[$semantic]);
            if($formatted===null||$formatted==='')return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'template_data_invalid'];
            $data[$wechatKey]=['value'=>$formatted];
        }
        foreach((array)($scene['field_defaults']??[]) as $wechatKey=>$fixedValue){
            $wechatKey=trim((string)$wechatKey);$fixedValue=trim((string)$fixedValue);
            if($wechatKey===''||$fixedValue===''||isset($data[$wechatKey]))continue;
            $formatted=WechatTemplateValue::format($wechatKey,$fixedValue);
            if($formatted===null||$formatted==='')return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'template_data_invalid'];
            $data[$wechatKey]=['value'=>$formatted];
        }
        foreach((array)($scene['template_fields']??[]) as $templateField)if(!isset($data[$templateField]))return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'template_data_missing'];
        if(!$data)return ['queued'=>false,'reason'=>'template_data_missing'];
        $page=$recipient==='worker'?'pages/workerOrder/detail?id=':'pages/userOrder/detail?id=';
        self::enqueueWechatSubscribe($db,$eventKey.':'.$recipient.':wxsub',$userId,$sceneKey,$openid,(string)$scene['template_id'],$page.rawurlencode((string)$order['public_no']),$data,$smsFallback);
        return ['queued'=>true,'reason'=>'queued'];
    }

    public static function queueWorkerOrderUpdateSupplement(Database $db,int $orderId,string $eventKey,string $eventType,array $definition,array $order,array $parameters,bool $fallbackMode=false):void
    {
        if(!in_array('worker',(array)($definition['recipients']??[]),true)||empty($order['assigned_worker_id']))return;
        $primaryKey=self::subscriptionSceneForEvent($eventType);
        $scenes=SubscriptionCatalog::subscriptionSceneDefinitions();
        $primary=$primaryKey!==''?($scenes[$primaryKey]??null):null;
        if(is_array($primary)&&(string)($primary['recipient']??'user')==='worker')return;
        $meta=MessageEventCatalog::get($eventType)??[];
        $important=((string)($meta['priority']??'normal')==='important')||$eventType==='worker_assigned';
        if(!$important)return;
        $workerFallback=$fallbackMode
            ? self::buildSubscriptionFallbackSmsPayload($db,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,$definition,$order,$parameters,'worker')
            : null;
        $result=self::queueOrderSubscription(
            $db,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,$definition,$order,$parameters,
            is_array($workerFallback)?$workerFallback:[],
            'worker_order_update'
        );
        if($fallbackMode&&empty($result['queued'])&&is_array($workerFallback)){
            $workerFallback['fallback_reason']=(string)($result['reason']??'worker_subscription_unavailable');
            self::enqueueSmsFallback($db,$workerFallback);
        }
    }

    public static function subscriptionSceneForEvent(string $eventType): string
    {
        $meta = MessageEventCatalog::get($eventType);
        return $meta ? (string)($meta['subscription_scene'] ?? '') : '';
    }

    public static function enqueueWechatSubscribe(Database $db,string $businessKey,int $userId,string $sceneKey,string $openid,string $templateId,string $page,array $data,array $smsFallback=[]):void
    {
        $payload=['user_id'=>$userId,'scene_key'=>$sceneKey,'openid'=>$openid,'template_id'=>$templateId,'page'=>$page,'data'=>$data];
        if($smsFallback)$payload['sms_fallback']=$smsFallback;
        $db->execute("INSERT IGNORE INTO message_outbox(topic,business_key,payload_json,status,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,created_at) VALUES('wechat_subscribe',:business_key,:payload,'pending',0,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['business_key'=>substr($businessKey,0,128),'payload'=>json_encode($payload,JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)]);
    }

    public static function buildSubscriptionFallbackSmsPayload(Database $db,int $orderId,string $eventKey,string $eventType,array $definition,array $order,array $parameters,string $recipientOverride=''):?array
    {
        $meta=MessageEventCatalog::get($eventType);
        if(!$meta||empty($meta['sms_subscription_fallback']))return null;
        $sceneKey=(string)($meta['subscription_scene']??'');if($sceneKey==='')return null;
        $scenes=SubscriptionCatalog::subscriptionSceneDefinitions();$scene=$scenes[$sceneKey]??null;if(!$scene)return null;
        $recipient=in_array($recipientOverride,['user','worker'],true)?$recipientOverride:(string)($scene['recipient']??'user');
        if(!in_array($recipient,(array)($definition['recipients']??[]),true))return null;
        $recipientId=0;$mobile='';
        if($recipient==='user'){
            $recipientId=(int)$order['user_id'];
            $mobile=\decrypt_private_value((string)$order['user_mobile'],'user-mobile');
        }elseif($recipient==='worker'&&!empty($order['assigned_worker_id'])){
            $recipientId=(int)$order['assigned_worker_id'];
            $row=$db->fetch('SELECT mobile_ciphertext FROM worker_profiles WHERE id=:id LIMIT 1',['id'=>$recipientId]);
            $mobile=$row?\decrypt_private_value((string)$row['mobile_ciphertext'],'worker-mobile'):'';
        }
        if($recipientId<1||$mobile==='')return null;
        return [
            'business_key'=>substr($eventKey.':'.$recipient.':'.$recipientId.':sms-fallback',0,128),
            'mobile'=>$mobile,
            'sms_scene'=>(string)$definition['scene'],
            'parameters'=>$parameters,
            'event_type'=>$eventType,
            'order_id'=>$orderId,
            'recipient_type'=>$recipient,
            'recipient_id'=>$recipientId,
            'delivery_mode'=>'subscription_fallback',
        ];
    }

    public static function enqueueSmsFallback(Database $db,array $fallback):bool
    {
        $eventType=trim((string)($fallback['event_type']??''));
        if($eventType===''||!\filter_var(\setting('sms.enabled',false),FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN)||!self::eventEnabled('sms.event_switches',$eventType))return false;
        $meta=MessageEventCatalog::get($eventType);
        if(!$meta||empty($meta['sms_subscription_fallback']))return false;
        $smsScene=trim((string)($fallback['sms_scene']??''));if($smsScene==='')return false;
        $templates=\setting('sms.template_codes',[]);if(!is_array($templates))return false;
        $configured=$templates[$smsScene]??'';
        $templateCode=is_array($configured)?(string)(($configured['template_code']??'')?:($configured['template_id']??'')?:($configured['code']??'')):(string)$configured;
        $mobile=trim((string)($fallback['mobile']??''));
        $businessKey=trim((string)($fallback['business_key']??''));
        if($templateCode===''||$mobile===''||$businessKey==='')return false;
        $payload=[
            'mobile'=>$mobile,
            'template_code'=>$templateCode,
            'parameters'=>is_array($fallback['parameters']??null)?$fallback['parameters']:[],
            'event_type'=>$eventType,
            'order_id'=>(int)($fallback['order_id']??0),
            'recipient_type'=>(string)($fallback['recipient_type']??'user'),
            'recipient_id'=>(int)($fallback['recipient_id']??0),
            'delivery_mode'=>'subscription_fallback',
            'fallback_reason'=>(string)($fallback['fallback_reason']??'wechat_unavailable'),
        ];
        $businessKey=substr($businessKey,0,128);
        $affected=$db->execute("INSERT IGNORE INTO message_outbox(topic,business_key,payload_json,status,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,created_at) VALUES('aliyun_sms',:business_key,:payload,'pending',0,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",[
            'business_key'=>$businessKey,
            'payload'=>json_encode($payload,JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES),
        ]);
        if($affected===1)return true;
        return (bool)$db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM message_outbox WHERE topic='aliyun_sms' AND BINARY business_key=BINARY :business_key LIMIT 1",['business_key'=>$businessKey]);
    }

    public static function eventEnabled(string $settingKey, string $eventType): bool
    {
        $channel = strpos($settingKey, 'wecom.') === 0 ? 'wecom' : (strpos($settingKey, 'notification.') === 0 ? 'inapp' : 'sms');
        $configured = \setting($settingKey, []);
        return MessageEventCatalog::enabled($channel, $eventType, is_array($configured) ? $configured : []);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Settings;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\SettingsProvider;

/**
 * 兼容现有 setting() 的基础设施适配器。
 */
final class GlobalSettingsProvider implements SettingsProvider
{
    public function get(string $key, $default = null)
    {
        return \setting($key, $default);
    }

    public function bool(string $key, bool $default = false): bool
    {
        $value = $this->get($key, $default);
        if (is_bool($value)) {
            return $value;
        }
        $filtered = filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
        return $filtered === null ? $default : $filtered;
    }

    public function int(string $key, int $default = 0): int
    {
        $value = $this->get($key, $default);
        return is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : $default;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\PlatformOrderSettlementPolicy;

/**
 * 平台单验收的资金侧事务步骤。调用者必须已锁定 orders、order_platform_terms、assignments，
 * 并处于同一个事务；本类不单独提交事务、不生成虚假的客户支付记录。
 * 普通客户订单（包括后台代下单）不调用该类，也绝不创建普通订单服务费。
 */
final class PlatformOrderSettlementWriter
{
    private PlatformOrderSettlementPolicy $policy;
    private PlatformOrderBookingPaymentVerifier $bookingVerifier;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->policy = new PlatformOrderSettlementPolicy();
        $this->bookingVerifier = new PlatformOrderBookingPaymentVerifier();
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string,mixed> $order
     * @param array<string,mixed> $terms
     * @param array<string,mixed> $assignment
     * @return array<string,int|string>
     */
    public function apply(Database $db, array $order, array $terms, array $assignment): array
    {
        $orderId = (int)($order['id'] ?? 0);
        $workerId = (int)($order['assigned_worker_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($orderId < 1 || (string)($order['order_source_type'] ?? '') !== 'platform'
            || (int)($terms['order_id'] ?? 0) !== $orderId
            || (string)($terms['customer_flow_mode'] ?? '') !== 'platform_managed'
            || (int)($assignment['worker_id'] ?? 0) !== $workerId
            || $workerId < 1
            || (string)($assignment['status'] ?? '') !== 'accepted'
            || (string)($terms['settlement_status'] ?? '') !== 'pending') {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台单结算关系或状态已变化，请刷新后重试', 'PLATFORM_SETTLEMENT_STATE_CHANGED', 409);
        }
        // 师傅现场收款凭证是客户向师傅付款的证据，不等同于师傅已向平台付清收入款。
        $receiptCount = (int)$db->fetchValue(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_links ml JOIN media_files mf ON mf.id=ml.media_file_id AND mf.status='active'
             WHERE ml.entity_type='order' AND ml.entity_id=:order_id AND ml.purpose='collection_receipt'",
            ['order_id'=>$orderId]
        );
        if ($receiptCount < 1) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('师傅尚未上传客户现场收款凭证，当前不能验收', 'COLLECTION_RECEIPT_REQUIRED', 409);
        }

        // booking_paid_cents 对平台单表示“外部渠道已实际收取的客户预付款”。
        // orders.booking_fee_cents 属于普通订单微信预约费口径，平台单不得再读取或抵扣它。
        $bookingPaid = $this->bookingVerifier->verifiedPaidCents(
            $db,
            $orderId,
            (int)$terms['customer_contract_total_cents'],
            (int)($terms['booking_paid_cents'] ?? 0),
            'platform_managed'
        );
        $calculation = $this->policy->settlement(
            (int)$terms['customer_contract_total_cents'],
            (int)$terms['worker_labor_cents'],
            $bookingPaid,
            (string)$terms['worker_settlement_mode']
        );
        $platformReceivable = (int)$calculation['platform_receivable_cents'];
        $workerCredit = (int)$calculation['worker_balance_credit_cents'];
        $freezeDays = max(0, (int)$terms['worker_balance_freeze_days_snapshot']);
        $status = $platformReceivable > 0 ? 'awaiting_platform_income' : 'settled';

        $changed = $db->execute(
            "UPDATE order_platform_terms SET booking_paid_cents=:booking,customer_tail_cents=:tail,
                    platform_receivable_cents=:platform_income,worker_balance_credit_cents=:worker_credit,
                    settlement_status=:status,settled_at=IF(:settled_status='settled',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),NULL),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
             WHERE order_id=:order_id AND settlement_status='pending' AND customer_flow_mode='platform_managed'",
            [
                'booking'=>$calculation['booking_paid_cents'],
                'tail'=>$calculation['customer_tail_cents'],
                'platform_income'=>$platformReceivable,'worker_credit'=>$workerCredit,
                'status'=>$status,'settled_status'=>$status,'order_id'=>$orderId,
            ]
        );
        if ($changed !== 1) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台结算已被处理，请刷新后重试', 'PLATFORM_SETTLEMENT_ALREADY_POSTED', 409);
        }
        $assignmentChanged = $db->execute(
            "UPDATE assignments SET status='completed',
                    estimated_commission_cents=0,estimated_net_income_cents=:labor,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
             WHERE id=:id AND worker_id=:worker_id AND status='accepted'",
            ['labor'=>$terms['worker_labor_cents'],'id'=>$assignment['id'],'worker_id'=>$workerId]
        );
        if ($assignmentChanged !== 1) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('成交师傅关系已变化，请刷新后重试', 'PLATFORM_ASSIGNMENT_CHANGED', 409);
        }
        if ($workerCredit > 0) {
            $entry = $this->policy->workerBalanceEntry($workerCredit, $freezeDays);
            $idempotencyKey = 'platform-order:'.$orderId.':worker-income';
            $existing = $db->fetch(
                'SELECT id FROM worker_balance_ledger WHERE idempotency_key=:key LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE',
                ['key'=>$idempotencyKey]
            );
            if ($existing) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('师傅工费入账记录已存在，请先核对，禁止重复入账', 'PLATFORM_WORKER_CREDIT_ALREADY_POSTED', 409);
            }
            $inserted = $db->execute(
                "INSERT INTO worker_balance_ledger(worker_id,entry_type,direction,amount_cents,available_delta_cents,frozen_delta_cents,
                        business_type,business_id,idempotency_key,description,status,created_at)
                 VALUES(:worker_id,:entry_type,'credit',:amount,:available,:frozen,'platform_order',:business_id,:key,:description,'effective',UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                [
                    'worker_id'=>$workerId,'entry_type'=>$entry['entry_type'],'amount'=>$workerCredit,
                    'available'=>$entry['available_delta_cents'],'frozen'=>$entry['frozen_delta_cents'],
                    'business_id'=>$orderId,'key'=>$idempotencyKey,
                    'description'=>$freezeDays === 0 ? '平台承接单工费结算进入可提现余额' : '平台承接单工费进入冻结余额',
                ]
            );
            if ($inserted !== 1) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('师傅余额入账失败，验收已自动回滚', 'PLATFORM_WORKER_CREDIT_FAILED', 409);
            }
        }
        return $calculation + [
            'settlement_status'=>$status,
            'worker_settlement_mode'=>(string)$terms['worker_settlement_mode'],
            'freeze_days'=>$freezeDays,
        ];
    }
}
