<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Scheduling;

use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence\OrderFormMediaRules;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence\PlatformOrderBookingPaymentVerifier;

/** V2.5.0 平台承接单自动发布。 */
final class PlatformOrderAutoPublishTask
{
    private const JOB = 'platform_auto_publish';

    private Database $db;
    private int $limit;
    private PlatformOrderBookingPaymentVerifier $prepaymentVerifier;

    public function __construct(Database $db, int $limit = 100)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->limit = max(1, min(500, $limit));
        $this->prepaymentVerifier = new PlatformOrderBookingPaymentVerifier();
    }

    public function run(): array
    {
        $runUuid = $this->uuidV4();
        $runId = $this->db->insert(
            "INSERT INTO scheduler_runs(run_uuid,job_name,status,host_name,process_id,scanned_count,success_count,failure_count,started_at)
             VALUES(:uuid,:job,'running',:host,:pid,0,0,0,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            ['uuid'=>$runUuid,'job'=>self::JOB,'host'=>substr((string)gethostname(),0,128),'pid'=>function_exists('getmypid')?(int)getmypid():null]
        );
        $startedAt = microtime(true);
        $stats = ['scanned'=>0,'success'=>0,'failure'=>0];
        $error = null;

        try {
            $cursorUpdatedAt = null;
            $cursorId = 0;
            do {
                $cursorSql = '';
                $params = [];
                if ($cursorUpdatedAt !== null) {
                    $cursorSql = ' AND (o.updated_at>:cursor_updated OR (o.updated_at=:cursor_updated_eq AND o.id>:cursor_id))';
                    $params = ['cursor_updated'=>$cursorUpdatedAt,'cursor_updated_eq'=>$cursorUpdatedAt,'cursor_id'=>$cursorId];
                }
                $rows = $this->db->fetchAll(
                    "SELECT o.id,o.version,o.updated_at
                     FROM orders o
                     INNER JOIN order_platform_terms t ON t.order_id=o.id
                     WHERE o.order_source_type='platform'
                       AND t.customer_flow_mode='platform_managed'
                       AND t.settlement_status='pending'
                       AND t.customer_contract_total_cents>0
                       AND t.booking_paid_cents<=t.customer_contract_total_cents
                       AND o.booking_fee_cents=0
                       AND COALESCE(o.is_demo,0)=0
                       AND o.lifecycle_status='active'
                       AND o.publish_status<>'published'
                       AND o.audit_status IN ('pending','approved')
                       AND COALESCE(o.refund_status,'none') IN ('','none')
                       AND o.selected_quote_id IS NULL
                       AND o.assigned_worker_id IS NULL
                       AND o.current_assignment_id IS NULL
                       AND o.quote_status IN ('waiting','quoting','collecting')
                       AND NOT EXISTS(
                           SELECT 1 FROM payment_orders p
                           WHERE p.order_id=o.id AND p.business_type IN ('order_booking','booking_fee') AND p.status='paid'
                       )
                       AND NOT EXISTS(
                           SELECT 1 FROM scheduled_job_failures f
                           WHERE f.job_name='platform_auto_publish'
                             AND f.business_key=CONCAT('order:',o.id)
                             AND f.business_version=o.version
                             AND f.resolved_at IS NULL
                             AND f.next_retry_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                       )
                       {$cursorSql}
                     ORDER BY o.updated_at,o.id
                     LIMIT {$this->limit}",
                    $params
                );
                if (!$rows) break;
                $stats['scanned'] += count($rows);
                foreach ($rows as $row) {
                    $orderId = (int)$row['id'];
                    $version = max(1,(int)$row['version']);
                    try {
                        if ($this->publishOne($orderId)) $stats['success']++;
                    } catch (Throwable $exception) {
                        $stats['failure']++;
                        $this->recordFailure($runId,$orderId,$version,$exception);
                    }
                }
                $last = $rows[count($rows)-1];
                $cursorUpdatedAt = (string)$last['updated_at'];
                $cursorId = (int)$last['id'];
            } while (count($rows) === $this->limit);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            $stats['failure']++;
            $error = mb_substr($exception->getMessage(),0,4000);
            $this->recordFailure($runId,0,1,$exception,'task:'.self::JOB);
        }

        if ($error === null && $stats['failure'] > 0) $error = '本批次有 '.$stats['failure'].' 笔平台承接单自动发布失败，请查看异常工作台。';
        $status = $stats['failure'] > 0 ? 'failed' : 'success';
        $this->db->execute(
            "UPDATE scheduler_runs SET status=:status,scanned_count=:scanned,success_count=:success,failure_count=:failure,finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),error_message=:error WHERE id=:id",
            ['status'=>$status,'scanned'=>$stats['scanned'],'success'=>$stats['success'],'failure'=>$stats['failure'],'error'=>$error,'id'=>$runId]
        );
        if ($status === 'success') {
            $this->db->execute("UPDATE scheduled_job_failures SET resolved_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE job_name=:job AND business_key=:key AND resolved_at IS NULL",['job'=>self::JOB,'key'=>'task:'.self::JOB]);
        }
        if ($stats['success'] === 0 && $stats['failure'] === 0) {
            $this->db->execute("DELETE FROM scheduler_runs WHERE job_name=:job AND id<>:id AND status='success' AND success_count=0 AND failure_count=0",['job'=>self::JOB,'id'=>$runId]);
        }

        return ['run_id'=>$runId,'run_uuid'=>$runUuid,'task'=>self::JOB,'status'=>$status,'scanned'=>$stats['scanned'],'success'=>$stats['success'],'failure'=>$stats['failure'],'duration_ms'=>(int)round((microtime(true)-$startedAt)*1000),'error'=>$error];
    }

    /**
     * 管理员恢复入口只重检这一张订单，复用自动发布的完整锁内校验，不运行整批 scheduler。
     * 已经发布视为幂等成功；当前业务条件不满足时只返回 not_ready，不伪造状态。
     * @return array{ok:bool,status:string,message:string}
     */
    public function retryOrder(int $orderId): array
    {
        $order = $this->db->fetch('SELECT id,publish_status FROM orders WHERE id=:id LIMIT 1', ['id'=>$orderId]);
        if (!$order) return ['ok'=>false,'status'=>'not_found','message'=>'订单不存在'];
        if ((string)$order['publish_status'] === 'published') {
            $this->db->execute(
                "UPDATE scheduled_job_failures SET resolved_at=COALESCE(resolved_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP())
                 WHERE job_name=:job AND business_key=:key AND resolved_at IS NULL",
                ['job'=>self::JOB,'key'=>'order:'.$orderId]
            );
            return ['ok'=>true,'status'=>'already_published','message'=>'订单已经发布，无需重复处理'];
        }
        try {
            $published = $this->publishOne($orderId);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            return ['ok'=>false,'status'=>'failed','message'=>mb_substr($exception->getMessage(),0,500)];
        }
        if (!$published) return ['ok'=>false,'status'=>'not_ready','message'=>'订单当前条件仍不满足自动发布，请按最新状态处理'];
        return ['ok'=>true,'status'=>'published','message'=>'重新检查通过，订单已发布'];
    }

    private function publishOne(int $orderId): bool
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($orderId): bool {
            $order = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT o.*,t.customer_flow_mode,t.customer_contract_total_cents,t.booking_paid_cents,t.settlement_status
                 FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_platform_terms t ON t.order_id=o.id
                 WHERE o.id=:id AND o.order_source_type='platform' FOR UPDATE",
                ['id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if (!$order
                || (int)($order['is_demo']??0)!==0
                || (string)$order['customer_flow_mode']!=='platform_managed'
                || (string)$order['settlement_status']!=='pending'
                || (int)$order['booking_fee_cents']!==0
                || (int)$order['customer_contract_total_cents']<=0
                || (int)$order['booking_paid_cents']>(int)$order['customer_contract_total_cents']
                || (string)$order['lifecycle_status']!=='active'
                || (string)$order['publish_status']==='published'
                || !in_array((string)$order['audit_status'],['pending','approved'],true)
                || !in_array((string)($order['refund_status']??'none'),['','none'],true)
                || !empty($order['selected_quote_id'])
                || !empty($order['assigned_worker_id'])
                || !empty($order['current_assignment_id'])
                || !in_array((string)$order['quote_status'],['waiting','quoting','collecting'],true)
                || $this->hasBlockingBusiness($db,$orderId)) return false;
            if ($order['lat']===null || $order['lng']===null) throw new RuntimeException('平台承接单缺少地图坐标，系统已停止自动发布，请补充地址后处理');
            $mediaReadiness = OrderFormMediaRules::readiness($db,$orderId,(int)($order['form_schema_version_id']??0),(string)($order['workflow_profile']??'construction'));
            if (empty($mediaReadiness['ready'])) return false;

            $this->prepaymentVerifier->verifiedPaidCents($db,$orderId,(int)$order['customer_contract_total_cents'],(int)$order['booking_paid_cents'],'platform_managed');
            $quoteDays = max(1,min(30,(int)\setting('order.auto_cancel_days',7)));
            $version = max(1,(int)$order['version']);
            $changed = $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET audit_status='approved',publish_status='published',quote_status='waiting',audited_at=COALESCE(audited_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),published_at=COALESCE(published_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),quote_deadline_at=COALESCE(quote_deadline_at,DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL {$quoteDays} DAY)),audit_note='平台托管条件核验通过后系统自动发布',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id AND order_source_type='platform' AND booking_fee_cents=0 AND lifecycle_status='active' AND publish_status<>'published' AND selected_quote_id IS NULL AND assigned_worker_id IS NULL AND current_assignment_id IS NULL",
                ['id'=>$orderId]
            );
            if ($changed!==1) return false;

            $eventKey='scheduler:'.self::JOB.':order:'.$orderId.':v'.$version;
            $payload=json_encode(['quote_days'=>$quoteDays,'external_prepayment_cents'=>(int)$order['booking_paid_cents'],'message'=>'平台承接单托管条件与公共下单资料完整，系统自动审核并发布，无需管理员二次确认。'],JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
            $db->execute("INSERT IGNORE INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(:order_id,'platform_order_auto_published',:event_key,'system',NULL,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['order_id'=>$orderId,'event_key'=>substr($eventKey,0,128),'payload'=>is_string($payload)?$payload:'{}']);
            $db->execute("UPDATE scheduled_job_failures SET resolved_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE job_name=:job AND business_key=:key AND resolved_at IS NULL",['job'=>self::JOB,'key'=>'order:'.$orderId]);
            return true;
        });
    }

    private function hasBlockingBusiness(Database $db, int $orderId): bool
    {
        return (int)$db->fetchValue(
            "SELECT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM disputes WHERE order_id=:id1 AND status IN ('open','pending','processing')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds WHERE order_id=:id2 AND status NOT IN ('failed','closed','cancelled','rejected')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_cancel_requests WHERE order_id=:id3 AND status IN ('pending','processing')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM change_requests WHERE order_id=:id4 AND status IN ('pending','processing','negotiating')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM after_sales WHERE order_id=:id5 AND status IN ('open','processing'))) AS blocked",
            ['id1'=>$orderId,'id2'=>$orderId,'id3'=>$orderId,'id4'=>$orderId,'id5'=>$orderId]
        )===1;
    }

    private function recordFailure(int $runId, int $orderId, int $version, Throwable $exception, ?string $businessKey=null): void
    {
        try {
            $key=$businessKey??('order:'.$orderId);
            $attempt=(int)$this->db->fetchValue("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no),0)+1 FROM scheduled_job_failures WHERE job_name=:job AND business_key=:key AND business_version=:version",['job'=>self::JOB,'key'=>$key,'version'=>max(1,$version)]);
            $attempt=max(1,$attempt);
            $minutes=min(1440,max(1,1<<min(10,max(0,$attempt-1))));
            $this->db->execute(
                "INSERT INTO scheduled_job_failures(job_name,business_key,business_version,scheduler_run_id,attempt_no,error_class,error_message,next_retry_at,created_at) VALUES(:job,:key,:version,:run_id,:attempt,:error_class,:error_message,DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL {$minutes} MINUTE),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                ['job'=>self::JOB,'key'=>substr($key,0,128),'version'=>max(1,$version),'run_id'=>$runId,'attempt'=>$attempt,'error_class'=>substr(get_class($exception),0,160),'error_message'=>mb_substr($exception->getMessage(),0,2000)]
            );
        } catch (Throwable $ignored) {}
    }

    private function uuidV4(): string
    {
        $data=random_bytes(16);
        $data[6]=chr((ord($data[6])&0x0f)|0x40);
        $data[8]=chr((ord($data[8])&0x3f)|0x80);
        return vsprintf('%s%s-%s-%s-%s-%s%s%s',str_split(bin2hex($data),4));
    }
}

            'measurement_extension'=>['title'=>'测量冻结延期结果','description'=>'用户申请延长冻结期的审核结果','template_id'=>'','field_map'=>[],'field_semantics'=>['order_no','status','time'],'keywords'=>['订单号','处理结果','时间']],
            'repair_progress'=>['title'=>'维修进度提醒','description'=>'师傅拒绝、已预约或可申请平台介入','template_id'=>'','field_map'=>[],'field_semantics'=>['order_no','status','time'],'keywords'=>['订单号','维修进度','时间']],
            'dispute_progress'=>['title'=>'争议处理通知','description'=>'争议处理完成或关键结果更新时通知用户','template_id'=>'','field_map'=>[],'field_semantics'=>['order_no','status','time'],'keywords'=>['订单号','处理状态','时间']],
            'user_order_update'=>['title'=>'订单重要进度通知','description'=>'派单异常、平台取消、电话公开、跑空费等需要用户及时知道的重要订单变化','template_id'=>'','field_map'=>[],'field_semantics'=>['order_no','status','time'],'keywords'=>['订单号','订单状态','更新时间'],'recipient'=>'user'],
            'worker_order_update'=>['title'=>'师傅订单重要进度','description'=>'安排接单、退款/取消、费用处理或争议等需要师傅及时知道的订单变化','template_id'=>'','field_map'=>[],'field_semantics'=>['order_no','status','time'],'keywords'=>['订单号','订单状态','更新时间'],'recipient'=>'worker'],
            'worker_repair'=>['title'=>'新维修工单','description'=>'提醒师傅及时联系用户处理售后','template_id'=>'','field_map'=>[],'field_semantics'=>['order_no','status','time'],'keywords'=>['订单号','维修任务','时间'],'recipient'=>'worker'],

        $importantScenes = [
            // 入驻审核 reviewResult 有独立提交埋点，不参与日常“一键续收”，避免审核完成后长期占用批量名额。
            'order_audit','quote_received','worker_assigned','completion_submitted','refund_result',
            'payment_pending','fee_adjustment','supplement_reminder','measurement_result','measurement_extension','repair_progress','dispute_progress',

            $scene['template_title'] = '';
            $scene['template_fields'] = [];
            $scene['synced_template_id'] = '';
            $scene['important'] = in_array($sceneKey, $importantScenes, true);
        }
        unset($scene);
        $configured = \setting('wechat.subscribe_template_ids', []);
        if (is_array($configured)) {
            foreach ($configured as $key => $row) {
                if (!isset($scenes[$key])) continue;
                if (is_string($row)) $scenes[$key]['template_id'] = trim($row);
                elseif (is_array($row)) {
                    $scenes[$key]['template_id'] = trim((string) ($row['template_id'] ?? $row['id'] ?? $scenes[$key]['template_id']));
                    $scenes[$key]['template_title'] = mb_substr(trim((string)($row['template_title'] ?? '')),0,80);
                    $scenes[$key]['synced_template_id'] = trim((string)($row['synced_template_id'] ?? ''));
                    $scenes[$key]['template_fields'] = ($scenes[$key]['synced_template_id']!==''&&hash_equals($scenes[$key]['template_id'],$scenes[$key]['synced_template_id'])&&is_array($row['template_fields'] ?? null)) ? array_values(array_filter(array_map('strval',$row['template_fields']))) : [];
                    $scenes[$key]['template_field_labels'] = is_array($row['template_field_labels'] ?? null) ? $row['template_field_labels'] : [];
                    $fieldMap = is_array($row['field_map'] ?? null) ? $row['field_map'] : [];
                    // 2.5.0：旧字段名在读取时无损迁移为明确语义；审核备注与订单需求必须按场景分开。
                    if(isset($fieldMap['service_name'])&&!isset($fieldMap['service_category'])){$fieldMap['service_category']=$fieldMap['service_name'];unset($fieldMap['service_name']);}
                    if(isset($fieldMap['remark'])){
                        if($key==='order_audit'&&!isset($fieldMap['audit_note']))$fieldMap['audit_note']=$fieldMap['remark'];
                        elseif(!isset($fieldMap['requirement_note']))$fieldMap['requirement_note']=$fieldMap['remark'];
                        unset($fieldMap['remark']);
                    }
                    // 旧 payment_success 的 merchant_name 实际发送的是“壁选”，本质是平台名称，不是订单商家。
                    if($key==='payment_success'&&isset($fieldMap['merchant_name'])&&!isset($fieldMap['platform_name'])){$fieldMap['platform_name']=$fieldMap['merchant_name'];unset($fieldMap['merchant_name']);}
                    $scenes[$key]['field_map'] = $fieldMap;
                    $scenes[$key]['field_defaults'] = is_array($row['field_defaults'] ?? null) ? $row['field_defaults'] : [];
                    $subscriptionType = trim((string) ($row['subscription_type'] ?? 'one_time'));
                    if (in_array($subscriptionType, ['one_time','long_term'], true)) $scenes[$key]['subscription_type'] = $subscriptionType;
                }
            }
        }
        $global = filter_var(\setting('wechat.subscribe_enabled', true), FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN);
        foreach ($scenes as $key => &$scene) {
            $scene['key'] = $key;
            $scene['global_enabled'] = $global;
            $requiredSemantics = array_values(array_map('strval',(array)($scene['field_semantics']??[])));
            $knownSemantics = array_fill_keys(array_keys(self::subscriptionSemanticLabels()), true);
            $fieldMap = is_array($scene['field_map']??null) ? $scene['field_map'] : [];
            $fieldDefaults = is_array($scene['field_defaults']??null) ? $scene['field_defaults'] : [];
            $templateFields=is_array($scene['template_fields']??null)?array_values(array_map('strval',$scene['template_fields'])):[];
            $mapComplete = true; $targets = [];
            // 当前场景声明的 field_semantics 是“必须来源”，必须全部映射。
            foreach($requiredSemantics as $semantic){
                $target=trim((string)($fieldMap[$semantic]??''));
                if($target===''||preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_]+\d+$/',$target)!==1||isset($targets[$target])||($templateFields&&!in_array($target,$templateFields,true))){$mapComplete=false;continue;}
                $targets[$target]=true;
            }
            // 微信模板可能比业务场景多字段。允许使用系统已知业务字段补齐，但这些不是当前场景的必填语义。
            foreach($fieldMap as $semantic=>$target){
                $semantic=(string)$semantic;$target=trim((string)$target);
                if(in_array($semantic,$requiredSemantics,true))continue;
                if(!isset($knownSemantics[$semantic])||$target===''||preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_]+\d+$/',$target)!==1||isset($targets[$target])||($templateFields&&!in_array($target,$templateFields,true))){$mapComplete=false;continue;}
                $targets[$target]=true;
            }
            foreach($fieldDefaults as $target=>$fixedValue){
                $target=trim((string)$target);$fixedValue=trim((string)$fixedValue);
                if($target===''||$fixedValue===''||preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_]+\d+$/',$target)!==1||isset($targets[$target])||($templateFields&&!in_array($target,$templateFields,true))){$mapComplete=false;continue;}
                $targets[$target]=true;
            }
            if($templateFields){
                foreach($templateFields as $templateField)if(!isset($targets[$templateField])){$mapComplete=false;break;}
            }
            $needsFieldMap = !empty($requiredSemantics)||!empty($templateFields);
            // reviewResult 是项目已验证的固定模板，字段由专用发送代码固定生成，不走通用 field_map。
            if($key==='reviewResult'){
                $mapComplete=true;
                if($templateFields){
                    foreach(self::reviewResultFixedTemplateFields() as $fixedField){
                        if(!in_array($fixedField,$templateFields,true)){$mapComplete=false;break;}
                    }
                }
            }
            $scene['configuration_complete'] = $scene['template_id'] !== '' && (!$needsFieldMap||$mapComplete);
            $scene['available'] = $global && $scene['configuration_complete'];
            $scene['availability_reason'] = $scene['template_id'] === '' ? 'template_missing' : ($needsFieldMap && !$mapComplete ? ($key==='reviewResult'?'fixed_template_mismatch':'field_map_missing') : ($global ? 'ready' : 'global_disabled'));
        }
        unset($scene);
        return $scenes;
    }

    public static function inferSubscriptionTemplateBinding(array $scene,array $actual,array $previous=[]): array
    {
        $fields=is_array($actual['fields']??null)?array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('strval',$actual['fields'])))):[];
        $labels=is_array($actual['field_labels']??null)?$actual['field_labels']:[];
        $required=array_values(array_map('strval',(array)($scene['field_semantics']??[])));
        $known=array_keys(self::subscriptionSemanticLabels());
        // 必填语义优先匹配；模板额外字段可继续匹配系统已知业务字段。
        $allowed=array_values(array_unique(array_merge($required,$known)));
        $fieldMap=[];$defaults=[];$used=[];
        $previousMap=is_array($previous['field_map']??null)?$previous['field_map']:[];
        // 兼容旧配置后再参与自动识别，避免同步模板时把已经绑好的字段丢掉。
        if(isset($previousMap['service_name'])&&!isset($previousMap['service_category'])){$previousMap['service_category']=$previousMap['service_name'];unset($previousMap['service_name']);}
        if(isset($previousMap['remark'])){
            if((string)($scene['key']??'')==='order_audit'&&!isset($previousMap['audit_note']))$previousMap['audit_note']=$previousMap['remark'];
            elseif(!isset($previousMap['requirement_note']))$previousMap['requirement_note']=$previousMap['remark'];
            unset($previousMap['remark']);
        }
        if((string)($scene['key']??'')==='payment_success'&&isset($previousMap['merchant_name'])&&!isset($previousMap['platform_name'])){$previousMap['platform_name']=$previousMap['merchant_name'];unset($previousMap['merchant_name']);}
        $previousDefaults=is_array($previous['field_defaults']??null)?$previous['field_defaults']:[];
        foreach($previousMap as $semantic=>$field){
            $semantic=(string)$semantic;$field=trim((string)$field);
            if(in_array($semantic,$allowed,true)&&in_array($field,$fields,true)&&!isset($used[$field])){$fieldMap[$semantic]=$field;$used[$field]=true;}
        }
        foreach($previousDefaults as $field=>$value){
            $field=trim((string)$field);$value=trim((string)$value);
            if($value!==''&&in_array($field,$fields,true)&&!isset($used[$field])){$defaults[$field]=$value;$used[$field]=true;}
        }
        $aliases=[
            'order_no'=>['订单编号','订单号','服务单号','工单号','预约单号'],
            'status'=>['订单状态','审核结果','处理状态','处理结果','退款状态','维修进度','进度','待办事项','调整状态','成果状态','补测状态','维修任务'],
            'time'=>['处理时间','更新时间','提醒时间','提交时间','生成时间','报价时间','付款时间','完工时间','时间'],
            'amount'=>['支付金额','退款金额','报价金额','费用金额','金额','费用'],
            'quote_party'=>['报价方','报价人','报价师傅'],
            'platform_name'=>['平台名称','服务平台','平台'],
            'merchant_name'=>['商家名称','商户名称','门店名称','店铺名称','企业名称'],
            'worker_name'=>['师傅姓名','服务人员','接单人','工作人员'],
            'service_category'=>['服务类目','服务分类','施工类目','业务类目','类目','服务项目','服务内容'],
            'order_title'=>['订单名称','订单标题','服务名称','项目名称'],
            'service_address'=>['施工地址','服务地址','上门地址','安装地址','地址'],
            'requirement_note'=>['需求说明','订单说明','施工要求','服务要求'],
            'audit_note'=>['审核说明','审核备注','审核意见','驳回原因','备注','说明'],
            'expected_visit_time'=>['期望上门时间','期望时间','期望日期','上门时间'],
            'contact_name'=>['联系人','联系人姓名','对接人','客户姓名'],
            'appointment_time'=>['预约时间','预约日期','上门预约'],
            'appointment_note'=>['预约说明','预约备注'],
        ];
        // payment_success 的“商家/商户名称”历史上实际表达收款平台；仅该场景将二者优先解释为平台名称。
        if((string)($scene['key']??'')==='payment_success')$aliases['platform_name']=array_merge(['商家名称','商户名称'],$aliases['platform_name']);
        $normalize=static function(string $value):string{return mb_strtolower((string)(preg_replace('/[\s：:（）()\-—_\/]+/u','',$value)??$value));};
        foreach($fields as $field){
            if(isset($used[$field]))continue;
            $label=trim((string)($labels[$field]??''));$normalized=$normalize($label);
            if($normalized==='')continue;
            $best='';
            foreach($allowed as $semantic){
                if(isset($fieldMap[$semantic]))continue;
                foreach($aliases[$semantic]??[] as $alias){
                    $a=$normalize($alias);
                    if($normalized===$a||mb_strpos($normalized,$a)!==false||mb_strpos($a,$normalized)!==false){$best=$semantic;break 2;}
                }
            }
            if($best!==''){$fieldMap[$best]=$field;$used[$field]=true;continue;}

        }
        $unresolved=[];foreach($fields as $field)if(!isset($used[$field]))$unresolved[]=$field;
        $missingSemantics=[];foreach($required as $semantic)if(empty($fieldMap[$semantic]))$missingSemantics[]=$semantic;
        return ['field_map'=>$fieldMap,'field_defaults'=>$defaults,'unresolved_fields'=>$unresolved,'missing_semantics'=>$missingSemantics,'complete'=>!$unresolved&&!$missingSemantics];
    }

    public static function recommendSubscriptionKeywords(array $scene,array $keywords): array
    {
        $pseudo=['fields'=>[],'field_labels'=>[]];
        foreach($keywords as $row){
            if(!is_array($row))continue;
            $kid=(int)($row['kid']??0);if($kid<1)continue;
            $field='kid'.$kid;$pseudo['fields'][]=$field;$pseudo['field_labels'][$field]=(string)($row['name']??'');
        }
        $binding=self::inferSubscriptionTemplateBinding($scene,$pseudo,[]);
        $recommended=[];
        foreach(array_merge(array_values($binding['field_map']),array_keys($binding['field_defaults'])) as $field){
            if(strpos((string)$field,'kid')===0)$recommended[]=(int)substr((string)$field,3);
        }
        return array_values(array_unique(array_filter($recommended,static function($id){return $id>0;})));
    }

        ]);
        $wecomNormalVisible = array_flip(['order_auto_preapproved','offline_collection_adjustment_auto_approved','worker_collection_code_auto_approved']);
        $explicitWecom = array_flip(['worker_profile_submitted','worker_realname_submitted','worker_collection_code_submitted','worker_collection_code_auto_approved','merchant_auth_submitted','commission_overdue','withdrawal_submitted','worker_contact_reveal_requested','measurement_hold_extension_requested','completion_dispute_opened','repair_platform_intervention_requested','order_auto_preapproved','offline_collection_adjustment_auto_approved']);

                'wecom_visible'=>isset($explicitWecom[$key]) || in_array('admin',$recipients,true) || isset($wecomNormalVisible[$key]),
                'wecom_default'=>isset($wecomDefaults[$key]),
            ];
        }

        return $catalog += \WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\OrderProgressMessageCatalog::all();
    }

    public static function get(string $eventType): ?array
    {
        $all = self::all();
        return $all[$eventType] ?? null;
    }

    public static function switches(string $channel, array $configured): array
    {
        $all = self::all();
        $visibleKey = $channel === 'wecom' ? 'wecom_visible' : ($channel === 'inapp' ? 'inapp_visible' : 'sms_visible');
        $result = [];

        foreach ($all as $eventKey => $meta) {
            if (empty($meta[$visibleKey])) continue;
            $saved = $configured[$eventKey] ?? null;
            $enabled = $saved === null ? $channel === 'inapp' : filter_var(is_array($saved) ? ($saved['enabled'] ?? false) : $saved, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN);
            $extra = is_array($saved) ? $saved : [];
            $extra['enabled'] = $enabled;
            $extra['priority'] = (string) ($channel==='sms'?($meta['sms_priority']??'normal'):$meta['priority']);
            $result[$eventKey] = $extra;
        }
        foreach ($configured as $eventKey => $saved) {
            if (isset($result[$eventKey]) || isset($all[$eventKey])) continue;
            $extra = is_array($saved) ? $saved : [];
            $extra['enabled'] = filter_var(is_array($saved) ? ($saved['enabled'] ?? false) : $saved, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN);
            $extra['priority'] = isset($extra['priority']) && $extra['priority'] === 'normal' ? 'normal' : 'important';
            $result[(string)$eventKey] = $extra;
        }

        return $result;
    }

    public static function enabled(string $channel, string $eventType, array $configured): bool
    {
        $switches = self::switches($channel, $configured);
        return isset($switches[$eventType]) && !empty($switches[$eventType]['enabled']);
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Safety;

use RuntimeException;

/**
 * 测试环境外部副作用统一安全边界。
 * 是否处于 testing 只由 config/installed.php 的 app.env 决定；可调参数来自后台 system_settings。
 */
final class TestingEnvironmentPolicy
{
    public static function active(): bool
    {
        return strtolower(trim((string) \app_config('app.env', 'production'))) === 'testing';
    }

    public static function qiniuUploadPrefix(string $configuredPrefix): string
    {
        $configuredPrefix=trim($configuredPrefix,'/');
        if (!self::active()) return $configuredPrefix;
        $prefix = trim((string) \setting('testing.qiniu_path_prefix', 'test'), '/');
        if ($prefix === '' || preg_match('#^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$#', $prefix) !== 1 || strpos($prefix, '..') !== false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境七牛根目录配置无效。');
        }
        if($configuredPrefix!==''&&strcasecmp($prefix,$configuredPrefix)===0){
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境七牛根目录不能与正式根目录相同。');
        }
        return $prefix;
    }

    public static function assertQiniuDeleteAllowed(string $key): void
    {
        if (!self::active()) return;
        $prefix = self::qiniuUploadPrefix((string)\setting('qiniu.path_prefix','upload'));
        $normalized = ltrim(trim($key), '/');
        if ($normalized === '' || strpos($normalized, $prefix . '/') !== 0) {
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境禁止删除非测试目录的七牛对象：仅允许 ' . $prefix . '/ 下的对象。');
        }
    }

    public static function paymentEnabled(bool $configuredEnabled): bool
    {
        return self::active() ? false : $configuredEnabled;
    }

    public static function assertPaymentAllowed(string $operation, string $outTradeNo = '', string $outRefundNo = ''): void
    {
        if (self::active()) throw new RuntimeException('测试环境禁止真实微信支付、退款、查单和支付回调入账。');
    }

    public static function assertSmsRecipientAllowed(string $mobile): void
    {
        if (!self::active()) return;
        if (!self::boolSetting('testing.sms_enabled', false)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境真实短信总开关未开启。');
        }
        $mobile = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $mobile) ?? '';
        $allowed = self::stringList('testing.allowed_sms_mobiles');
        if ($mobile === '' || !in_array($mobile, $allowed, true)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境禁止向非白名单手机号发送真实短信。');
        }
    }

    public static function assertWechatRecipientAllowed(string $openid): void
    {
        if (!self::active()) return;
        if (!self::boolSetting('testing.subscribe_enabled', false)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境微信订阅消息总开关未开启。');
        }
        $openid = trim($openid);
        $allowed = self::stringList('testing.allowed_wechat_openids');
        if ($openid === '' || !in_array($openid, $allowed, true)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境禁止向非白名单 OpenID 发送真实微信订阅消息。');
        }
    }

    public static function adminAlertContent(string $content): string
    {
        if (!self::active()) return $content;
        if (!self::boolSetting('testing.allow_wecom', false)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境默认禁止企业微信机器人通知。');
        }
        return strpos($content, '【测试环境】') === 0 ? $content : "【测试环境】\n" . $content;
    }

    public static function assertWechatAccountWriteAllowed(): void
    {
        if (self::active() && !self::boolSetting('testing.allow_wechat_account_writes', false)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境默认禁止修改正式小程序的订阅模板配置。');
        }
    }

    public static function assertCloudActionAllowed(string $action): void
    {
        if (!self::active()) return;
        if (self::boolSetting('testing.allow_cloud_writes', false)) return;
        $readOnly = [
            'admin.health','admin.list','admin.detail','server.owner.get','server.nearbyMarkedWorkers',
            'server.phoneSearchIds','server.phoneReveal','server.membershipStatus','server.publicWorkerSearch',
        ];
        if (!in_array($action, $readOnly, true)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('测试环境禁止写入正式微信云开发环境：' . $action);
        }
    }

    private static function boolSetting(string $key, bool $default): bool
    {
        return filter_var(\setting($key, $default ? '1' : '0'), FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN);
    }

    private static function stringList(string $settingKey): array
    {
        $value = \setting($settingKey, '');
        if (is_string($value)) $value = preg_split('/[\s,;]+/', $value) ?: [];
        if (!is_array($value)) return [];
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($value as $item) {
            $item = trim((string) $item);
            if ($item !== '') $rows[] = $item;
        }
        return array_values(array_unique($rows));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DateTimeZone;
use Throwable;

// 2026-10-08：各类异常共用升级规则；拒绝和超时只开放申请，不自动生成平台待办。
final class NegotiationPolicy
{
    public const WAIT_HOURS = 48;

    public static function evaluate(string $status, ?string $openedAt, string $timezone = 'UTC', ?DateTimeImmutable $now = null): array
    {
        $result = ['eligible'=>false,'reason'=>'not_active','available_at'=>null,'wait_hours'=>self::WAIT_HOURS];
        if ($status === 'rejected') return array_merge($result, ['eligible'=>true,'reason'=>'counterparty_rejected']);
        if (!in_array($status, ['pending','accepted_processing'], true) || !$openedAt) return $result;
        try {
            $zone = new DateTimeZone($timezone ?: 'UTC');
            $available = (new DateTimeImmutable($openedAt, $zone))->modify('+'.self::WAIT_HOURS.' hours');
            $result['available_at'] = $available->format('Y-m-d H:i:s');
            $result['eligible'] = ($now ?: new DateTimeImmutable('now', $zone)) >= $available;
            $result['reason'] = $result['eligible'] ? 'response_timeout' : 'waiting_counterparty';
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            $result['reason'] = 'invalid_deadline';
        }
        return $result;
    }

    public static function refundStatus(string $reasonCode): string
    {
        return ['bilateral_refund_pending'=>'pending','bilateral_refund_rejected'=>'rejected',
            'bilateral_refund_escalated'=>'escalated','bilateral_refund_execution_required'=>'escalated'][$reasonCode] ?? '';
    }

    public static function disputeStatus(?string $resolution): string
    {
        return strpos((string)$resolution, '师傅拒绝异议') === 0 ? 'rejected' : 'pending';
    }
}

namespace WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order;

/** 领域事件的真实经办来源；协助字段只由已鉴权且重验指派的管理员用例构造。 */
final class FulfillmentActor
{
    public static function assisted(array $actor): bool
    {
        return (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0)>0 && (int)($actor['worker_id'] ?? 0)>0
            && (int)($actor['assistance_operator_id'] ?? 0)===(int)$actor['user_id']
            && trim((string)($actor['assistance_assignment_id'] ?? ''))!=='';
    }

    public static function type(array $actor): string { return self::assisted($actor) ? 'mini_admin' : 'worker'; }
    public static function id(array $actor): int { return (int)($actor[self::assisted($actor) ? 'user_id' : 'worker_id'] ?? 0); }

    public static function metadata(array $actor): array
    {
        return !self::assisted($actor) ? [] : [
            'assisted'=>true,'operator_channel'=>'mini_admin','operator_user_id'=>(int)$actor['user_id'],
            'worker_id'=>(int)$actor['worker_id'],'assignment_id'=>(string)$actor['assistance_assignment_id'],
            'occurred_at'=>(string)($actor['assistance_occurred_at'] ?? ''),
        ];
    }

 * 普通下单 finalize、图片上传与平台承接单发布必须使用同一字段映射。
 */
final class OrderFormMediaRules
{
    /** @return array{active:bool,min:int,max:int,label:string} */
    public static function rule(Database $db,int $schemaVersionId,string $purpose):array
    {
        $keys=['product'=>'material_images','wall'=>'wall_images'];
        if($schemaVersionId<1||!isset($keys[$purpose]))return ['active'=>false,'min'=>0,'max'=>20,'label'=>'图片'];
        $row=$db->fetch(
            "SELECT f.label,f.component_type,f.is_required,f.validation_json
             FROM form_fields f
             JOIN form_steps s ON s.id=f.step_id
             WHERE s.schema_version_id=:version AND s.status='active' AND f.status='active' AND BINARY f.field_key=BINARY :field
             LIMIT 1",
            ['version'=>$schemaVersionId,'field'=>$keys[$purpose]]
        );
        if(!$row||!in_array((string)$row['component_type'],['image','image_upload'],true)){
            return ['active'=>false,'min'=>0,'max'=>20,'label'=>$purpose==='product'?'商品/材料图片':'现场环境/墙面图片'];
        }
        $validation=[];
        if(is_string($row['validation_json']??null)&&$row['validation_json']!==''){
            $decoded=json_decode((string)$row['validation_json'],true);
            if(is_array($decoded))$validation=$decoded;
        }
        $max=max(1,min(20,(int)($validation['max_items']??20)));
        $min=min($max,max(!empty($row['is_required'])?1:0,(int)($validation['min_items']??0)));
        return ['active'=>true,'min'=>$min,'max'=>$max,'label'=>(string)($row['label']?:($purpose==='product'?'商品/材料图片':'现场环境/墙面图片'))];
    }

    /** @return array{ready:bool,reason:string,purpose:string,required:int,actual:int} */
    public static function readiness(Database $db,int $orderId,int $schemaVersionId,string $workflowProfile):array
    {
        // 与普通订单 finalize 保持一致：测量单不要求施工材料/墙面图片。
        if($workflowProfile==='measurement')return ['ready'=>true,'reason'=>'','purpose'=>'','required'=>0,'actual'=>0];
        foreach(['product','wall'] as $purpose){
            $rule=self::rule($db,$schemaVersionId,$purpose);
            if(!$rule['active'])continue;
            $count=(int)$db->fetchValue(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_links
                 WHERE entity_type='order' AND entity_id=:order_id AND purpose=:purpose",
                ['order_id'=>$orderId,'purpose'=>$purpose]
            );
            if($count<$rule['min']){
                return ['ready'=>false,'reason'=>'“'.$rule['label'].'”至少需要上传 '.$rule['min'].' 张','purpose'=>$purpose,'required'=>$rule['min'],'actual'=>$count];
            }
            if($count>$rule['max']){
                return ['ready'=>false,'reason'=>'“'.$rule['label'].'”最多允许 '.$rule['max'].' 张','purpose'=>$purpose,'required'=>$rule['max'],'actual'=>$count];
            }
        }
        return ['ready'=>true,'reason'=>'','purpose'=>'','required'=>0,'actual'=>0];
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging;

final class OrderMessageDefinition
{
    public static function definition(string $type, array $payload): ?array
    {
        $meta = MessageEventCatalog::get($type);
        // 管理员恢复类事件只需要订单进度触达，不自动扩入短信/模板配置目录。
        if (!$meta && $type === 'worker_replaced_by_admin') {
            $meta = ['status'=>'平台已改派师傅，等待新师傅确认接单','recipients'=>['user','worker'],'scene'=>'order_status'];
        }
        if (!$meta && $type === 'repair_platform_intervention_started') {
            $meta = ['status'=>'平台已主动介入维修售后','recipients'=>['user','worker'],'scene'=>'order_status'];
        }
        if (!$meta || trim((string)($meta['status'] ?? '')) === '' || empty($meta['recipients'])) return null;
        if (!empty($payload['assisted']) && in_array($type,['completion_submitted','measurement_result_submitted','platform_measurement_result_submitted','platform_measurement_auto_confirmed','repair_worker_completed'],true)) {
            $meta['status']=$type==='completion_submitted' ? '管理员已补录完工，等待客户验收'
                : ($type==='repair_worker_completed' ? '管理员已补录维修处理结果' : '管理员已补录测量成果');
            $meta['recipients']=['user','worker'];
        }
        if (!empty($payload['assisted']) && in_array($type, ['appointment_recorded','appointment_waiting_customer_notice','repair_appointment_recorded','repair_waiting_customer_notice'], true)) {
            $meta['status'] = !empty($payload['wait_customer_notice']) ? '管理员补录联系结果：等待客户另行通知' : '管理员已补录预约';
            $meta['recipients'] = ['user','worker'];
        }
        $amount = null;
        foreach (['amount_cents','requested_tail_cents','new_amount_cents','added_amount_cents','total_amount_cents','refund_amount_cents'] as $amountKey) {
            if (isset($payload[$amountKey]) && is_numeric($payload[$amountKey])) { $amount = (int)$payload[$amountKey]; break; }
        }
        $recipients = (array)$meta['recipients'];
        if (isset($payload['notify_recipients']) && is_array($payload['notify_recipients'])) {
            $requested = array_values(array_unique(array_map('strval', $payload['notify_recipients'])));
            $recipients = array_values(array_intersect($recipients, $requested));
        }
        return [
            'scene'=>(string)($meta['scene'] ?? 'order_status'),
            'status'=>(string)$meta['status'],
            'recipients'=>$recipients,
            'amount_cents'=>$amount,
        ];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order;

/**
 * V2.5.0 平台承接单纯金额规则。
 *
 * 不访问数据库、不读取配置、不处理 HTTP，供当前平台履约适配器以及后续统一
 * OrderFulfillment Application 复用，避免 worker_collect / platform_balance 的
 * 金额算法在多个入口各写一份。
 */
final class PlatformOrderSettlementPolicy
{
    public const MODE_WORKER_COLLECT = 'worker_collect';
    public const MODE_PLATFORM_BALANCE = 'platform_balance';

    /**
     * 兼容现有 extra_income_rate_bp_snapshot 单字段的规则编码。
     * 0..10000 表示万分比；大于等于该偏移量表示“固定金额”，偏移后的值单位为分。
     * 这样 V2.5.0 尚未正式运营时无需再拆一套加项结算表，且所有资金算法仍集中在领域层。
     */
    public const EXTRA_INCOME_FIXED_OFFSET = 1000000000;

    /**
     * @return array{booking_paid_cents:int,customer_tail_cents:int,platform_receivable_cents:int,worker_balance_credit_cents:int}
     */
    public function settlement(int $customerTotal, int $workerLabor, int $bookingPaid, string $mode): array
    {
        if ($customerTotal <= 0 || $workerLabor <= 0) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('客户金额或师傅工费尚未确认', 'PLATFORM_SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT_REQUIRED', 409);
        }
        $this->assertMode($mode);

        $bookingPaid = min($customerTotal, max(0, $bookingPaid));
        $customerTail = max(0, $customerTotal - $bookingPaid);
        $platformReceivable = $mode === self::MODE_PLATFORM_BALANCE
            ? $customerTail
            : $customerTotal - $workerLabor - $bookingPaid;
        if ($platformReceivable < 0) {
            throw new OrderOperationException(
                '本单会形成负差额，请先与客户加收或处理加价后再验收',
                'PLATFORM_SETTLEMENT_NEGATIVE',
                409
            );
        }

        return [
            'booking_paid_cents' => $bookingPaid,
            'customer_tail_cents' => $customerTail,
            'platform_receivable_cents' => $platformReceivable,
            'worker_balance_credit_cents' => $mode === self::MODE_PLATFORM_BALANCE ? $workerLabor : 0,
        ];
    }

    /** @return array{platform_share_cents:int,worker_share_cents:int} */
    public function splitExtraIncome(int $addedAmount, int $platformRuleValue): array
    {
        if ($addedAmount <= 0) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('请输入正确的加价金额', 'PLATFORM_CHANGE_AMOUNT_INVALID', 422);
        }

        if ($platformRuleValue >= self::EXTRA_INCOME_FIXED_OFFSET) {
            $fixed = max(0, $platformRuleValue - self::EXTRA_INCOME_FIXED_OFFSET);
            if ($fixed > $addedAmount) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('本次加项金额低于本单设置的固定平台收入，请先调整加项金额或平台收入规则', 'PLATFORM_CHANGE_BELOW_FIXED_INCOME', 422);
            }
            return [
                'platform_share_cents' => $fixed,
                'worker_share_cents' => $addedAmount - $fixed,
            ];
        }

        $rate = max(0, min(10000, $platformRuleValue));
        $platformShare = (int) round($addedAmount * $rate / 10000);
        return [
            'platform_share_cents' => $platformShare,
            'worker_share_cents' => max(0, $addedAmount - $platformShare),
        ];
    }

    /** @return array{available_delta_cents:int,frozen_delta_cents:int,entry_type:string} */
    public function workerBalanceEntry(int $workerBalanceCredit, int $freezeDays): array
    {
        $credit = max(0, $workerBalanceCredit);
        $days = max(0, $freezeDays);
        return [
            'available_delta_cents' => $days === 0 ? $credit : 0,
            'frozen_delta_cents' => $days > 0 ? $credit : 0,
            'entry_type' => $days === 0 ? 'platform_order_income' : 'platform_order_income_frozen',
        ];
    }

    private function assertMode(string $mode): void
    {
        if (!in_array($mode, [self::MODE_WORKER_COLLECT, self::MODE_PLATFORM_BALANCE], true)) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('平台承接单工费结算方式无效', 'PLATFORM_SETTLEMENT_MODE_INVALID', 409);
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging;



final class WechatTemplateValue
{

    public static function format(string $wechatKey,string $value):?string
    {
        $value=trim((string)(preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]+/u',' ',$value)??$value));
        if($value==='')return null;
        $prefix=strtolower((string)(preg_replace('/\d+$/','',$wechatKey)??''));
        if($prefix==='thing')return mb_substr($value,0,20);
        if($prefix==='name')return mb_substr($value,0,32);
        if($prefix==='phrase')return mb_substr($value,0,16);
        if($prefix==='character_string'){
            $ascii=(string)(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9_+\-\.\/]/','',$value)??'');
            return $ascii===''?null:substr($ascii,0,64);
        }
        if($prefix==='number'){
            $number=(string)(preg_replace('/[^0-9.\-]/','',$value)??'');
            return $number===''?null:substr($number,0,32);
        }
        if($prefix==='letter'){
            $letters=(string)(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z]/','',$value)??'');
            return $letters===''?null:substr($letters,0,32);
        }
        if($prefix==='symbol'){
            $symbols=(string)(preg_replace('/[A-Za-z0-9\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}\s]/u','',$value)??'');
            return $symbols===''?null:mb_substr($symbols,0,5);
        }
        if($prefix==='phone_number'){
            $phone=(string)(preg_replace('/[^0-9+\-]/','',$value)??'');
            return $phone===''?null:substr($phone,0,17);
        }
        if($prefix==='car_number')return mb_substr($value,0,12);
        if($prefix==='amount'){
            $number=(string)(preg_replace('/[^0-9.]/','',$value)??'');
            if($number===''||!preg_match('/^\d{1,8}(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/',$number))return null;
            return '¥'.$number;
        }
        if($prefix==='time'){
            if(preg_match('/(?:^|\s)([0-2]\d:[0-5]\d)(?::[0-5]\d)?$/',$value,$match)===1)return (string)$match[1];
            return preg_match('/^([0-2]\d:[0-5]\d)(?::[0-5]\d)?$/',$value,$match)===1?(string)$match[1]:null;
        }
        if($prefix==='date'){
            if(preg_match('/(\d{4}-[01]\d-[0-3]\d)/',$value,$match)===1)return (string)$match[1];
            return null;
        }
        return mb_substr($value,0,20);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\OrderDisputeRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\NegotiationPolicy;
use WorkerAdmin\Services\OrderNotificationService;

final class DatabaseOrderDisputeRepository implements OrderDisputeRepository
{
    private Database $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    public function startNegotiation(array $actor, string $orderNo, string $description, array $evidenceIds): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$orderNo,$description,$evidenceIds): array {
            $order = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE', ['public_no'=>$orderNo]);
            if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在', 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            if ((int)$order['user_id'] !== (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('只能为自己的订单提交异议', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
            }
            if ((string)$order['fulfillment_status'] !== 'submitted' || (string)$order['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active') {
                throw new OrderOperationException('只有待确认的服务结果可以提交异议', 'DISPUTE_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
            }
            if (!in_array((string)($order['dispute_status'] ?? 'none'), ['','none','resolved'], true)
                || $db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM disputes WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('negotiating','open','pending','processing') LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE", ['id'=>$order['id']])) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('本单已有异议正在处理中', 'DISPUTE_ALREADY_ACTIVE', 409);
            }

            $params = ['order_id'=>$order['id']];
            $marks = [];
            foreach (array_values($evidenceIds) as $index=>$publicId) {
                $key = 'media_'.$index;
                $marks[] = ':'.$key;
                $params[$key] = $publicId;
            }
            $mediaRows = $db->fetchAll(
                "SELECT m.id,m.public_id FROM media_files m
                 JOIN media_links l ON l.media_file_id=m.id AND l.entity_type='order' AND l.entity_id=:order_id AND l.purpose='dispute_evidence'
                 WHERE m.public_id IN (".implode(',', $marks).") AND m.status='active'
                 GROUP BY m.id,m.public_id",
                $params
            );
            if (count($mediaRows) !== count($evidenceIds)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('异议证据图片无效，请重新上传后提交', 'DISPUTE_EVIDENCE_INVALID', 422);
            }

            $measurement = (string)($order['workflow_profile'] ?? 'construction') === 'measurement';
            $disputeNo = 'DSP'.gmdate('ymdHis').strtoupper(bin2hex(random_bytes(4)));
            $disputeId = $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO disputes(public_no,order_id,raised_by_type,raised_by_id,dispute_type,title,description,status,responsibility,refund_amount_cents,run_empty_fee_cents,opened_at,created_at,updated_at)
                 VALUES(:public_no,:order_id,'user',:user_id,:dispute_type,:title,:description,'negotiating','undetermined',0,0,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                [
                    'public_no'=>$disputeNo,'order_id'=>$order['id'],'user_id'=>$actor['user_id'],
                    'dispute_type'=>$measurement ? 'measurement_result' : 'completion_quality',
                    'title'=>$measurement ? '测量成果异议协商中' : '完工异议协商中',
                    'description'=>$description,
                ]
            );
            foreach ($mediaRows as $row) {
                $db->insert(
                    "INSERT INTO dispute_evidence(dispute_id,submitted_by_type,submitted_by_id,evidence_type,description,media_file_id,occurred_at,created_at)
                     VALUES(:dispute_id,'user',:user_id,'photo',NULL,:media_id,NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                    ['dispute_id'=>$disputeId,'user_id'=>$actor['user_id'],'media_id'=>$row['id']]
                );
            }
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET dispute_status='negotiating',publish_status='hidden',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id",
                ['id'=>$order['id']]
            );
            $eventKey = $this->event($db, (int)$order['id'], 'dispute_negotiation_started', 'user', (int)$actor['user_id'], [
                'dispute_no'=>$disputeNo,
                'evidence_count'=>count($mediaRows),
                'message'=>$measurement
                    ? '用户提出测量成果异议，自动确认已暂停，请双方先自行沟通处理'
                    : '用户提出完工异议，自动验收已暂停，请双方先自行沟通处理',
            ], false);
            $this->notifyWorkerNegotiation($db, $order, $eventKey, $measurement);
            return ['id'=>$disputeNo,'status'=>'negotiating','admin_escalated'=>false];
        });
    }

    public function escalate(array $actor, string $disputeNo, string $note): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$disputeNo,$note): array {
            $seed = $db->fetch('SELECT order_id FROM disputes WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :no', ['no'=>$disputeNo]);
            if (!$seed) throw new OrderOperationException('异议记录不存在', 'DISPUTE_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            $db->fetch('SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$seed['order_id']]);
            $row = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT d.*,o.public_no order_no,o.user_id,o.id order_id,o.workflow_profile
                 FROM disputes d JOIN orders o ON o.id=d.order_id
                 WHERE BINARY d.public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE",
                ['public_no'=>$disputeNo]
            );
            if (!$row) throw new OrderOperationException('异议记录不存在', 'DISPUTE_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            if ((int)$row['user_id'] !== (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('只能处理自己的订单异议', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
            }
            if ((string)$row['status'] !== 'negotiating') {
                throw new OrderOperationException('该异议当前不能重复申请平台介入', 'DISPUTE_ESCALATE_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
            }
            // 2026-10-08：直接 API 与页面使用同一升级条件，不能提交后立即绕过协商。
            $eligibility = NegotiationPolicy::evaluate(NegotiationPolicy::disputeStatus($row['resolution'] ?? null), $row['opened_at'] ?? null);
            if (empty($eligibility['eligible'])) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('请先协商；师傅拒绝或满48小时未解决后才可申请平台介入', 'NEGOTIATION_WAIT_REQUIRED', 409, $eligibility);
            }
            if ($note !== '') {
                $db->insert(
                    "INSERT INTO dispute_evidence(dispute_id,submitted_by_type,submitted_by_id,evidence_type,description,media_file_id,occurred_at,created_at)
                     VALUES(:dispute_id,'user',:user_id,'note',:description,NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                    ['dispute_id'=>$row['id'],'user_id'=>$actor['user_id'],'description'=>$note]
                );
            }
            $measurement = (string)($row['workflow_profile'] ?? 'construction') === 'measurement';
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE disputes SET status='open',title=:title,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id AND status='negotiating'",
                ['title'=>$measurement ? '用户申请平台介入测量成果争议' : '用户申请平台介入完工争议','id'=>$row['id']]
            );
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET dispute_status='open',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id",
                ['id'=>$row['order_id']]
            );
            // 平台待办只通过 queueAdminTask 产生一次；订单事件仅通知双方，避免管理员收到两条重复提醒。
            $eventKey = $this->event($db, (int)$row['order_id'], 'dispute_opened', 'user', (int)$actor['user_id'], [
                'dispute_no'=>$row['public_no'],
                'dispute_type'=>$row['dispute_type'],
                'message'=>'双方自行协商未解决，用户已申请平台介入',
                'reason'=>$note,
                'notify_recipients'=>['user','worker'],
            ], true);
            OrderNotificationService::queueAdminTask(
                $db,
                'dispute:'.$row['id'],
                'completion_dispute_opened',
                $measurement ? '用户申请平台介入测量成果争议' : '用户申请平台介入完工争议',
                [
                    '订单号'=>(string)$row['order_no'],
                    '争议说明'=>(string)$row['description'],
                    '补充说明'=>$note,
                ]
            );
            return ['id'=>(string)$row['public_no'],'status'=>'open','admin_escalated'=>true,'event_key'=>$eventKey];
        });
    }

    public function resolveByAgreement(array $actor, string $disputeNo, string $note): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$disputeNo,$note): array {
            $seed = $db->fetch('SELECT order_id FROM disputes WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :no', ['no'=>$disputeNo]);
            if (!$seed) throw new OrderOperationException('异议记录不存在', 'DISPUTE_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            $db->fetch('SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$seed['order_id']]);
            $row = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT d.*,o.user_id,o.id order_id FROM disputes d JOIN orders o ON o.id=d.order_id
                 WHERE BINARY d.public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE",
                ['public_no'=>$disputeNo]
            );
            if (!$row) throw new OrderOperationException('异议记录不存在', 'DISPUTE_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            if ((int)$row['user_id'] !== (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('只能处理自己的订单异议', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
            }
            if ((string)$row['status'] !== 'negotiating') {
                throw new OrderOperationException('平台已经介入或异议已经结束，不能自行关闭', 'DISPUTE_SELF_RESOLVE_NOT_ALLOWED', 409);
            }
            $resolution = '双方自行协商解决'.($note !== '' ? '：'.$note : '');
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE disputes SET status='resolved',responsibility='mutual',resolution=:resolution,resolved_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id AND status='negotiating'",
                ['resolution'=>$resolution,'id'=>$row['id']]
            );
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET dispute_status='resolved',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id",
                ['id'=>$row['order_id']]
            );
            $this->event($db, (int)$row['order_id'], 'dispute_resolved', 'user', (int)$actor['user_id'], [
                'dispute_no'=>$row['public_no'],
                'resolution'=>$resolution,
                'self_resolved'=>1,
                'notify_recipients'=>['worker'],
            ], true);
            return ['id'=>(string)$row['public_no'],'status'=>'resolved','admin_escalated'=>false];
        });
    }

    public function resolveByAdmin(
        array $operator,
        string $orderNo,
        string $resolution,
        string $responsibility,
        int $refundCents = 0,
        int $runEmptyCents = 0
    ): array {
        $operation = function () use ($operator, $orderNo, $resolution, $responsibility, $refundCents, $runEmptyCents): array {
            return $this->resolveByAdminUnderWriteGuard($operator, $orderNo, $resolution, $responsibility, $refundCents, $runEmptyCents);
        };
        if (($operator['channel'] ?? '') === 'web_admin') {
            return (new DatabaseDemoOrderWriteGuard($this->db))->run($orderNo, $operation);
        }
        return $operation();
    }

    private function resolveByAdminUnderWriteGuard(
        array $operator,
        string $orderNo,
        string $resolution,
        string $responsibility,
        int $refundCents = 0,
        int $runEmptyCents = 0
    ): array {
        $channel = (string)($operator['channel'] ?? '');
        if ($channel === 'mini_admin') {
            $operatorId = max(0, (int)($operator['user_id'] ?? 0));
            $handledBy = null;
        } elseif ($channel === 'web_admin') {
            $operatorId = max(0, (int)($operator['admin_user_id'] ?? 0));
            $handledBy = $operatorId;
        } else {
            throw new OrderOperationException('管理员操作来源无效', 'ADMIN_REQUIRED', 403);
        }
        if ($operatorId < 1) throw new OrderOperationException('管理员身份无效', 'ADMIN_REQUIRED', 403);
        $refundCents = max(0, $refundCents);
        $runEmptyCents = max(0, $runEmptyCents);
        if ($channel === 'mini_admin' && ($refundCents > 0 || $runEmptyCents > 0)) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('涉及退款或跑空费金额，请到网页后台处理', 'DISPUTE_ADMIN_FINANCIAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED', 409);
        }

        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use (
            $orderNo,$resolution,$responsibility,$refundCents,$runEmptyCents,$channel,$operatorId,$handledBy
        ): array {
            $order = $db->fetch(
                'SELECT * FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE',
                ['public_no'=>$orderNo]
            );
            if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在', 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);

            $dispute = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT * FROM disputes
                 WHERE order_id=:order_id AND status IN ('open','processing')
                 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['order_id'=>$order['id']]
            );
            if (!$dispute) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('当前没有待处理争议', 'DISPUTE_ADMIN_NOT_FOUND', 409);
            }
            if ($channel === 'mini_admin' && ((int)($dispute['refund_amount_cents'] ?? 0) > 0 || (int)($dispute['run_empty_fee_cents'] ?? 0) > 0)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException(
                    '该争议涉及退款或跑空费金额，请到网页后台处理',
                    'DISPUTE_ADMIN_FINANCIAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED',
                    409
                );
            }

            $financial = $refundCents > 0 || $runEmptyCents > 0;
            $effectiveRefundCents = 0;
            $autoRefundCents = 0;
            $allocations = [
                'refund_cents'=>0,
                'outstanding_refund_cents'=>0,
                'succeeded_refund_cents'=>0,
                'runner_cents'=>0,
            ];
            $payment = null;
            $availableBookingFee = 0;

            if ($financial) {
                if ($channel !== 'web_admin' || $handledBy === null) {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('资金争议只能由网页后台裁定', 'DISPUTE_ADMIN_FINANCIAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED', 409);
                }
                if ($this->isTerminalLifecycle((string)($order['lifecycle_status'] ?? ''))) {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('已结束订单不能再次分配预约费，请核对已有退款和结算记录', 'DISPUTE_FINANCE_ORDER_CLOSED', 409);
                }
                $payment = $db->fetch(
                    "SELECT id,amount_cents FROM payment_orders
                     WHERE order_id=:order_id AND business_type IN ('order_booking','booking_fee') AND status='paid'
                     ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                    ['order_id'=>$order['id']]
                );
                $availableBookingFee = $payment
                    ? ((int)($order['booking_fee_cents'] ?? 0) > 0
                        ? min((int)$payment['amount_cents'], (int)$order['booking_fee_cents'])
                        : (int)$payment['amount_cents'])
                    : 0;
                if ($refundCents + $runEmptyCents > $availableBookingFee) {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('退款与跑空费合计不能超过本单实际支付的预约费', 'DISPUTE_FINANCE_EXCEEDS_BOOKING', 409);
                }
                $allocations = $payment
                    ? $this->bookingFeeAllocations($db, (int)$payment['id'], (int)$order['id'])
                    : $allocations;
                if ($allocations['refund_cents'] + $allocations['runner_cents'] + $refundCents + $runEmptyCents > $availableBookingFee) {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('该支付单已有退款或费用分配，剩余预约费不足', 'DISPUTE_FINANCE_ALREADY_ALLOCATED', 409);
                }

                // 资金裁定会终止本次履约；未判给师傅且尚未被占用的预约费必须全部回到退款，避免余额悬空。
                $allocatedAfterDecision = $allocations['refund_cents'] + $allocations['runner_cents'] + $refundCents + $runEmptyCents;
                $autoRefundCents = max(0, $availableBookingFee - $allocatedAfterDecision);
                $effectiveRefundCents = $refundCents + $autoRefundCents;

                if ($effectiveRefundCents > 0) {
                    $db->insert(
                        "INSERT INTO refunds(public_no,payment_order_id,order_id,cancel_request_id,amount_cents,reason,status,requested_by_admin_id,requested_at,created_at,updated_at)
                         VALUES(:public_no,:payment_id,:order_id,NULL,:amount,:reason,'pending_review',:admin_id,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                        [
                            'public_no'=>\business_no('RF'),
                            'payment_id'=>$payment['id'],
                            'order_id'=>$order['id'],
                            'amount'=>$effectiveRefundCents,
                            'reason'=>mb_substr('争议裁定：'.$resolution, 0, 1000),
                            'admin_id'=>$handledBy,
                        ]
                    );
                }

                if ($runEmptyCents > 0) {
                    $workerId = !empty($order['assigned_worker_id'])
                        ? (int)$order['assigned_worker_id']
                        : (int)$db->fetchValue(
                            "SELECT worker_id FROM assignments
                             WHERE order_id=:order_id
                             ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'accepted' THEN 1 WHEN 'completed' THEN 2 WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 3 WHEN 'offered' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,id DESC
                             LIMIT 1",
                            ['order_id'=>$order['id']]
                        );
                    if ($workerId < 1) {
                        throw new OrderOperationException('订单没有可收取跑空费的师傅，请先核对指派记录', 'DISPUTE_RUN_EMPTY_WORKER_MISSING', 409);
                    }
                    $db->execute(
                        "INSERT INTO worker_balance_ledger(
                            worker_id,entry_type,direction,amount_cents,available_delta_cents,frozen_delta_cents,
                            business_type,business_id,idempotency_key,description,status,created_by_admin_id,created_at
                         ) VALUES(
                            :worker_id,'run_empty_fee','credit',:amount,:available_delta,0,
                            'dispute',:dispute_id,:idempotency_key,:description,'effective',:admin_id,UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                         )",
                        [
                            'worker_id'=>$workerId,
                            'amount'=>$runEmptyCents,
                            'available_delta'=>$runEmptyCents,
                            'dispute_id'=>$dispute['id'],
                            'idempotency_key'=>'dispute:'.$dispute['id'].':run_empty_fee',
                            'description'=>mb_substr('争议裁定跑空费：'.$resolution, 0, 1000),
                            'admin_id'=>$handledBy,
                        ]
                    );
                }
            }

            $changed = $db->execute(
                "UPDATE disputes
                 SET status='resolved',resolution=:resolution,responsibility=:responsibility,
                     refund_amount_cents=:refund,run_empty_fee_cents=:runner,handled_by=:handled_by,
                     resolved_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE id=:id AND status IN ('open','processing')",
                [
                    'resolution'=>$resolution,
                    'responsibility'=>$responsibility,
                    'refund'=>$effectiveRefundCents,
                    'runner'=>$runEmptyCents,
                    'handled_by'=>$handledBy,
                    'id'=>$dispute['id'],
                ]
            );
            if ($changed !== 1) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('争议状态已变化，请刷新后重试', 'DISPUTE_ADMIN_CHANGED', 409);
            }

            if ($financial) {
                // 取消风控必须在报价/指派失效前捕获原事实，并与争议裁定同一事务提交。
                (new DatabaseOrderCancellationRiskRepository($db))->captureCancellation($order, $responsibility, $runEmptyCents);
                $hasOutstandingRefund = $allocations['outstanding_refund_cents'] + $effectiveRefundCents > 0;
                $lifecycle = $hasOutstandingRefund ? 'cancel_approved_pending_refund' : 'cancelled';
                $db->execute(
                    "UPDATE orders
                     SET dispute_status='resolved',lifecycle_status=:lifecycle,publish_status='hidden',quote_status='cancelled',
                         assignment_status='cancelled',fulfillment_status='cancelled',
                         refund_status=IF(:has_refund=1,'pending_review',refund_status),
                         cancelled_at=COALESCE(cancelled_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),
                         closed_at=IF(:close_now=1,COALESCE(closed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),closed_at),
                         updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1
                     WHERE id=:id",
                    [
                        'lifecycle'=>$lifecycle,
                        'has_refund'=>$hasOutstandingRefund ? 1 : 0,
                        'close_now'=>$hasOutstandingRefund ? 0 : 1,
                        'id'=>$order['id'],
                    ]
                );
                $db->execute("UPDATE quotes SET status='cancelled',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('active','selected')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $db->execute("UPDATE assignments SET status='cancelled',cancelled_at=COALESCE(cancelled_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('offered','accepted')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $db->execute("UPDATE invite_tokens SET status='revoked' WHERE order_id=:id AND status='active'", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $db->execute("UPDATE order_role_grants SET status='revoked',revoked_at=COALESCE(revoked_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()) WHERE order_id=:id AND status='active'", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $db->execute("UPDATE order_deadlines SET status='cancelled',processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('pending','blocked','claimed')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            } else {
                $db->execute(
                    "UPDATE orders SET dispute_status='resolved',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id",
                    ['id'=>$order['id']]
                );
            }

            $payload = [
                'dispute_no'=>(string)$dispute['public_no'],
                'message'=>'平台争议处理完成：'.$resolution,
                'resolution'=>$resolution,
                'responsibility'=>$responsibility,
                'refund_cents'=>$effectiveRefundCents,
                'run_empty_fee_cents'=>$runEmptyCents,
                'auto_refund_cents'=>$autoRefundCents,
                'operator_channel'=>$channel,
                'notify_recipients'=>['user','worker'],
            ];
            if ($channel === 'mini_admin') $payload['operator_user_id'] = $operatorId;
            else $payload['operator_admin_id'] = $operatorId;
            $eventKey = $this->event($db, (int)$order['id'], 'dispute_resolved', $channel, $operatorId, $payload, true);

            return [
                'id'=>(string)$dispute['public_no'],
                'status'=>'resolved',
                'order_id'=>(int)$order['id'],
                'refund_cents'=>$effectiveRefundCents,
                'run_empty_fee_cents'=>$runEmptyCents,
                'auto_refund_cents'=>$autoRefundCents,
                'event_key'=>$eventKey,
            ];
        });
    }

    /** @return array{refund_cents:int,outstanding_refund_cents:int,succeeded_refund_cents:int,runner_cents:int} */
    private function bookingFeeAllocations(Database $db, int $paymentId, int $orderId): array
    {
        $refundRows = $db->fetchAll(
            "SELECT id,amount_cents,status FROM refunds
             WHERE payment_order_id=:payment_id
               AND status NOT IN ('failed','closed','cancelled','rejected')
             FOR UPDATE",
            ['payment_id'=>$paymentId]
        );
        $refundCents = 0;
        $outstandingRefundCents = 0;
        $succeededRefundCents = 0;
        foreach ($refundRows as $row) {
            $amount = max(0, (int)$row['amount_cents']);
            $refundCents += $amount;
            if ((string)$row['status'] === 'succeeded') $succeededRefundCents += $amount;
            else $outstandingRefundCents += $amount;
        }

        $runnerCents = 0;
        $paymentBusiness = (string)$db->fetchValue('SELECT business_type FROM payment_orders WHERE id=:id', ['id'=>$paymentId]);
        if ($orderId > 0 && in_array($paymentBusiness, ['order_booking','booking_fee'], true)) {
            $runnerRows = $db->fetchAll(
                "SELECT l.id,l.amount_cents
                 FROM worker_balance_ledger l
                 INNER JOIN disputes d ON d.id=l.business_id
                 WHERE l.business_type='dispute'
                   AND l.entry_type='run_empty_fee'
                   AND l.status='effective'
                   AND d.order_id=:order_id
                 FOR UPDATE",
                ['order_id'=>$orderId]
            );
            foreach ($runnerRows as $row) $runnerCents += max(0, (int)$row['amount_cents']);
        }
        return [
            'refund_cents'=>$refundCents,
            'outstanding_refund_cents'=>$outstandingRefundCents,
            'succeeded_refund_cents'=>$succeededRefundCents,
            'runner_cents'=>$runnerCents,
        ];
    }

    private function isTerminalLifecycle(string $status): bool
    {
        return strpos($status, 'cancel') === 0 || in_array($status, ['completed','closed','expired'], true);
    }

    private function notifyWorkerNegotiation(Database $db, array $order, string $eventKey, bool $measurement): void
    {
        $workerId = (int)($order['assigned_worker_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($workerId < 1) return;
        $data = json_encode(['order_id'=>(int)$order['id'],'event_key'=>$eventKey], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        if ($db->fetchValue(
            "SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE recipient_type='worker' AND recipient_id=:worker_id AND channel='in_app' AND template_key='dispute_negotiation_started' AND BINARY data_json=BINARY :data LIMIT 1",
            ['worker_id'=>$workerId,'data'=>$data]
        )) return;
        $db->insert(
            "INSERT INTO notifications(public_id,recipient_type,recipient_id,channel,template_key,title,content,data_json,status,scheduled_at,created_at)
             VALUES(:public_id,'worker',:worker_id,'in_app','dispute_negotiation_started',:title,:content,:data,'pending',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
            [
                'public_id'=>\public_id(),
                'worker_id'=>$workerId,
                'title'=>$measurement ? '用户提出测量成果异议' : '用户提出完工异议',
                'content'=>'订单 '.(string)$order['public_no'].'：用户对'.($measurement ? '测量成果' : '完工结果').'有异议，请先主动联系协商处理；协商不成时用户可再申请平台介入。',
                'data'=>$data,
            ]
        );
    }

    private function event(Database $db, int $orderId, string $type, string $actorType, int $actorId, array $payload, bool $notify): string
    {
        if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
            (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true))->schedule($orderId);
        }
        $eventKey = $type.':'.$orderId.':'.bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        $db->insert(
            'INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(:order_id,:type,:event_key,:actor_type,:actor_id,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())',
            [
                'order_id'=>$orderId,'type'=>$type,'event_key'=>$eventKey,'actor_type'=>$actorType,'actor_id'=>$actorId,
                'payload'=>json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES),
            ]
        );
        if ($notify) OrderNotificationService::queue($db, $orderId, $eventKey, $type, $payload);
        return $eventKey;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Contracts;

interface OrderNegotiationRepository
{
    public function respond(array $actor, string $orderNo, string $kind, string $reference, string $decision, string $note): array;
    public function escalate(array $actor, string $orderNo, string $kind, string $reference, string $note): array;
