<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\OrderRepairInterventionRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\RepairInterventionPolicy;
use WorkerAdmin\Services\OrderNotificationService;

final class DatabaseOrderRepairInterventionRepository implements OrderRepairInterventionRepository
{
    private Database $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    public function request(array $actor, string $orderNo, string $afterSaleNo, string $note): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$orderNo,$afterSaleNo,$note): array {
            $order = $db->fetch(
                'SELECT id,public_no,user_id,version FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE',
                ['public_no'=>$orderNo]
            );
            if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在', 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            if ((int)$order['user_id'] !== (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('只能为自己的维修申请平台介入', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
            }

            $repair = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT id,public_no,status,resolution,opened_at
                 FROM after_sales
                 WHERE order_id=:order_id AND BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no AND type='warranty_repair'
                 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['order_id'=>$order['id'],'public_no'=>$afterSaleNo]
            );
            if (!$repair || !in_array((string)$repair['status'], ['open','processing'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('维修申请不存在或已结束', 'REPAIR_NOT_ACTIVE', 409);
            }

            $eligibility = RepairInterventionPolicy::evaluate(
                (string)$repair['status'],
                $repair['resolution'] === null ? null : (string)$repair['resolution'],
                $repair['opened_at'] === null ? null : (string)$repair['opened_at'],
                'UTC'
            );
            if (!$eligibility['eligible']) {
                if ((string)$eligibility['reason'] === 'already_escalated') {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('已经申请平台介入，请勿重复提交', 'REPAIR_INTERVENTION_ALREADY_REQUESTED', 409);
                }
                $availableAt = (string)($eligibility['available_at'] ?? '');
                throw new OrderOperationException(
                    $availableAt !== ''
                        ? '请先与师傅沟通处理；师傅未明确拒绝时，维修申请满 48 小时后（'.$availableAt.'）才可申请平台介入'
                        : '请先与师傅沟通处理；师傅明确拒绝或维修申请满 48 小时后才可申请平台介入',
                    'REPAIR_INTERVENTION_WAIT_REQUIRED',
                    409,
                    ['available_at'=>$availableAt,'wait_hours'=>RepairInterventionPolicy::WAIT_HOURS]
                );
            }

            $resolution = '用户申请平台介入'.($note !== '' ? '：'.$note : '');
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE after_sales SET status='processing',resolution=:resolution,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id",
                ['resolution'=>$resolution,'id'=>$repair['id']]
            );
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id",
                ['id'=>$order['id']]
            );

            $eventKey = 'repair_platform_intervention_requested:'.$order['id'].':'.bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
            $payload = [
                'after_sale_id'=>(string)$repair['public_no'],
                'message'=>'用户申请平台介入维修',
                'note'=>$note,
                'notify_recipients'=>['worker'],
            ];
            $db->insert(
                'INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(:order_id,:type,:event_key,\'user\',:actor_id,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())',
                [
                    'order_id'=>$order['id'],'type'=>'repair_platform_intervention_requested','event_key'=>$eventKey,
                    'actor_id'=>$actor['user_id'],'payload'=>json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES),
                ]
            );
            OrderNotificationService::queue($db, (int)$order['id'], $eventKey, 'repair_platform_intervention_requested', $payload);
            OrderNotificationService::queueAdminTask(
                $db,
                'after-sales:'.$repair['public_no'].':user-escalated',
                'repair_platform_intervention_requested',
                '用户申请平台介入维修',
                ['订单号'=>(string)$order['public_no'],'售后编号'=>(string)$repair['public_no'],'用户说明'=>$note]
            );

            return [
                'after_sale_id'=>(string)$repair['public_no'],
                'status'=>'processing',
                'intervention_reason'=>(string)$eligibility['reason'],
            ];
        });
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\OrderCancellationRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
use WorkerAdmin\Services\OrderNotificationService;

final class DatabaseOrderCancellationRepository implements OrderCancellationRepository
{
    private Database $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    public function request(array $actor, string $orderNo, string $reason, string $reasonCode): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$orderNo,$reason,$reasonCode): array {
            $order = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE', ['public_no'=>$orderNo]);
            if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在', 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            if ((int)$order['user_id'] !== (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('只能取消自己的订单', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
            }
            if ((string)$order['payment_status'] !== 'paid') {
                throw new OrderOperationException('预约费尚未支付，不存在可退款款项；如不需要该订单可直接保留未付款状态', 'REFUND_NOT_AVAILABLE_BEFORE_PAYMENT', 409);
            }
            if ((string)$order['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active' || in_array((string)$order['fulfillment_status'], ['submitted','accepted'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('该订单当前不能申请退款并取消订单', 'ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE', 409);
            }
            if ($db->fetchValue(
                "SELECT id FROM order_cancel_requests WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('pending','processing','approved') AND closed_at IS NULL LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['id'=>$order['id']]
            )) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('已经存在待处理的取消申请', 'CANCEL_REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN', 409);
            }

            $payments = $this->refundablePayments($db, $order);
            $refundAmount = array_sum(array_map(static function (array $row): int { return (int)$row['available_cents']; }, $payments));
            $auto = $refundAmount > 0 && $this->canAutoApproveBeforeService($db, $order);
            $requestPublicId = \public_id();

            if (!$auto) {
                $db->insert(
                    "INSERT INTO order_cancel_requests(public_id,order_id,applicant_type,applicant_id,request_type,order_state_snapshot_json,reason_code,reason,status,requested_refund_cents,requested_at,created_at,updated_at)
                     VALUES(:public_id,:order_id,'user',:user_id,'cancel_refund',:snapshot,:reason_code,:reason,'pending',:refund,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                    [
                        'public_id'=>$requestPublicId,'order_id'=>$order['id'],'user_id'=>$actor['user_id'],
                        'snapshot'=>$this->snapshot($order),'reason_code'=>!empty($order['assigned_worker_id']) ? 'bilateral_refund_pending' : $reasonCode,'reason'=>$reason,'refund'=>$refundAmount,
                    ]
                );
                $db->execute(
                    "UPDATE orders SET refund_status='pending_review',publish_status='hidden',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id",
                    ['id'=>$order['id']]
                );
                $this->event($db, (int)$order['id'], 'cancel_requested', 'user', (int)$actor['user_id'], [
                    'requested_refund_cents'=>$refundAmount,
                    'notify_recipients'=>!empty($order['assigned_worker_id']) ? ['worker'] : ['admin'],
                    'message'=>!empty($order['assigned_worker_id']) ? '用户提出退款方案，请师傅先接受或拒绝；方案金额 ¥'.number_format($refundAmount/100, 2) : '用户申请退款取消，当前可退线上实收合计 ¥'.number_format($refundAmount/100, 2),
                ]);
                return ['request_id'=>$requestPublicId,'auto_approved'=>false,'bilateral_negotiation'=>!empty($order['assigned_worker_id']),'refund_cents'=>$refundAmount,'refund_count'=>0];
            }

            $requestId = $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO order_cancel_requests(public_id,order_id,applicant_type,applicant_id,request_type,order_state_snapshot_json,reason_code,reason,status,requested_refund_cents,requested_at,created_at,updated_at)
                 VALUES(:public_id,:order_id,'user',:user_id,'cancel_refund',:snapshot,'pre_service_auto_refund',:reason,'approved',:refund,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                [
                    'public_id'=>$requestPublicId,'order_id'=>$order['id'],'user_id'=>$actor['user_id'],
                    'snapshot'=>$this->snapshot($order),'reason'=>$reason,'refund'=>$refundAmount,
                ]
            );

            return $this->approveRefund($db, $order, $requestId, $requestPublicId, $payments, $refundAmount, $reason, (int)$actor['user_id']);
        });
    }


    // 2026-10-08：接受方案时锁内复核对方身份和资金；复用未成交自动退款的同一执行器。
    public function approveByAgreement(array $actor, string $requestNo): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($actor,$requestNo): array {
            $seed = $db->fetch('SELECT order_id FROM order_cancel_requests WHERE BINARY public_id=BINARY :no', ['no'=>$requestNo]);
            if (!$seed) throw new OrderOperationException('退款方案不存在', 'REFUND_PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND', 404);
            $order = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE', ['id'=>$seed['order_id']]);
            $request = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM order_cancel_requests WHERE BINARY public_id=BINARY :no FOR UPDATE', ['no'=>$requestNo]);
            $isWorker = (string)$request['applicant_type'] === 'user' && (int)($actor['worker_id'] ?? 0) > 0 && (int)$order['assigned_worker_id'] === (int)$actor['worker_id'];
            $isUser = (string)$request['applicant_type'] === 'worker' && (int)$order['user_id'] === (int)($actor['user_id'] ?? 0);
            if (!$isWorker && !$isUser) throw new OrderOperationException('只能由方案的另一方接受', 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
            if ((string)$request['status'] !== 'pending' || (string)$request['reason_code'] !== 'bilateral_refund_pending'
                || (string)$order['lifecycle_status'] !== 'active' || in_array((string)$order['fulfillment_status'], ['submitted','accepted'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('方案已经响应或订单状态已变化', 'REFUND_PROPOSAL_NOT_PENDING', 409);
            }
            $assignment = $db->fetch("SELECT id FROM assignments WHERE id=:id AND order_id=:order AND worker_id=:worker AND status='accepted' FOR UPDATE", ['id'=>$order['current_assignment_id'] ?: 0,'order'=>$order['id'],'worker'=>$order['assigned_worker_id']]);
            if (!$assignment) throw new OrderOperationException('成交师傅关系已变化', 'ASSIGNMENT_CHANGED', 409);
            $payments = $this->refundablePayments($db, $order);
            $amount = array_sum(array_column($payments, 'available_cents'));
            // 已同意不等于能够随意分配资金：平台工费/跑空费/争议/已入账收入保持既有财务核验。
            $blocked = (string)$order['order_source_type'] === 'platform' || $amount !== (int)$request['requested_refund_cents'] || $amount < 1
                || !in_array((string)($order['dispute_status'] ?? 'none'), ['', 'none','resolved'], true)
                || (bool)$db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM run_empty_fee_claims WHERE order_id=:id AND status NOT IN ('cancelled') LIMIT 1", ['id'=>$order['id']])
                || (bool)$db->fetchValue("SELECT l.id FROM worker_balance_ledger l WHERE l.status='effective' AND ((l.business_type IN ('order','platform_order','measurement_order','order_measurement') AND l.business_id=:id) OR (l.business_type='commission' AND l.business_id IN (SELECT id FROM commission_receivables WHERE order_id=:id)) OR (l.business_type='dispute' AND l.business_id IN (SELECT id FROM disputes WHERE order_id=:id))) LIMIT 1", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            if ($blocked) {
                $db->execute("UPDATE order_cancel_requests SET reason_code='bilateral_refund_execution_required',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id", ['id'=>$request['id']]);
                // 双方已经接受取消/退款方案时，业务履约立即终止；这里只等待资金核账，不允许订单继续施工。
                $db->execute(
                    "UPDATE orders
                     SET lifecycle_status='cancel_approved_pending_refund',refund_status='pending_review',publish_status='hidden',
                         quote_status='cancelled',assignment_status='cancelled',cancelled_at=COALESCE(cancelled_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),
                         version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                     WHERE id=:id",
                    ['id'=>$order['id']]
                );
                $db->execute("UPDATE quotes SET status='cancelled',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('active','selected')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $db->execute("UPDATE assignments SET status='cancelled',cancelled_at=COALESCE(cancelled_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('offered','accepted')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $db->execute("UPDATE invite_tokens SET status='revoked' WHERE order_id=:id AND status='active'", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $db->execute("UPDATE order_role_grants SET status='revoked',revoked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status='active'", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $db->execute("UPDATE order_deadlines SET status='cancelled',processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('pending','blocked','claimed')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
                $this->event($db, (int)$order['id'], 'cancel_requested', $isWorker ? 'worker' : 'user', $isWorker ? (int)$actor['worker_id'] : (int)$actor['user_id'], [
                    'message'=>'双方已接受退款方案，订单已停止履约；涉及资金分配或可退金额变化，需平台核账后执行退款','notify_recipients'=>['user','worker','admin'],
                ]);
                return ['request_id'=>$requestNo,'agreement_accepted'=>true,'execution_requires_platform'=>true];
            }
            $db->execute("UPDATE order_cancel_requests SET status='approved',reason_code='bilateral_refund_accepted',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id", ['id'=>$request['id']]);
            return $this->approveRefund($db, $order, (int)$request['id'], $requestNo, $payments, $amount, '双方接受退款方案：'.$request['reason'], (int)$order['user_id'], true);
        });
    }

    private function approveRefund(Database $db, array $order, int $requestId, string $requestPublicId, array $payments, int $refundAmount, string $reason, int $userId, bool $agreed = false): array
    {
            $refundIds = [];
            $firstRefundId = null;
            foreach ($payments as $payment) {
                $amount = (int)$payment['available_cents'];
                if ($amount < 1) continue;
                $refundId = $db->insert(
                    "INSERT INTO refunds(public_no,payment_order_id,order_id,cancel_request_id,amount_cents,reason,status,requested_by_admin_id,requested_at,created_at,updated_at)
                     VALUES(:public_no,:payment_id,:order_id,:request_id,:amount,:reason,'pending_review',NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                    [
                        'public_no'=>\business_no('RF'),'payment_id'=>$payment['id'],'order_id'=>$order['id'],'request_id'=>$requestId,
                        'amount'=>$amount,'reason'=>mb_substr('自动取消退款：'.$reason.'；原支付：'.(string)$payment['business_type'], 0, 1000),
                    ]
                );
                if ($firstRefundId === null) $firstRefundId = $refundId;
                $refundIds[] = $refundId;
            }
            if (!$refundIds) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('当前没有可自动原路退款的实际支付，请转人工核对', 'AUTO_REFUND_PAYMENT_MISSING', 409);
            }

            // 2026-10-08：取消成立时保存失效前的报价/成交事实，与取消退款同事务提交。
            (new DatabaseOrderCancellationRiskRepository($db))->captureCancellation($order);

            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET lifecycle_status='cancel_approved_pending_refund',refund_status='pending_review',publish_status='hidden',quote_status='cancelled',assignment_status='cancelled',cancelled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1 WHERE id=:id",
                ['id'=>$order['id']]
            );
            $db->execute("UPDATE quotes SET status='cancelled',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('active','selected')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE assignments SET status='cancelled',cancelled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('offered','accepted')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE invite_tokens SET status='revoked' WHERE order_id=:id AND status='active'", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE order_role_grants SET status='revoked',revoked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status='active'", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE order_deadlines SET status='cancelled',processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('pending','blocked','claimed')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO order_cancel_decisions(cancel_request_id,order_id,decision,responsibility,reason,refund_amount_cents,run_empty_fee_cents,refund_id,decided_by,decided_at,created_at)
                 VALUES(:request_id,:order_id,'approved','user',:reason,:refund,0,:refund_id,NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                [
                    'request_id'=>$requestId,'order_id'=>$order['id'],
                    'reason'=>mb_substr('系统执行已获准退款；原因：'.$reason, 0, 1000),
                    'refund'=>$refundAmount,'refund_id'=>$firstRefundId,
                ]
            );
            $this->event($db, (int)$order['id'], 'cancel_approved', 'system', 0, [
                'refund_amount_cents'=>$refundAmount,'refund_count'=>count($refundIds),'auto_approved'=>1,
                'requested_by_user_id'=>$userId,
                'message'=>'系统已取消订单并登记 '.count($refundIds).' 笔原路退款，无需管理员审核',
                'notify_recipients'=>$agreed ? ['user','worker'] : ['user'],
            ]);
            return ['request_id'=>$requestPublicId,'auto_approved'=>true,'refund_cents'=>$refundAmount,'refund_count'=>count($refundIds)];
    }

    public function review(
        array $operator,
        string $orderNo,
        string $decision,
        string $workerArrived,
        string $responsibility,
        string $reason,
        int $refundCents
    ): array {
        $operation = function () use ($operator, $orderNo, $decision, $workerArrived, $responsibility, $reason, $refundCents): array {
            return $this->reviewUnderWriteGuard($operator, $orderNo, $decision, $workerArrived, $responsibility, $reason, $refundCents);
        };
        if (($operator['channel'] ?? '') === 'web_admin') {
            return (new DatabaseDemoOrderWriteGuard($this->db))->run($orderNo, $operation);
        }
        return $operation();
    }

    private function reviewUnderWriteGuard(
        array $operator,
        string $orderNo,
        string $decision,
        string $workerArrived,
        string $responsibility,
        string $reason,
        int $refundCents
    ): array {
        $channel = (string)($operator['channel'] ?? '');
        if ($channel === 'mini_admin') {
            $operatorId = max(0, (int)($operator['user_id'] ?? 0));
            $webAdminId = 0;
        } elseif ($channel === 'web_admin') {
            $operatorId = max(0, (int)($operator['admin_user_id'] ?? 0));
            $webAdminId = $operatorId;
        } else {
            $operatorId = 0;
            $webAdminId = 0;
        }
        if ($operatorId < 1) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('管理员操作来源无效', 'ADMIN_REQUIRED', 403);
        }
        $decidedBy = $webAdminId > 0 ? $webAdminId : null;

        return $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($orderNo,$decision,$workerArrived,$responsibility,$reason,$refundCents,$channel,$operatorId,$decidedBy): array {
            $order = $db->fetch(
                'SELECT * FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no FOR UPDATE',
                ['public_no'=>$orderNo]
            );
            if (!$order) throw new OrderOperationException('订单不存在', 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 404);

            $request = $db->fetch(
                "SELECT * FROM order_cancel_requests
                 WHERE order_id=:order_id AND status='pending'
                 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
                ['order_id'=>$order['id']]
            );
            if (!$request) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('当前没有待审核退款申请', 'REFUND_REVIEW_CHANGED', 409);
            }
            if (in_array((string)$request['reason_code'], ['bilateral_refund_pending','bilateral_refund_rejected'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('请先由订单双方申请平台介入', 'NEGOTIATION_NOT_ESCALATED', 409);
            }
            if ((string)$request['reason_code'] === 'bilateral_refund_execution_required') {
                throw new OrderOperationException(
                    '双方已经接受退款方案；当前涉及资金核账或历史入账，请到 Web 后台按真实资金记录执行，不能在小程序重新通过或拒绝',
                    'REFUND_EXECUTION_WEB_REQUIRED',
                    409
                );
            }

            $needsArrival = !empty($order['assigned_worker_id'])
                || in_array((string)($order['assignment_status'] ?? ''), ['offered','accepted','assigned'], true)
                || in_array((string)($order['fulfillment_status'] ?? ''), ['scheduled','in_progress'], true);
            if (!$needsArrival) $workerArrived = 'no';
            if ($needsArrival && !in_array($workerArrived, ['yes','no'], true)) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('请确认师傅是否已经上门', 'WORKER_ARRIVAL_REQUIRED', 422);
            }
            $responsibilityLabels = [
                'worker'=>'师傅','user'=>'用户','platform'=>'平台','shared'=>'双方','unclear'=>'待定',
            ];
            $decisionReason = ($workerArrived === 'yes' ? '师傅已上门' : '师傅未上门')
                .'；责任：'.$responsibilityLabels[$responsibility].'；'.$reason;

            if ($decision === 'reject') {
                $changed = $db->execute(
                    "UPDATE order_cancel_requests
                     SET status='rejected',closed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                     WHERE id=:id AND status='pending'",
                    ['id'=>$request['id']]
                );
                if ($changed !== 1) {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('退款申请状态已变化，请刷新', 'REFUND_REVIEW_CHANGED', 409);
                }
                $hasMeasurementLink = (bool)$db->fetchValue(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM order_relations
                     WHERE child_order_id=:id AND relation_type='measurement_construction' AND status='active' LIMIT 1",
                    ['id'=>$order['id']]
                );
                $snapshot = $this->decodeSnapshot((string)($request['order_state_snapshot_json'] ?? ''));
                $restorePublish = (string)($snapshot['publish_status'] ?? 'hidden');
                if (!in_array($restorePublish, ['published','hidden'], true)) $restorePublish = 'hidden';
                if ($hasMeasurementLink) $restorePublish = 'hidden';
                $restoreRefund = (string)($snapshot['refund_status'] ?? 'none');
                if (!in_array($restoreRefund, ['','none','failed'], true)) $restoreRefund = 'none';
                if ($restoreRefund === '') $restoreRefund = 'none';
                $db->execute(
                    "UPDATE orders
                     SET refund_status=:refund_status,publish_status=:publish_status,
                         updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1
                     WHERE id=:id",
                    [
                        'refund_status'=>$restoreRefund,
                        'publish_status'=>$restorePublish,
                        'id'=>$order['id'],
                    ]
                );
                $db->insert(
                    "INSERT INTO order_cancel_decisions(cancel_request_id,order_id,decision,responsibility,reason,refund_amount_cents,run_empty_fee_cents,refund_id,decided_by,decided_at,created_at)
                     VALUES(:request_id,:order_id,'rejected',:responsibility,:reason,0,0,NULL,:decided_by,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                    [
                        'request_id'=>$request['id'],'order_id'=>$order['id'],
                        'responsibility'=>$responsibility,'reason'=>$decisionReason,'decided_by'=>$decidedBy,
                    ]
                );
                $this->event($db, (int)$order['id'], 'cancel_rejected', $channel, $operatorId, [
                    'message'=>'退款申请未通过：'.$decisionReason,
                    'restored_publish_status'=>$restorePublish,
                    'operator_channel'=>$channel,
                    'operator_user_id'=>$channel === 'mini_admin' ? $operatorId : null,
                    'operator_admin_id'=>$channel === 'web_admin' ? $operatorId : null,
                    'notify_recipients'=>['user'],
                ]);
                return ['approved'=>false,'refund_cents'=>0,'refund_ids'=>[]];
            }

            if ($workerArrived === 'yes' && $responsibility !== 'worker') {
                throw new OrderOperationException(
                    '师傅已上门且不是师傅责任时，请拒绝退款并记录说明',
                    'REFUND_ARRIVAL_RESPONSIBILITY_CONFLICT',
                    422
                );
            }

            $payments = $this->refundablePayments($db, $order);
            $available = array_sum(array_map(static function (array $row): int {
                return (int)$row['available_cents'];
            }, $payments));
            $requested = max(0, (int)$request['requested_refund_cents']);
            $maxRefund = $requested > 0 ? min($available, $requested) : $available;
            if ($maxRefund > 0 && $refundCents < 1) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('请填写退款金额', 'REFUND_AMOUNT_REQUIRED', 422);
            }
            if ($refundCents > $maxRefund) {
                throw new OrderOperationException(
                    '退款金额超过当前可退线上余额 '.number_format($maxRefund/100, 2).' 元',
                    'REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE',
                    422,
                    ['max_refund_cents'=>$maxRefund]
                );
            }

            $remaining = $refundCents;
            $refundIds = [];
            $firstRefundId = null;
            foreach ($payments as $payment) {
                if ($remaining <= 0) break;
                $part = min($remaining, (int)$payment['available_cents']);
                if ($part < 1) continue;
                $refundId = $db->insert(
                    "INSERT INTO refunds(public_no,payment_order_id,order_id,cancel_request_id,amount_cents,reason,status,requested_by_admin_id,requested_at,created_at,updated_at)
                     VALUES(:public_no,:payment_id,:order_id,:request_id,:amount,:reason,'pending_review',:requested_by_admin_id,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                    [
                        'public_no'=>\business_no('RF'),
                        'payment_id'=>$payment['id'],
                        'order_id'=>$order['id'],
                        'request_id'=>$request['id'],
                        'amount'=>$part,
                        'reason'=>$decisionReason.'；原支付：'.(string)$payment['business_type'],
                        'requested_by_admin_id'=>$decidedBy,
                    ]
                );
                if ($firstRefundId === null) $firstRefundId = $refundId;
                $refundIds[] = $refundId;
                $remaining -= $part;
            }
            if ($remaining > 0) {
                throw new OrderOperationException(
                    '退款拆分失败，当前原支付可退余额不足，请刷新后重试',
                    'REFUND_SPLIT_BALANCE_CHANGED',
                    409
                );
            }

            // 先抢占 pending 取消申请，再推进订单；网络重试或并发请求只能有一个事务成功。
            $requestChanged = $db->execute(
                "UPDATE order_cancel_requests
                 SET status=:status,requested_refund_cents=:refund,
                     closed_at=IF(:close_now=1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),NULL),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                 WHERE id=:id AND status='pending'",
                [
                    'status'=>$refundCents > 0 ? 'processing' : 'approved',
                    'refund'=>$refundCents,
                    'close_now'=>$refundCents > 0 ? 0 : 1,
                    'id'=>$request['id'],
                ]
            );
            if ($requestChanged !== 1) {
                throw new OrderOperationException('退款申请状态已变化，请刷新', 'REFUND_REVIEW_CHANGED', 409);
            }

            $lifecycle = $refundCents > 0 ? 'cancel_approved_pending_refund' : 'cancelled';
            (new DatabaseOrderCancellationRiskRepository($db))->captureCancellation($order, $responsibility);
            $refundStatus = $refundCents > 0 ? 'pending_review' : 'none';
            $db->execute(
                "UPDATE orders
                 SET lifecycle_status=:lifecycle,refund_status=:refund_status,publish_status='hidden',
                     quote_status='cancelled',assignment_status='cancelled',cancelled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),
                     closed_at=IF(:close_now=1,COALESCE(closed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()),closed_at),
                     updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),version=version+1
                 WHERE id=:id",
                [
                    'lifecycle'=>$lifecycle,'refund_status'=>$refundStatus,
                    'close_now'=>$refundCents > 0 ? 0 : 1,'id'=>$order['id'],
                ]
            );
            $db->execute("UPDATE quotes SET status='cancelled',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('active','selected')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE assignments SET status='cancelled',cancelled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('offered','accepted')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE invite_tokens SET status='revoked' WHERE order_id=:id AND status='active'", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE order_role_grants SET status='revoked',revoked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status='active'", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->execute("UPDATE order_deadlines SET status='cancelled',processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id=:id AND status IN ('pending','blocked','claimed')", ['id'=>$order['id']]);
            $db->insert(
                "INSERT INTO order_cancel_decisions(cancel_request_id,order_id,decision,responsibility,reason,refund_amount_cents,run_empty_fee_cents,refund_id,decided_by,decided_at,created_at)
                 VALUES(:request_id,:order_id,'approved',:responsibility,:reason,:refund,0,:refund_id,:decided_by,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",
                [
                    'request_id'=>$request['id'],'order_id'=>$order['id'],'responsibility'=>$responsibility,
                    'reason'=>$decisionReason,'refund'=>$refundCents,'refund_id'=>$firstRefundId,'decided_by'=>$decidedBy,
                ]
            );
            $this->event($db, (int)$order['id'], 'cancel_approved', $channel, $operatorId, [
                'refund_amount_cents'=>$refundCents,
                'refund_count'=>count($refundIds),
                'message'=>$refundCents > 0
                    ? '退款审核通过，已按原支付单拆分为 '.count($refundIds).' 笔微信退款'
                    : '取消申请通过，无线上款项需退',
                'operator_channel'=>$channel,
                'operator_user_id'=>$channel === 'mini_admin' ? $operatorId : null,
                'operator_admin_id'=>$channel === 'web_admin' ? $operatorId : null,
                'notify_recipients'=>['user'],
            ]);
            return ['approved'=>true,'refund_cents'=>$refundCents,'refund_ids'=>$refundIds];
        });
    }

    /** @return array<int,array<string,mixed>> */
    private function refundablePayments(Database $db, array $order): array
    {
        $measurement = (string)($order['workflow_profile'] ?? 'construction') === 'measurement';
        $types = $measurement ? ['order_booking','booking_fee','measurement_balance','measurement_change'] : ['order_booking','booking_fee'];
        $marks = [];
        $params = ['order_id'=>$order['id']];
        foreach ($types as $index=>$type) {
            $key = 'type_'.$index;
            $marks[] = ':'.$key;
            $params[$key] = $type;
        }
        $rows = $db->fetchAll(
            "SELECT * FROM payment_orders WHERE order_id=:order_id AND business_type IN (".implode(',', $marks).") AND status IN ('paid','refunded')
             ORDER BY CASE business_type WHEN 'measurement_change' THEN 1 WHEN 'measurement_balance' THEN 2 WHEN 'booking_fee' THEN 3 WHEN 'order_booking' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END,id DESC FOR UPDATE",
            $params
        );
        $runnerRemaining = (int)$db->fetchValue(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount_cents),0) FROM worker_balance_ledger l
             INNER JOIN disputes d ON d.id=l.business_id
             WHERE l.business_type='dispute' AND l.entry_type='run_empty_fee' AND l.status='effective' AND d.order_id=:order_id",
            ['order_id'=>$order['id']]
        );
        $result = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $refundAllocated = (int)$db->fetchValue(
                "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0) FROM refunds WHERE payment_order_id=:payment_id AND status NOT IN ('failed','closed','cancelled','rejected')",
                ['payment_id'=>$row['id']]
            );
            $cap = max(0, (int)$row['amount_cents']);
            if (in_array((string)$row['business_type'], ['order_booking','booking_fee'], true)) {
                if ((int)($order['booking_fee_cents'] ?? 0) > 0) $cap = min($cap, (int)$order['booking_fee_cents']);
                $runnerApplied = min($cap, max(0, $runnerRemaining));
                $runnerRemaining = max(0, $runnerRemaining - $runnerApplied);
            } else {
                $runnerApplied = 0;
            }
            $available = max(0, $cap - $refundAllocated - $runnerApplied);
            if ($available < 1) continue;
            $row['available_cents'] = $available;
            $result[] = $row;
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function canAutoApproveBeforeService(Database $db, array $order): bool
    {
        if ((string)($order['order_source_type'] ?? 'consumer') !== 'consumer') return false;
        if (!in_array((string)($order['refund_status'] ?? 'none'), ['', 'none'], true)) return false;
        if (!empty($order['selected_quote_id']) || !empty($order['assigned_worker_id']) || !empty($order['current_assignment_id'])) return false;
        if (!empty($order['contact_revealed_at']) || !empty($order['completion_submitted_at']) || !empty($order['accepted_at'])) return false;
        if (in_array((string)($order['fulfillment_status'] ?? ''), ['scheduled','in_progress','submitted','accepted'], true)) return false;

        $blocked = (int)$db->fetchValue(
            "SELECT (
                EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments WHERE order_id=:a LIMIT 1)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quote_selections WHERE order_id=:q LIMIT 1)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM appointment_records WHERE order_id=:ap LIMIT 1)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM change_requests WHERE order_id=:c LIMIT 1)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM disputes WHERE order_id=:d LIMIT 1)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM after_sales WHERE order_id=:s LIMIT 1)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_empty_fee_claims WHERE order_id=:r LIMIT 1)
            ) AS blocked",
            ['a'=>$order['id'],'q'=>$order['id'],'ap'=>$order['id'],'c'=>$order['id'],'d'=>$order['id'],'s'=>$order['id'],'r'=>$order['id']]
        );
        return $blocked === 0;
    }

    /** @return array<string,mixed> */
    private function decodeSnapshot(string $json): array
    {
        $decoded = json_decode($json, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
    }

    private function snapshot(array $order): string
    {
        $json = json_encode([
            'lifecycle_status'=>$order['lifecycle_status'] ?? null,
            'fulfillment_status'=>$order['fulfillment_status'] ?? null,
            'payment_status'=>$order['payment_status'] ?? null,
            'workflow_profile'=>$order['workflow_profile'] ?? null,
            'order_source_type'=>$order['order_source_type'] ?? null,
            'refund_status'=>$order['refund_status'] ?? null,
            'publish_status'=>$order['publish_status'] ?? null,
            'quote_status'=>$order['quote_status'] ?? null,
            'assignment_status'=>$order['assignment_status'] ?? null,
            'selected_quote_id'=>$order['selected_quote_id'] ?? null,
            'assigned_worker_id'=>$order['assigned_worker_id'] ?? null,
        ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        return is_string($json) ? $json : '{}';
    }

    private function event(Database $db, int $orderId, string $type, string $actorType, int $actorId, array $payload): void
    {
        if (function_exists('app_config') && \app_config('chat.order_policy_enabled',false)===true) {
            (new DatabaseOrderConversationBridge($db,true))->schedule($orderId);
        }
        $eventKey = $type.':'.$orderId.':'.bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        $db->insert(
            'INSERT INTO order_events(order_id,event_type,event_key,actor_type,actor_id,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(:order_id,:type,:event_key,:actor_type,:actor_id,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())',
            [
                'order_id'=>$orderId,'type'=>$type,'event_key'=>$eventKey,'actor_type'=>$actorType,
                'actor_id'=>$actorId > 0 ? $actorId : null,
                'payload'=>json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES),
            ]
        );
        OrderNotificationService::queue($db, $orderId, $eventKey, $type, $payload);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Messaging;

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\MessageEventCatalog;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\OrderMessageDefinition;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\WechatTemplateValue;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Testing\TestMessageProjectionRecorder;

final class OrderNotificationProjector
{

    public static function queueAdminTask(Database $db,string $eventKey,string $eventType,string $title,array $lines=[]):void
    {
        // 与订单事件的 demo 隔离保持一致：带订单号的演示/测试订单绝不能进入真实企业微信管理员待办。
        // 无订单号的入驻、提现等独立业务仍沿用原有通知逻辑。
        $orderNo=trim((string)($lines['订单号']??''));
        if($orderNo!==''){
            $isDemo=(int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT COALESCE(is_demo,0) FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no LIMIT 1',['public_no'=>$orderNo]);
            if($isDemo===1)return;
        }
        if(!self::eventEnabled('wecom.event_switches',$eventType)||!\filter_var(\setting('wecom.webhook_enabled',false),FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN))return;
        // 2026-09-22：机器人首行直接显示具体事项标题，不再套“壁选后台待办”等笼统标题。
        $title=trim((string)(preg_replace('/[\\r\\n【】]+/u',' ',$title)??''));
        if($title==='')$title=$eventType;
        $title=mb_substr($title,0,40);
        $content='【'.$title.'】';
        foreach($lines as $label=>$value){$value=trim((string)$value);if($value!=='')$content.="\n".$label.'：'.$value;}
        $orderId=0;
        if(isset($lines['订单号'])&&trim((string)$lines['订单号'])!==''){
            $orderId=(int)$db->fetchValue('SELECT id FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no LIMIT 1',['public_no'=>(string)$lines['订单号']]);
        }
        $data=['content'=>$content,'event_type'=>$eventType,'title'=>$title,'action_path'=>self::adminActionPath($eventType,$orderId)];
        $db->execute("INSERT IGNORE INTO message_outbox(topic,business_key,payload_json,status,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,created_at) VALUES('wecom_webhook',:business_key,:payload,'pending',0,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['business_key'=>substr($eventKey.':admin:wecom',0,128),'payload'=>json_encode($data,JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)]);
    }

    public static function queue(Database $db, int $orderId, string $eventKey, string $eventType, array $payload = []): void
    {
        $definition = OrderMessageDefinition::definition($eventType, $payload); if (!$definition) return;
        $order = $db->fetch("SELECT o.public_no,o.user_id,o.assigned_worker_id,o.final_amount_cents,o.booking_fee_cents,o.is_demo,u.mobile_ciphertext user_mobile FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id=o.user_id WHERE o.id=:id", ['id'=>$orderId]);
        if (!$order) return;
        $parameters = ['order_no'=>(string)$order['public_no'],'status'=>$definition['status'],'amount'=>number_format(((int)($definition['amount_cents'] ?? $order['final_amount_cents']))/100,2,'.',''),'time'=>date('Y-m-d H:i')];
        // 内部通知是基础渠道，可单独关闭某类进度消息；不影响外部通知。
        if (self::eventEnabled('notification.internal_event_switches', $eventType)) {
            $noticeData = json_encode(['order_id' => (int) $orderId, 'event_key' => $eventKey], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
            foreach ($definition['recipients'] as $recipientType) {
                if (!in_array($recipientType, ['user', 'worker'], true)) continue;
                $recipientId = $recipientType === 'user' ? (int) $order['user_id'] : (int) ($order['assigned_worker_id'] ?? 0);
                if ($recipientId < 1) continue;
                $content = '订单 ' . $parameters['order_no'] . '：' . $definition['status'];
                if (!empty($definition['amount_cents'])) $content .= '，金额 ' . $parameters['amount'] . ' 元';
                $duplicate = $db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE recipient_type=:recipient_type AND recipient_id=:recipient_id AND channel='in_app' AND template_key=:template_key AND BINARY data_json=BINARY :data_json LIMIT 1", [
                    'recipient_type' => $recipientType, 'recipient_id' => $recipientId, 'template_key' => $eventType, 'data_json' => $noticeData,
                ]);
                if (!$duplicate) {
                    $db->insert("INSERT INTO notifications(public_id,recipient_type,recipient_id,channel,template_key,title,content,data_json,status,scheduled_at,created_at) VALUES(:public_id,:recipient_type,:recipient_id,'in_app',:template_key,:title,:content,:data,'pending',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())", [
                        'public_id' => \public_id(), 'recipient_type' => $recipientType, 'recipient_id' => $recipientId,
                        'template_key' => $eventType, 'title' => $definition['status'], 'content' => $content, 'data' => $noticeData,
                    ]);
                }
            }
        }
        // V2.2.7：演示订单只落站内消息，绝不进入企业微信、微信订阅或短信发件箱。
        // 测试中心订单额外记录“应发但未真实投递”的模拟投影，不复用真实 message_outbox。
        if(!empty($order['is_demo'])){
            try{
                TestMessageProjectionRecorder::capture($db,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,$definition,$order,$parameters);
            }catch(\Throwable $exception){
                \write_log('test-center','['.date('c').'] message_projection_failed order_id='.$orderId.' event='.str_replace(["\r","\n"],' ',$eventType).' '.$exception->getMessage()."\n");
            }
            return;
        }
        // 2026-09-02：管理员通知独立进入企业微信机器人，不读取或发送管理员短信号码。
        if (in_array('admin', $definition['recipients'], true) && self::eventEnabled('wecom.event_switches', $eventType)
            && \filter_var(\setting('wecom.webhook_enabled', false), FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN)) {
            $adminTitle=trim((string)($definition['admin_title']??$definition['status']??''));
            $adminTitle=trim((string)(preg_replace('/[\\r\\n【】]+/u',' ',$adminTitle)??''));
            if($adminTitle==='')$adminTitle=$eventType;
            $adminTitle=mb_substr($adminTitle,0,40);
            $content = "【{$adminTitle}】\n订单号：{$parameters['order_no']}\n时间：{$parameters['time']}";
            if ((string)$definition['status'] !== $adminTitle) $content .= "\n状态：{$definition['status']}";
            if (!empty($definition['amount_cents'])) $content .= "\n金额：{$parameters['amount']} 元";
            $adminData=['content'=>$content,'event_type'=>$eventType,'order_id'=>$orderId,'title'=>$adminTitle,'action_path'=>self::adminActionPath($eventType,$orderId,(string)$order['public_no'])];
            $db->execute("INSERT IGNORE INTO message_outbox(topic,business_key,payload_json,status,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,created_at) VALUES('wecom_webhook',:business_key,:payload,'pending',0,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['business_key'=>substr($eventKey.':admin:wecom',0,128),'payload'=>json_encode($adminData,JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)]);
        }
        // 2026-10-01：外部触达分两种模式：
        // 1) 建议/普通短信仍按开关独立发送；
        // 2) “订阅补充短信”改为微信订阅优先，只有订阅不可用或最终失败时才进入短信队列。
        $smsEnabled=\filter_var(\setting('sms.enabled',false),FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN)
            && self::eventEnabled('sms.event_switches',$eventType);
        $eventMeta=MessageEventCatalog::get($eventType)??[];
        $fallbackMode=$smsEnabled && (($eventMeta['sms_delivery_mode']??'independent')==='subscription_fallback');
        $fallbackPayload=$fallbackMode
            ? OrderSubscriptionQueue::buildSubscriptionFallbackSmsPayload($db,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,$definition,$order,$parameters)
            : null;
        $subscription=OrderSubscriptionQueue::queueOrderSubscription(
            $db,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,$definition,$order,$parameters,
            is_array($fallbackPayload)?$fallbackPayload:[]
        );
        // 同一事件对用户和师傅的外部提醒语义可能不同。若事件需要师傅及时知道、
        // 但主订阅场景并不是师傅场景，则额外使用通用“师傅订单重要进度”模板补一条微信提醒。
        OrderSubscriptionQueue::queueWorkerOrderUpdateSupplement($db,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,$definition,$order,$parameters,$fallbackMode);
        if($fallbackMode){
            if(empty($subscription['queued'])&&is_array($fallbackPayload)){
                $fallbackPayload['fallback_reason']=(string)($subscription['reason']??'subscription_unavailable');
                OrderSubscriptionQueue::enqueueSmsFallback($db,$fallbackPayload);
            }
            return;
        }

        if(!$smsEnabled)return;
        $templates=\setting('sms.template_codes',[]);if(!is_array($templates))return;
        $configured=$templates[$definition['scene']]??'';
        $templateCode=is_array($configured)?(string)(($configured['template_code']??'')?:($configured['template_id']??'')?:($configured['code']??'')):(string)$configured;
        if($templateCode==='')return;
        $recipients=[];
        foreach($definition['recipients'] as $recipient){
            if($recipient==='user'){$mobile=\decrypt_private_value((string)$order['user_mobile'],'user-mobile');if($mobile!=='')$recipients['user:'.(int)$order['user_id']]=[$mobile,'user',(int)$order['user_id']];}
            elseif($recipient==='worker'&&!empty($order['assigned_worker_id'])){$row=$db->fetch('SELECT mobile_ciphertext FROM worker_profiles WHERE id=:id',['id'=>$order['assigned_worker_id']]);$mobile=$row?\decrypt_private_value((string)$row['mobile_ciphertext'],'worker-mobile'):'';if($mobile!=='')$recipients['worker:'.(int)$order['assigned_worker_id']]=[$mobile,'worker',(int)$order['assigned_worker_id']];}
        }
        foreach($recipients as $key=>$recipient){
            $data=['mobile'=>$recipient[0],'template_code'=>$templateCode,'parameters'=>$parameters,'event_type'=>$eventType,'order_id'=>$orderId,'recipient_type'=>$recipient[1],'recipient_id'=>$recipient[2]];
            $db->execute("INSERT IGNORE INTO message_outbox(topic,business_key,payload_json,status,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,created_at) VALUES('aliyun_sms',:business_key,:payload,'pending',0,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['business_key'=>substr($eventKey.':'.$key,0,128),'payload'=>json_encode($data,JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)]);

    public static function adminActionPath(string $eventType, int $orderId=0, string $orderNo=''): ?string
    {
        $routes=[
            'platform_worker_quoted'=>'platform-orders',

    public static function queueWorkerWithdrawalResult(Database $db,int $workerId,string $withdrawalNo,string $status,string $note='',int $amountCents=0):void
    {
        if($workerId<1||$withdrawalNo==='')return;

        [$title,$content]=$labels[$status];
        if($amountCents>0)$content.=' 金额 '.number_format($amountCents/100,2,'.','').' 元。';
        $note=trim($note);if($note!=='')$content.=' 说明：'.mb_substr($note,0,120);

    public static function queueWorkerReviewResult(Database $db, int $workerId, string $cloudId, string $decision, string $reason, string $workerName=''): void
    {
        if ($workerId < 1) return;
        $row = $db->fetch("SELECT w.user_id,w.display_name,u.mobile_ciphertext,(SELECT wi.openid FROM wechat_identities wi WHERE wi.user_id=w.user_id AND wi.status='active' ORDER BY wi.id DESC LIMIT 1) openid FROM worker_profiles w JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id WHERE w.id=:id LIMIT 1", ['id'=>$workerId]);
        if (!$row) return;
        $labels=['approved'=>'审核通过','rejected'=>'审核未通过','suspended'=>'接单已暂停','pending'=>'等待审核'];
        $status=$labels[$decision]??'审核状态已更新';
        $dataJson=json_encode(['cloud_id'=>$cloudId,'review_status'=>$decision],JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $duplicate=$db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE recipient_type='worker' AND recipient_id=:id AND channel='in_app' AND template_key='worker_profile_review_result' AND BINARY data_json=BINARY :data LIMIT 1",['id'=>$workerId,'data'=>$dataJson]);
        if(!$duplicate)$db->insert("INSERT INTO notifications(public_id,recipient_type,recipient_id,channel,template_key,title,content,data_json,status,scheduled_at,created_at) VALUES(:public_id,'worker',:recipient_id,'in_app','worker_profile_review_result',:title,:content,:data,'pending',UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())",['public_id'=>\public_id(),'recipient_id'=>$workerId,'title'=>'师傅入驻'.$status,'content'=>$reason!==''?$status.'：'.mb_substr($reason,0,80):$status,'data'=>$dataJson]);
        if(!in_array($decision,['approved','rejected','suspended'],true))return;
        $scenes=SubscriptionCatalog::subscriptionSceneDefinitions();$scene=$scenes['reviewResult'];$userId=(int)$row['user_id'];$pref=SubscriptionQuotaStore::subscriptionPreferences($db,$userId)['reviewResult']??[];
        if(empty($scene['available']))return;
        $authorizationStatus=(string)($pref['authorization_status']??'');
        $subscriptionType=(string)($scene['subscription_type']??'one_time');
        if($subscriptionType==='one_time'){
            if(in_array($authorizationStatus,['ban','disabled'],true))return;

        }else{
            if(empty($pref['enabled'])||!in_array($authorizationStatus,['accept','acceptWithAudio','acceptWithAlert'],true))return;

        $openid=trim((string)$row['openid']);$mobile=\decrypt_private_value((string)$row['mobile_ciphertext'],'user-mobile');if($openid===''||$mobile==='')return;
        $name=mb_substr(trim($workerName)!==''?trim($workerName):(string)$row['display_name'],0,10);
        $thing=$decision==='approved'?'入驻审核已通过，请进入小程序查看。':($decision==='rejected'?'入驻审核未通过，请按处理说明修改。':'师傅接单状态已暂停，请查看处理说明。');
        if($reason!=='')$thing=mb_substr($thing.' '.trim($reason),0,20);

            'name1'=>['value'=>$name?:'入驻师傅'],
            'phone_number2'=>['value'=>$mobile],
            'phrase3'=>['value'=>$status],
            'thing5'=>['value'=>$thing],
        ]);
    }

    public static function eventEnabled(string $settingKey, string $eventType): bool
    {
        $channel = strpos($settingKey, 'wecom.') === 0 ? 'wecom' : (strpos($settingKey, 'notification.') === 0 ? 'inapp' : 'sms');

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Persistence;

use Throwable;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;

final class DatabaseDemoOrderWriteGuard
{
    private Database $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db) { $this->db = $db; }

    public function run(string $orderNo, callable $operation): array
    {
        $params = ['lock_name'=>'wall_worker_admin_demo_guard'];
        if ((int)$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT GET_LOCK(:lock_name,5)', $params) !== 1) {
            throw new OrderOperationException('演示数据设置正在变更，请稍后重试。', 'DEMO_SETTING_BUSY', 409);
        }
        try {
            // Locking read bypasses the HTTP settings cache and any earlier transaction snapshot.
            $setting = $this->db->fetch(
                "SELECT setting_value FROM system_settings WHERE setting_key='demo.data_enabled' LOCK IN SHARE MODE"
            );
            $enabled = !$setting || in_array(strtolower((string)$setting['setting_value']), ['1','true','yes','on'], true);
            if (!$enabled) {
                $order = $this->db->fetch(
                    'SELECT is_demo,public_no FROM orders WHERE BINARY public_no=BINARY :public_no LIMIT 1',
                    ['public_no'=>$orderNo]
                );
                if ($order && (!empty($order['is_demo']) || stripos((string)$order['public_no'], 'DEMO') !== false)) {
                    throw new OrderOperationException('演示数据已关闭，该演示记录不可继续处理。', 'DEMO_DATA_DISABLED', 403);
                }
            }
            return $operation();
        } finally {
            try { $this->db->fetchValue('SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(:lock_name)', $params); }
            catch (Throwable $exception) { /* Connection close also releases the advisory lock. */ }
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Testing;

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\MessageEventCatalog;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Messaging\SubscriptionCatalog;
use WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Safety\TestingEnvironmentPolicy;

/**
 * 测试订单消息投影记录器。
 *
 * 只记录“本来会尝试什么渠道”的测试证据，不写真实 message_outbox，
 * 不读取/保存手机号、OpenID、Webhook 等敏感投递地址。
 */
final class TestMessageProjectionRecorder
{
    public static function capture(Database $db,int $orderId,string $eventKey,string $eventType,array $definition,array $order,array $parameters): void
    {
        if(!TestingEnvironmentPolicy::active()||!$db->tableExists('test_message_outbox'))return;
        $instanceId=self::resolveInstanceId($db,$orderId);
        if($instanceId<1)return;

        $meta=MessageEventCatalog::get($eventType)??[];
        foreach((array)($definition['recipients']??[]) as $recipientType){
            if(!in_array($recipientType,['user','worker'],true))continue;
            $recipientId=$recipientType==='user'?(int)($order['user_id']??0):(int)($order['assigned_worker_id']??0);
            if($recipientId<1)continue;
            $inappEnabled=self::eventEnabled('notification.internal_event_switches','inapp',$eventType);
            self::record($db,$instanceId,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,'in_app',$recipientType,$recipientId,
                $inappEnabled?'delivered':'config_disabled',$inappEnabled?'notification_created_or_deduplicated':'event_switch_disabled',
                (string)($definition['scene']??''),[
                    'status'=>(string)($definition['status']??''),'order_no'=>(string)($parameters['order_no']??''),
                    'amount'=>(string)($parameters['amount']??''),'delivery_mode'=>'internal',
                ]);
        }

        self::captureSubscription($db,$instanceId,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,$definition,$order,$parameters,$meta);
        self::captureSms($db,$instanceId,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,$definition,$order,$parameters,$meta);
        self::captureWecom($db,$instanceId,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,$definition,$parameters,$meta);
    }

    private static function captureSubscription(Database $db,int $instanceId,int $orderId,string $eventKey,string $eventType,array $definition,array $order,array $parameters,array $meta): void
    {
        $sceneKey=trim((string)($meta['subscription_scene']??''));
        if($sceneKey==='')return;
        $scenes=SubscriptionCatalog::subscriptionSceneDefinitions();
        $scene=$scenes[$sceneKey]??null;
        $recipientType=is_array($scene)?(string)($scene['recipient']??'user'):'user';
        if(!in_array($recipientType,(array)($definition['recipients']??[]),true))return;
        $recipientId=$recipientType==='user'?(int)($order['user_id']??0):(int)($order['assigned_worker_id']??0);
        if($recipientId<1)return;
        $available=is_array($scene)&&!empty($scene['available'])&&!empty($scene['field_map']);
        self::record($db,$instanceId,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,'wechat_subscribe',$recipientType,$recipientId,
            $available?'demo_suppressed':'config_disabled',
            $available?'demo_order_external_delivery_suppressed':(string)($scene['availability_reason']??'scene_unavailable'),
            $sceneKey,[
                'status'=>(string)($definition['status']??''),'order_no'=>(string)($parameters['order_no']??''),
                'subscription_type'=>(string)($scene['subscription_type']??''),'eligibility'=>'quota_and_authorization_not_consumed',
            ]);

        if($recipientType==='worker'||!in_array('worker',(array)($definition['recipients']??[]),true)||(int)($order['assigned_worker_id']??0)<1)return;
        $important=((string)($meta['priority']??'normal')==='important')||$eventType==='worker_assigned';
        if(!$important)return;
        $supplement=$scenes['worker_order_update']??null;
        $supplementAvailable=is_array($supplement)&&!empty($supplement['available'])&&!empty($supplement['field_map']);
        self::record($db,$instanceId,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,'wechat_subscribe','worker',(int)$order['assigned_worker_id'],
            $supplementAvailable?'demo_suppressed':'config_disabled',
            $supplementAvailable?'demo_order_external_delivery_suppressed':(string)($supplement['availability_reason']??'scene_unavailable'),
            'worker_order_update',[
                'status'=>(string)($definition['status']??''),'order_no'=>(string)($parameters['order_no']??''),
                'supplement'=>true,'eligibility'=>'quota_and_authorization_not_consumed',
            ]);
    }

    private static function captureSms(Database $db,int $instanceId,int $orderId,string $eventKey,string $eventType,array $definition,array $order,array $parameters,array $meta): void
    {
        if(empty($meta['sms_visible']))return;
        $enabled=\filter_var(\setting('sms.enabled',false),FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN)
            && self::eventEnabled('sms.event_switches','sms',$eventType);
        $templates=\setting('sms.template_codes',[]);
        $configured=is_array($templates)?($templates[(string)($definition['scene']??'')]??''):'';
        $templateCode=is_array($configured)?(string)(($configured['template_code']??'')?:($configured['template_id']??'')?:($configured['code']??'')):(string)$configured;
        $deliveryMode=(string)($meta['sms_delivery_mode']??'independent');
        if(!$enabled||$templateCode===''){
            $status='config_disabled';
            $reason=$enabled?'template_missing':'channel_or_event_disabled';
        }elseif($deliveryMode==='subscription_fallback'){
            $status='not_run';
            $reason='subscription_fallback_not_triggered_in_demo';
        }else{
            $status='demo_suppressed';
            $reason='demo_order_external_delivery_suppressed';
        }
        foreach((array)($definition['recipients']??[]) as $recipientType){
            if(!in_array($recipientType,['user','worker'],true))continue;
            $recipientId=$recipientType==='user'?(int)($order['user_id']??0):(int)($order['assigned_worker_id']??0);
            if($recipientId<1)continue;
            self::record($db,$instanceId,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,'aliyun_sms',$recipientType,$recipientId,$status,$reason,(string)($definition['scene']??''),[
                'status'=>(string)($definition['status']??''),'order_no'=>(string)($parameters['order_no']??''),
                'delivery_mode'=>$deliveryMode,'template_configured'=>$templateCode!=='',
            ]);
        }
    }

    private static function captureWecom(Database $db,int $instanceId,int $orderId,string $eventKey,string $eventType,array $definition,array $parameters,array $meta): void
    {
        if(!in_array('admin',(array)($definition['recipients']??[]),true)||empty($meta['wecom_visible']))return;
        $enabled=\filter_var(\setting('wecom.webhook_enabled',false),FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN)
            && self::eventEnabled('wecom.event_switches','wecom',$eventType);
        self::record($db,$instanceId,$orderId,$eventKey,$eventType,'wecom_webhook','admin',0,
            $enabled?'demo_suppressed':'config_disabled',$enabled?'demo_order_external_delivery_suppressed':'channel_or_event_disabled',
            (string)($definition['scene']??''),[
                'status'=>(string)($definition['status']??''),'order_no'=>(string)($parameters['order_no']??''),
            ]);
    }

    private static function resolveInstanceId(Database $db,int $orderId): int
    {
        $direct=(int)$db->fetchValue("SELECT ti.id FROM test_instances ti JOIN orders o ON o.id=ti.order_id WHERE ti.order_id=:id AND o.is_demo=1 AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1",['id'=>$orderId]);
        if($direct>0)return $direct;
        if(!$db->tableExists('order_relations'))return 0;
        return(int)$db->fetchValue("SELECT ti.id FROM order_relations r JOIN test_instances ti ON ti.order_id=r.parent_order_id JOIN orders child_order ON child_order.id=r.child_order_id WHERE r.child_order_id=:id AND r.relation_type='measurement_construction' AND r.status='active' AND child_order.is_demo=1 AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1",['id'=>$orderId]);
    }

    private static function eventEnabled(string $settingKey,string $channel,string $eventType): bool
    {
        $configured=\setting($settingKey,[]);
        return MessageEventCatalog::enabled($channel,$eventType,is_array($configured)?$configured:[]);
    }

    private static function record(Database $db,int $instanceId,int $orderId,string $eventKey,string $eventType,string $channel,string $recipientType,int $recipientId,string $status,string $reason,string $sceneKey,array $payload): void
    {
        $businessIdentity=$eventKey.':'.$channel.':'.$recipientType.':'.$recipientId.':'.$sceneKey;
        // Keep long event keys distinct: a raw 190-byte prefix can silently collide under INSERT IGNORE.
        $businessKey=strlen($businessIdentity)<=190?$businessIdentity:substr($businessIdentity,0,125).':'.hash('sha256',$businessIdentity);
        $db->execute("INSERT IGNORE INTO test_message_outbox(instance_id,order_id,business_key,event_key,event_type,channel,recipient_type,recipient_id,scene_key,projection_status,reason_code,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(:instance,:order_id,:business_key,:event_key,:event_type,:channel,:recipient_type,:recipient_id,:scene_key,:status,:reason,:payload,UTC_TIMESTAMP())",[
            'instance'=>$instanceId,'order_id'=>$orderId,'business_key'=>$businessKey,'event_key'=>substr($eventKey,0,160),
            'event_type'=>substr($eventType,0,120),'channel'=>$channel,'recipient_type'=>$recipientType,'recipient_id'=>$recipientId>0?$recipientId:null,
            'scene_key'=>substr($sceneKey,0,80),'status'=>$status,'reason'=>substr($reason,0,120),
            'payload'=>json_encode($payload,JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES),
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DateTimeZone;
use Throwable;

/** 售后维修先由双方处理；师傅拒绝或超时后才允许升级平台。 */
final class RepairInterventionPolicy
{
    public const WAIT_HOURS = 48;

    /** @return array{eligible:bool,reason:string,available_at:?string,wait_hours:int} */
    public static function evaluate(
        string $status,
        ?string $resolution,
        ?string $openedAt,
        string $timezone = 'UTC',
        ?DateTimeImmutable $now = null
    ): array {
        $status = trim($status);
        $resolution = trim((string)$resolution);
        $openedAt = trim((string)$openedAt);
        $result = ['eligible'=>false,'reason'=>'not_active','available_at'=>null,'wait_hours'=>self::WAIT_HOURS];

        if (!in_array($status, ['open','processing'], true)) return $result;
        if (strpos($resolution, '用户申请平台介入') === 0) {
            $result['reason'] = 'already_escalated';
            return $result;
        }
        if (strpos($resolution, '师傅拒绝维修') === 0) {
            $result['eligible'] = true;
            $result['reason'] = 'worker_rejected';
            return $result;
        }
        if ($openedAt === '') {
            $result['reason'] = 'opened_at_missing';
            return $result;
        }

        try {
            $zone = new DateTimeZone($timezone !== '' ? $timezone : 'UTC');
            $opened = new DateTimeImmutable($openedAt, $zone);
            $available = $opened->modify('+'.self::WAIT_HOURS.' hours');
            $current = $now ?: new DateTimeImmutable('now', $zone);
            $result['available_at'] = $available->format('Y-m-d H:i');
            $result['eligible'] = $current >= $available;
            $result['reason'] = $result['eligible'] ? 'response_timeout' : 'waiting_worker';
            return $result;
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            $result['reason'] = 'opened_at_invalid';
            return $result;
        }
    }
}
